Het bedrijf combineert stabiliteit en vakkennis met een moderne IT-visie en werkt zowel aan interne IT-projecten als aan oplossingen voor klanten.
Je komt terecht in een mensgerichte organisatie waar initiatief, samenwerking en persoonlijke groei centraal staan.

Jouw rol

  • Je werkt mee aan het beheren en uitbouwen van een moderne IT-infrastructuur, on-prem en in de cloud. Je taken zijn gevarieerd en technisch uitdagend.
  • Beheer van Azure en Azure Entra ID
  • Ondersteuning van Windows-omgevingen, servers en netwerken
  • Meewerken aan IT-security en infrastructuurprojecten
  • Afwisseling tussen interne IT en klantenwerk
  • Opleiding en voldoende werkervaring in IT / Informatica
  • Goede kennis van netwerken, systemen en beveiliging
  • Ervaring met Azure, Windows-omgevingen en servers
  • Leergierige, oplossingsgerichte en hands-on ingesteldheid
  • Kennis van Zabbix, pfSense, Sophos, Genetec of ISO27001

jobs.title: Flexijob onderhoudstechnieker grootkeukentoestellen
jobs.description:
Ben jij een krak in elektriciteit en elektronica? Zoek je een flexibele bijverdienste? Sleutel je graag aan professionele keukenapparaten?

Kom dan werken als reparateur bij onze toonaangevende partner in professionele keuken- en restaurantinrichtingen in Lummen.

Onze klant is dé B2B-totaalleverancier voor professionele keukeninrichting en horeca-uitrusting. Zij begeleiden professionele klanten zoals horecazaken, scholen en zorginstellingen van A tot Z. Dit gaat van het ontwerpen van complete keukentrajecten tot de levering van specifieke toestellen en tafelbekleding. Zij produceren zelf niet, maar ontzorgen de klant volledig met oplossingen op maat, van ontwerp tot nazorg.

Jouw missie!

Jij bent als technieker de redder in nood voor professionele keukens en grootkeukentoestellen.

  • In het atelier: Je herstelt binnengebrachte professionele keukenapparatuur (o.a. mixers, ovens,…)
  • Op locatie: Je onderhoudt professionele keukenapparatuur bij de klant (o.a. vaatwasser, kookplaat,…). Dit doe je van Limburg tot de grens met Antwerpen en Brussel

Ben jij de vliegende technieker die paraat staat wanneer een keukentoestel stopt met werken?

Herken jij jezelf hierin?

  • Goede basiskennis van elektriciteit en elektronica
  • Heb je al ervaring als technieker met keukenapparaten, elektronica,…? Dan is dit héél mooi meegenomen!
  • Handig en weet van aanpakken
  • Rijbewijs B in je bezit: je onderhoudt keukenapparatuur op locatie bij klanten
  • Flexibel inzetbaar naargelang nood en vraag, zonder vaste uren of dagen (soms 1 à 2 dagen per week, soms een week niet)

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
Onze klant is een Japans internationaal bedrijf voor koel- en gascompressoren op de Europese markt. Ze zijn op zoek naar een Commissioning Engineer voor hun kantoor in Zaventem.

Ze werken aan een duurzame toekomst door enkel gebruik te maken van natuurlijke koelmiddelen zonder broeikaseffect en te streven naar optimale systemen, uitrusting en technologie in nauwe samenwerking met onze klanten.

Onze klant biedt producten aan in Europa, het Midden-Oosten, Afrika, India en de Oceanische markt. Ze hebben kantoren in 15 landen.

Functie omschrijving
Ze zoeken een Commissioning Engineer voor hun control team.

Je zult rapporteren aan de Teamleider van de Commissioning Afdeling en een belangrijke schakel worden in een team van vier personen dat verantwoordelijk is voor de automatisering van onze koel- en warmtepompunits.

Wat kun je voor ons betekenen?
  • Programmeren, opstarten en analyseren van software in de werktuigbouwkunde.
  • Focus op industriële machines met behulp van PLC- en HMI-besturingen en netwerken.
  • Ontwerp en implementatie van het procesbesturingssysteem voor de automatiseringsmachines (schematisch, paneelbouw, documentatie, enz.).
  • Bereidheid om naar het veld te gaan voor onze diverse klanten.
Wat verwachten we van jou?
  • Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma in elektromechanica of automatisering.
  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in gerelateerde sectoren (elektrotechniek, technische dienst...) is een vereiste.
  • Je bent punctueel en kunt gestructureerd werken. Bovendien ben je gemotiveerd en leergierig.
  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in een team werken.
  • Een rijbewijs B is een pluspunt.
  • Kennis van computerprogrammering is een pluspunt.
  • Engels is een must, kennis van andere talen is een pluspunt.

Ben jij de Commissioning Engineer die wij zoeken of wil je meer informatie?

jobs.title: Stafmedewerker sociale economie
jobs.description:
Welzijnsvereniging KINA p.v. is een OCMW-vereniging van 26 OCMW's in het arrondissement Antwerpen. Als samenwerkingsverband helpen wij onze leden-OCMW bij het zoeken naar oplossingen voor problemen die een grensoverschrijdende aanpak vergen. Dynamisch en flexibel bieden wij ondersteuning telkens wanneer het lokaal bestuur geconfronteerd wordt met nieuwe uitdagingen, capaciteitsproblemen of een tekort aan expertise.

Als stafmedewerker sociale economie behoor je mee tot de groep van onze experten. Je bent actief in onze hele regio om sociale economie, inclusie, integratie en participatie mogelijk te maken, je tracht samenwerking tussen partners te bevorderen via een open partnerschap, je zorgt voor een actieve kennisdeling in het werkveld en je creëert zowel intern als extern bijkomende tewerkstellingsmogelijkheden voor mensen met een grote(re) afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt.

Bovendien sta je als specialist de lokale besturen bij in de uitvoering van hun activiteiten rond sociale economie, inclusie, integratie en participatie door proactief en flexibel in te spelen op de ontwikkelingen binnen dit vakgebied en op de wijzigende behoeften van de leden. Zo zijn we ooit begonnen als regisseur sociale economie voor een aantal van onze leden, een rol die we momenteel nog altijd actief opnemen. Doorheen de jaren zijn hier heel wat verschillende projecten uitgegroeid: het regionaal initiatief wijk-werken, een uitleendienst voor kinderfietsen, een voedseldistributieplatform, een netwerk voor inburgering i.h.k.v. de vierde pijler, enz. Iets dat we willen blijven doen en waaraan jij als stafmedewerker verder kan bouwen door actief in te spelen op nieuwe kansen in het werkveld. Zo zorg je telkens mee voor de opstart en uitrol van nieuwe projecten, in het belang van onze lokale besturen.

Ben jij op de hoogte van het reilen en zeilen in het werkveld van de sociale economie? Is netwerken je op het lijf geschreven? Hou je van de uitwerking en uitrol van nieuwe projecten? Heb je een sociaal hart en zijn inclusie, integratie en participatie van kwetsbare doelgroepen jouw drijfveer? Wil jij mee mogelijkheden creëren om mensen met een verre afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt te activeren? Dan ben jij misschien wel de geknipte persoon voor deze functie!

Jouw voornaamste taken:

  • Ontwikkelen van een gedragen beleidsvisie omtrent de lokale sociale economie binnen de regio.
  • Informatieverzameling en uitvoeren van wetenschappelijke analyses op het terrein van lokale werkgelegenheid en sociale economie.
  • Opmaak van beleids- en actieplannen met betrekking tot de sociale economie en uitwerken van bijhorende acties.
  • Ondersteunen van KINA, haar lokale besturen en sociale economieondernemingen bij de ontwikkeling, implementatie en optimalisatie van hun initiatieven in de sociale economie.
  • Opvolgen van de regelgeving, relevante beleidsontwikkelingen en de lokale noden in de sociale economie en vertalen naar de gebruikers.
  • Voorbereiden, voorzitten en verslag maken van overlegplatformen, werkgroepen, etc. die voortvloeien uit de regierol sociale economie.
  • De principes van maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen bekendmaken bij de lokale besturen en in het bredere werkveld.

Algemeen

  • Je beschikt over een masterdiploma, ofwel een diploma van het universitair onderwijs, ofwel een diploma van het hoger onderwijs van 2 cycli dat gelijkgeschakeld werd met Universitair onderwijs, dat toegang geeft tot het niveau A.
  • Je hebt een grondige kennis van het werkveld van de sociale economie.
  • Je hebt een grondige kennis van de bestaande regelgeving sociale economie en tewerkstellingsmaatregelen.
  • Je hebt kennis van sociaalwetenschappelijke onderzoeksmethodes.
  • Je hebt kennis van de werking van een lokaal bestuur.
  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B en eigen vervoer.

Jobgerelateerde competenties

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en kan op een positieve manier onderhandelen, modereren en motiveren.
  • Je hebt sterke redactionele vaardigheden.
  • Je hebt sterke analytische vaardigheden en kan probleemoplossend werken.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met het gebruik van sociale onderzoeksmethoden.
  • Je kan een situatie, een lokale context of een dienstverlening diagnosticeren door het analyseren van economische, demografische, sociale, ... gegevens.
  • Je kan beslissingen van de regering toepassen rekening houdend met de lokale context en belangen.
  • Je bent in staat om de uit te voeren projecten te bepalen.
  • Je kan de uitgevoerde acties controleren en aanbevelingen geven.

Persoonsgebonden competenties

  • Je bent creatief ingesteld.
  • Je bent flexibel.
  • Je bent discreet en diplomatisch.
  • Je bent loyaal en kan je schikken naar beleid.
  • Je streeft naar kwaliteit en resultaatsgerichtheid.
  • Je bent collegiaal, zowel binnen KINA als binnen de lokale besturen.
  • Je hebt een sterke verantwoordelijkheidszin.

jobs.title: Cloud and Data Platform Lead
jobs.description: Cloud and Data Platform Lead. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Etsimme nyt joukkoomme Pilvi- ja data-alustan omistajaa vastaamaan Helenin yhteisten pilvi- ja data-alustapalveluiden kokonaisuudesta ja niiden kehittämisestä. Työsuhde on vakituinen. Pilvi- ja data-alustan omistajana huolehdit siitä, että alustapalvelut muodostavat liiketoimintaa ja digitaalisten ratkaisujen kehittämistä tukevan, hallitun ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän kokonaisuuden. Tehtävä ei ole ensisijaisesti syvällinen tekninen asiantuntijarooli, vaan sinun tulee ymmärtää pilvi- ja dataratkaisujen toimintaympäristöä ja mahdollisuuksia. Pilvi- ja data-alustojen kehittämistä tehdään Helenissä virtuaalitiimin voimin. Roolissasi Vastaat Helenin pilvi- ja data-alustapalveluiden kokonaisuudesta, niiden elinkaaresta ja suunnitelmallisesta kehittämisestä.Määrität yhdessä liiketoiminnan, arkkitehtuurin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa alustapalveluiden tavoitetilaa.Vastaat alustapalveluiden laadusta, jatkuvuudesta, kustannustehokkuudesta, tietoturvasta ja tarkoituksenmukaisesta elinkaarenhallinnasta.Rakennat selkeitä palvelumalleja ja huolehdit siitä, että alustojen tarjoamat kyvykkyydet ovat niitä hyödyntäville tiimeille helposti ymmärrettäviä ja käytettäviä.Ohjaat palveluiden tuottamiseen ja kehittämiseen osallistuvia kumppaneita ja varmistat, että tekeminen etenee yhteisten tavoitteiden mukaisesti.Varmistat aktiivisen yhteistyön liiketoiminnan, IT:n, data- ja analytiikkatoimintojen, arkkitehtuurin, kyberturvan sekä muiden keskeisten sidosryhmien välillä.Toivomme sinulta Vähintään noin viiden vuoden kokemusta laajojen IT-palveluiden, alustojen tai digitaalisten kyvykkyyksien omistamisesta ja kehittämisestä.Hyvää kokonaisymmärrystä pilvi- ja data-alustoista liiketoiminnan ja digitaalisten palveluiden mahdollistajana sekä liiketoiminnan tarpeiden ja teknologian yhdistämisestä.Kykyä tarkastella palveluita myös kustannusten, riskien, jatkuvuuden ja käyttäjäkokemuksen näkökulmista.Kokemusta toimittaja- ja kumppanijohtamisesta sekä kykyä ohjata useiden toimijoiden muodostamaa kokonaisuutta.Hyviä yhteistyö-, viestintä- ja vaikuttamistaitoja sekä kykyä rakentaa yhteistä ymmärrystä erilaisten sidosryhmien välillä. Emme etsi tehtävään yksittäisen pilviteknologian syväosaajaa, vaan suunnannäyttäjää, joka pystyy johtamaan alustapalveluita kokonaisuutena ja tekemään niiden kehittämisestä liiketoimintalähtöistä. Tarjoamme sinulle Pilvi- ja data-alustat ovat keskeisiä mahdollistajia Helenin digitaalisten palveluiden, datan hyödyntämisen, analytiikan ja uusien AI-ratkaisujen kehittämisessä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, millaisia yhteisiä kyvykkyyksiä Helen tarjoaa kehittäjille ja liiketoiminnoille sekä miten niitä kehitetään tulevaisuudessa. Saat vastuullesi kokonaisuuden, jossa onnistuminen ei tarkoita vain teknisesti toimivaa alustaa. Tavoitteena on rakentaa palveluita, jotka ovat käyttäjilleen selkeitä, helposti hyödynnettäviä, kustannustehokkaita ja turvallisia ja jotka kehittyvät Helenin liiketoiminnan mukana. Pääset nauttimaan myös erilaisista henkilöstöeduistamme, kuten henkilöstösähköstä, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, etätyömahdollisuudesta ulkomailla ja hyvinvointiedusta. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määritellään tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä tai tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi (Jarmo Ojamo / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi) sähköpostitse. Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa! Voit hakea rekryjärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 11.10.2026. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: People and Workplace Executive
jobs.description:
Healf is Europe's fastest-growing company.

Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three.

We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter.

The next chapter is harder and more interesting.

We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one.

At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people.

We're looking for an ambitious People Executive to help build an exceptional employee experience at Healf.

This is an ideal opportunity for an exceptional graduate or someone early in their career who thrives on ownership, loves bringing order to fast-moving environments, and genuinely cares about creating a workplace where people can do their best work.

You'll sit at the heart of the business, ensuring our office runs seamlessly, every new joiner has an outstanding experience, and our culture continues to scale as we grow. You'll constantly look for ways to improve processes, automate manual work, and raise the bar across every employee touchpoint.

Where you'll make an impact

  • Workplace:

    • Create a workplace that is organised, energising and enables the team to perform at their best.

    • Own the day-to-day running of the office, ensuring spaces, meeting rooms and equipment are always ready for use.

    • Manage workplace technology, inventory and supplies, proactively identifying improvements before they become problems.

  • Culture and Engagement:

    • Launch initiatives that strengthen team connection, including buddy programmes, coffee chats and other engagement activities.

    • Coordinate inspiring fireside chats, team meetings and internal events.

    • Plan quarterly socials and wellbeing initiatives aligned to Healf's four wellbeing pillars.

    • Gather feedback from employees and identify opportunities to improve the overall employee experience.

What you'll bring

  • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Naturally proactive; you spot problems before anyone else does.

  • Strong ownership mentality; you enjoy being trusted with responsibility.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to prioritise multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Curious and always looking for better ways of working.

  • Confident working across different teams and building relationships.

  • Strong administrative skills and comfortable learning new systems quickly.

  • Positive energy and genuine enthusiasm for creating a great employee experience.

  • Excited by working in the office five days a week and helping shape company culture in person.

Nice to haves

  • Previous internship or placement in People, Operations, Hospitality, Events or Customer Experience.

  • Experience improving processes or introducing automation.

  • Passion for wellbeing, health or high-performance cultures.

What makes someone exceptional in this role?

We'd love to see examples of someone who has:

  • Taken ownership of a university society, sports club or large-scale event.

  • Built systems that made something run better.

  • Naturally notices details that others miss.

  • Loves hosting, organising and creating memorable experiences.

  • Has high standards and dislikes leaving things "good enough."

  • Learns incredibly quickly and actively seeks feedback.

These behaviours matter far more than extensive experience.

  • You rely mainly on inbound applications or agencies. Direct sourcing and proactive pipeline building are important parts of this role

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

💰 A salary between £55,000 and £65,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

First stage - screening interview with the talent lead

Second stage - interview with the head of people and talent lead to delve into your technical skills via a case study/scenario based task

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Role

9fin's buy-side clients are the capital behind the credit markets. Credit funds, CLO managers, private credit platforms, and distressed investors run research, underwriting, portfolio monitoring, and relative value workflows that are deep and specialised. They are actively excited about what AI can unlock. Our job is to make that potential real inside their investment teams.

The Forward Deployed Investor is the person who does it. You are a domain expert who has done the work yourself, and you can credibly sit across the table from a portfolio manager, a private credit underwriter, or a distressed analyst and say: "Here is how this changes the way you invest."

You will work with 9fin's most strategic buy-side clients, drive deep adoption of our existing AI capabilities across the investment process, and become a critical voice in shaping what we build next. Every client engagement is a source of product intelligence. The insights you bring back from the front line will directly influence 9fin's AI product roadmap and sharpen how we win the next generation of buy-side accounts.

 

What You Will Do

  • Map investment workflows and find the highest-value insertion points. Embed with client teams to document how sourcing, screening, underwriting, credit committee preparation, portfolio monitoring, and relative value work actually gets done end-to-end. Identify the three to five places where 9fin's AI can materially change the workflow. Co-author adoption success criteria with the client, tied to their investment outcomes.

  • Build 9fin's AI into those workflows. Take the identified insertion points and build them out using 9fin's toolkit: in-platform capabilities, MCP integrations, agents, and future capabilities as they ship. Weighted by workflow depth, not count. Iterate based on real usage behaviour, not intended usage.

  • Drive adoption at your served accounts. Onboard named users across investment, research, and risk. Run enablement sessions with power users, identify and support champions inside the client. Monitor active usage and address dormant seats before they become churn signals. Review adoption monthly with client champions and quarterly with the CIO, head of research, or equivalent sponsor.

  • Feed the field back into 9fin. Every deployment produces structured intelligence, fed to two consumers. First, product and engineering: prioritised requests tied to specific account and workflow context, patterns extracted across deployments. Second, the wider GTM cycle: case studies, demo assets, workflow evidence, and competitive intelligence that sharpen the next GTM cycle.

  • Spot expansion. Identify opportunities inside served accounts for new users, new use cases, new departments, or new products. Document with context and hand to Account Management for commercial follow-up.

 

What You Bring

You are a subject matter expert with 3+ years of practitioner experience at an asset manager, credit fund, or insurer, with fluency across end-to-end investment workflows in your area, not just the data those workflows consume. Specifically, in one or more of the following:

  • Credit portfolio management and research. High yield, leveraged loan, or multi-strategy credit investing, covering screening, underwriting, credit committee process, and ongoing portfolio monitoring

  • Private credit and direct lending. Origination, underwriting, documentation review, or portfolio monitoring at a private credit or direct lending platform

  • CLO investing. CLO management, warehouse and portfolio construction, or CLO debt and equity tranche investing

  • Distressed and special situations. Stressed and distressed credit analysis, restructuring and process tracking, documentation and covenant analysis, or capital structure work

  • Buy-side transformation, data, or research technology functions. Investment data, quantitative or systematic credit research, chief data office, digital transformation, or AI strategy roles where you have led or contributed to AI and workflow transformation projects specifically in credit investing

Beyond your domain expertise, you are:

  • Demonstrably interested in technology applied to your domain. For example: participation in an internal AI, data, or research technology working group; external vendor champion or evaluation lead for domain tech. You may have already moved to a technology company focused on credit markets.

  • Familiar with and hands-on with modern domain tooling. Direct user experience of Rogo, Hebbia, AlphaSense, Octus, or comparable AI-native platforms in your workflow. You can speak from experience about what works, what doesn't, and why.

  • Comfortable operating inside confidential investment processes. You will sit close to live pipelines, positions, and internal research. You are disciplined about what does and does not travel between accounts, and clients trust you quickly because of it.

  • A strong communicator across styles and audiences. Extremely comfortable with the analysts who will be the day-to-day platform users. Highly credible with portfolio managers, heads of research, and CIOs. Strong writing and in-person skills. Able to flex style for technical and business audiences.

  • Highly collaborative across a broad internal network. The function operates in close partnership with GTM, Product, Engineering, and other 9fin teams. You are energised by cross-functional work, you bring people with you rather than working around them, and you know how to translate what you are learning in the field into inputs that other teams can act on.

  • Outcome-oriented. You measure success by whether clients are actually using the platform differently, not by how many meetings you held or decks you delivered.

 

Why Join 9fin

  • Category leadership. 9fin is the reference platform for debt capital markets data and AI. Buy-side clients use us because there is no comparable alternative.

  • A genuine domain-expert role. You bring credit investing expertise; we back you with the platform, the product team, and the mandate to make it real inside client organisations.

  • Direct influence on the product. Field intelligence from your deployments feeds the product roadmap. What you learn on the ground shapes what 9fin builds next.

  • Series C stage, growing fast. Small enough that your work is visible, large enough to have the platform and customer base ready for real deployment.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

jobs.title: Head of Legal, Commercial
jobs.description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

We are hiring our Head of Legal, Commercial to lead and scale the commercial legal function at OLIX. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, you will own commercial contracting end to end as OLIX moves from a small legal team to a function that supports a rapidly scaling business. You will be the lead lawyer on some of our most important projects and largest and most complex deals, the person the business comes to to help them make clear and quick risk decisions and, as the company grows, you will have the opportunity to recruit team members. You will define the playbooks, standards, and tooling that let OLIX scale faster than legal headcount.

This is a player-coach role for a technically excellent, experienced lawyer who wants to own a function in an environment accelerating and changing quickly, work hands-on with engineers and commercial leaders, and shape how commercial legal works at one of the most ambitious deep-tech companies in Europe. You will not be sitting above the work. You will be leading the toughest negotiations yourself, making judgement calls where the law, the facts, and the commercial picture are all still moving, and building the team that handles everything else. OLIX moves quickly, priorities shift, and there is often no precedent to lean on. You need to have worked in an environment like this before, or be able to show you would thrive in one.

Open to UK-based candidates and US-qualified attorneys willing to relocate to London. We provide full visa sponsorship and relocation support.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the commercial legal function end to end: strategy, team, deal flow, tooling, and standards.

  • Personally lead negotiations on OLIX’s largest and most complex commercial deals, including customer agreements with hyperscalers, manufacturing, and other supply chain agreements with contract manufacturing partners, NREs, JDAs, technology licences, and strategic partnerships.

  • Build and scale the commercial legal team as OLIX grows. You will be hands-on as the main lawyer on your own projects from day one and, in time, hire, develop, and line-manage additional team members.

  • Set commercial legal standards, playbooks, fallback positions, and templates across the function.

  • Working with the CLO, make risk decisions, and help the business make them. Cut through ambiguity, frame legal and commercial risk in plain terms, recommend a position, and own the call, including where the facts, the law, or the commercial context are developing and moving quickly.

  • Design and build scalable legal workflows using AI tooling and automation, so the legal function scales faster than headcount.

  • Integrate AI deeply into day-to-day contracting: triage, first-pass review, redline generation, clause extraction, precedent search, and playbook enforcement.

  • Set OLIX’s positions on key commercial terms including liability caps, indemnities, IP ownership and licensing, data protection, warranties, termination, and service levels.

  • Own the IP dimension of commercial work: structure and negotiate IP ownership, background and foreground IP, licensing, confidentiality, and know-how provisions in JDAs, NREs, and manufacturing and supply arrangements, working closely with engineering and IP counsel to protect OLIX’s core technology, working closely with the CLO and other senior leaders to define and implement IP strategy.

  • Partner with Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and Engineering to align legal with business strategy.

  • Manage external counsel for specialist workstreams including US contracting, specialist IP, data, and export controls.

  • Partner with the CLO and other team members on cross-functional matters including corporate, governance, and regulatory work that touches commercial contracting.

  • Contribute to legal tooling selection, CLM implementation, and internal enablement across the broader legal team.

Skills & Experience

  • Qualified solicitor in England and Wales, or US-qualified attorney (admitted to a US state bar), guidance being at least 8 to 12 years of post-qualification experience.

  • Trained at a top-tier City, US, or comparable international firm.

  • Technically excellent lawyer. Rigorous legal analysis, precise drafting, and a structured approach to playbooks and standard forms. You know when precision matters and when speed does, and you are the person more junior lawyers check their work with.

  • Demonstrable track record leading complex commercial contract negotiations end to end as the responsible lawyer, not just supporting a partner, and of being the main lawyer on multi-workstream projects (a manufacturing ramp, a major customer deployment, a strategic partnership) rather than on a single contract.

  • Technical IP experience. You have negotiated IP ownership, background and foreground IP, licensing, confidentiality, and know-how provisions in technology development, manufacturing, and supply arrangements (JDAs, NREs, foundry and supply agreements), ideally involving semiconductors, hardware, or other deep technology. You do not need to be a patent attorney, but you need to understand what is being created and licensed and how to protect it.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making risk decisions. You can take an incomplete picture, work out what matters, give a clear recommendation, and own it. You help the business make good risk calls rather than handing it a list of issues.

  • Proper, relevant experience of an environment like OLIX: you have built, scaled, or meaningfully contributed to a commercial legal function in a fast-moving technology or hardware business, ideally a venture-backed scale-up, working directly with founders, engineers, and commercial teams.

  • Line-management or mentoring experience with junior counsel, paralegals, or secondees. Does not need to be extensive but needs to be real, and you want to manage and grow a team as the function scales.

  • Comfortable with technical subject matter. You can get to grips with OLIX’s technology well enough to draft and negotiate around it credibly and to hold your own with engineers.

  • AI-native approach to legal work. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day practice, have strong instincts for what AI does well and where it fails, and treat AI fluency as a core craft skill rather than a novelty.

  • Bias toward building scalable systems over doing work manually. You look for the automation, template, or workflow that solves the problem ten times, not just once.

  • Commercially pragmatic, able to move at pace, and comfortable owning positions without constant supervision.

  • Direct, plain-language communicator.

  • The right fit for how OLIX works: hands-on, direct, high ownership, and comfortable being part of the team rather than a gatekeeper. You would rather solve the problem than write the memo.

Nice to have

  • Experience in technology or in technical manufacturing more broadly, ideally B2B hardware, semiconductors, or infrastructure. Highly desirable.

  • Supply chain experience: supply, manufacturing, component, and logistics arrangements, and the issues that come with scaling a hardware supply chain (capacity and volume commitments, allocation, lead times, quality, tooling, dual-sourcing). Highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with enterprise or cloud customer contracting, including bespoke negotiations with hyperscalers.

  • Understanding of export controls (particularly the US and UK regimes for advanced computing and semiconductors) and data protection as they arise in commercial contracts.

  • Experience implementing or selecting CLM or legal AI tooling (Ironclad, Harvey, Legora, Spellbook, Robin, Eve, etc.).

  • Light coding or low-code fluency (Python, SQL, Zapier, n8n, or similar) for building internal workflows.

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

jobs.title: Fengselsbetjenter  i Halden fengsel
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Halden fengsel søker fengselsbetjenter med etatsutdanning til faste stillinger i turnustjeneste.  

Fengselsbetjenter i turnus gis innplassering i en av fengselets 8 avdelinger. 
I turnus inngår vakter dag, kveld, natt og helger. Turnusansatte jobber 3. hver helg.

En fengselsbetjent har ansvar for de innsatte og ansattes sikkerhet, innholdsarbeid, innhenting og vurdering av informasjon og saksbehandling. Fengselsbetjenten skal ha evne til sikkerhetstenkning, grensesetting og konflikthåndtering samt være en samtalepartner, kontaktbetjent, rollemodell og veileder for de innsatte, og delta i målrettet progresjonsarbeid med innsatte.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • avdelingstjeneste med daglige oppgaver knyttet til innsatte
  • kontaktbetjentarbeid, soningsplanlegging, miljøarbeid og programarbeid
  • være en aktiv medspiller i den faglige og sikkerhetsmessige utviklingen av avdelingen

 Den som ansettes må påregne endringer i ansvars- og arbeidsområde.


Utdanning og erfaring

Du må ha

  • bestått fengselsbetjentutdanning fra Kriminalomsorgens høgskole og utdanningssenter KRUS
  • god kunnskap og erfaring i bruk av IKT verktøy og systemer
  • god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne
  • førerkort klasse B

Det er ønskelig med

  • kunnskap om andre språk

Personlige egenskaper
  • gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • evne til å jobbe selvstendig, målrettet og systematisk med målgruppen
  • evne til å søke gode løsninger for den enkelte, i samspill med øvrige kollegaer, ledelse og eksterne samarbeidspartnere
  • tålmodighet, ansvarsfull, å kunne sette grenser og ha evnen til å motivere mennesker i vanskelige livssituasjoner

Vi tilbyr
  • meningsfulle oppgaver i en etat med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
  • gode pensjons, forsikrings- og låneordninger i Statens pensjonskasse
  • moderne lokaler, kantineordning, gratis parkering, trening i arbeidstid
  • stillingen lønnes som fengselsbetjent fra  kr 500 000 - 630 000 pr år avhengig av erfaring og kompetanse. Det blir trukket 2 % innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse

Generell informasjon

Kriminalomsorgen mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulik kompetanse, livserfaring og perspektiv for å kunne bidra til en enda bedre oppgaveløsning.  

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at det må ikke være noe å utsette på vandelen til den som ansettes. Dette må dokumenteres med en uttømmende politiattest forut for ansettelse.

Vi gjør også oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om søker har bedt om å være unntatt søkerlisten. Søker vil i så fall bli varslet om dette og gitt anledning til å trekke søknaden.

 

Den som ansettes må rette seg etter organisasjonsmessige eller andre endringer som blir bestemt om arbeidsområdet. 

Nærmere opplysninger om stillingen fås ved henvendelse til fengselsinspektør Runar Eidissen,  tlf. 69214600.

For spørsmål om elektronisk utfylling av CV kan Jobbnorge kontaktes på 75 54 22 20. 
 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kriminalomsorgens samfunnsoppdrag er å gjennomføre varetektsfengsling og straffereaksjoner på en måte som er betryggende for samfunnet og som motvirker straffbare handlinger. Målet vårt er at den domfelte etter soning skal velge å leve et kriminalitetsfritt liv. Vår visjon er «Straff som endrer» og våre verdier er: trygghet, åpenhet og nytenking som er førende for vår atferd og som organisasjon. Les mer om vår virksomhetsstrategi her. Kriminalomsorgen består av Kriminalomsorgsdirektoratet (KDI), Kriminalomsorgens høyskole og utdanningssenter (KRUS) og fem regioner med cirka 60 lokale fengsler og friomsorgskontor.  Region øst omfatter 12 fengsler, 4 friomsorgskontor, overgangsbolig, senter for narkotikakontroll med domstolkontroll og hundetjeneste med ca. 1.800 tilsatte i Akershus, Oslo, Østfold, Oppland og Hedmark.  Regionadministrasjonen er i Lillestrøm.  

Halden fengsel er et av Norges største fengsler med 250 innsatte og er lokalisert i Halden og gjennomfører varetektsfengsling og fengselsstraffer av ulike kategorier. Fengselet har avdelinger med høyt sikkerhetsnivå  i tillegg til en overgangsbolig. Halden fengsel har et høyt faglig nivå og legger stor vekt på tverrfaglig samarbeid.
Halden fengsel har en stor spennvidde i sin aktivitet, eksempelvis; Fra avdelingstjeneste på boavdeling for innsatte, via en meget variert håndverks- og industriproduksjon, til samhandling med andre stedlige forvaltningssamarbeidspartnere fra stat/fylkeskommune/kommune

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Infrastructure Engineer

Hybrid/Tunbridge Wells | Unlimited Holiday | Keeping customer infrastructure secure, resilient and ready
for what comes next.

Infinity Group are a innovative Microsoft Cloud Solution Partner based in the UK. We excel in providing award-winning IT Support, Digital Transformation, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Consultancy services.
 
With a robust team of over 180 professionals, we operate from offices in Tunbridge Wells and London Paddington. Our exceptional work has earned us the prestigious title of Microsoft Partner of the Year for Dynamics Business Central.
 
We are dedicated to fostering a more productive and secure work environment for organizations utilizing Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, and Azure.
 
Guided by core values of empathy, creativity, ambition, authenticity, and confidence, we celebrate diversity and strive to create a supportive and innovative work environment.
 
We are committed to the well-being and growth of our employees, and we prioritize continuous learning and development through fully funded training programs.
 
Our focus on people, expertise, and commitment to excellence underscores our mission to make a positive impact in the tech industry.
 
Role Overview:

Our customers rely on their infrastructure to operate securely and without disruption. This role exists to protect that foundation.

You’ll take ownership of the health, performance and security of customer environments across Microsoft Azure and on-premises infrastructure. You’ll prevent avoidable issues, resolve complex problems and ensure new solutions move smoothly into live service.

Working across Service Desk, Cyber Security and project delivery, you’ll help turn infrastructure support from a reactive service into a proactive source of customer confidence and long-term value


What you'll be doing:
Infrastructure health and performance
  • Own the day-to-day health of customer infrastructure across Azure and on-premises environments. Monitor availability, performance and capacity, taking action before emerging issues affect the customer.
    • Secure and controlled operations
  • Maintain secure configurations, access controls and patching standards across supported platforms. Ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within agreed timescales and that operational activity supports Cyber Essentials and ISO 27001 expectations.
    • Incident resolution and prevention
  • Act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents. Diagnose issues across servers, storage, virtualisation, networking and cloud services, then turn root-cause findings into preventative improvements.
    • Platform maintenance and recovery
  • Plan and deliver patches, upgrades and maintenance activity with the right change control, testing and rollback planning. Maintain backup, restore and disaster-recovery readiness across customer environments.
    • Customer and service improvement
  • Identify practical ways to make customer environments more stable, secure and efficient. Provide clear recommendations that improve service quality and create opportunities for wider optimisation or modernisation.
    • Cross-team delivery
  • Work closely with Service Desk, Cyber Security and project teams to ensure infrastructure changes are supportable from day one. Create useful runbooks, accurate records and effective knowledge transfer rather than documentation for its own sake.

    • The kind of problems you’ll solve
  • A customer’s infrastructure is slowing down, but the cause could sit across compute, storage, networking or cloud services.
  • An Azure or Windows Server environment has grown without enough control, creating performance, cost or security risks.
  • Critical patches must be deployed without disrupting customer operations.
  • Backup jobs appear successful, but recovery readiness has not been properly validated.
  • An Azure Virtual Desktop environment is creating inconsistent performance or user disruption.
  • Storage capacity is approaching its limit, with no clear plan for optimisation or expansion.
  • A recurring incident has been repeatedly fixed but never properly prevented.
  • A newly delivered solution is technically complete but not yet ready to be supported effectively.

    • What sets you apart
  • You look beyond the immediate fault and ask what allowed it to happen.
  • You take ownership through to resolution rather than simply passing problems between teams.
  • You can move between Azure and on-premises environments without treating them as separate worlds.
  • You balance technical quality with customer disruption, commercial reality and operational risk.
  • You communicate technical issues clearly, without unnecessary complexity or ambiguity.
  • You are disciplined around patching, change control, documentation and recovery planning.
  • You are comfortable managing competing priorities across multiple customer environments.
  • You bring credible experience of Windows Server, Azure infrastructure, identity, networking, virtualisation, storage and backup technologies. Azure hybrid certification, particularly AZ-800 and AZ-801, provides a strong foundation for the role.

    • Your impact:

    On the business:

  • You reduce avoidable incidents, repeated support effort and operational risk. By improving infrastructure standards and identifying opportunities for optimisation, you also help strengthen customer retention and support future cloud and transformation work.

    • On customers:

  • Customers gain infrastructure they can rely on: secure, well-maintained and capable of supporting their day-to-day operations. When issues do happen, they receive clear communication, confident ownership and lasting resolution.

    • On team performance:

  • Service Desk receives stronger escalation support, project teams achieve cleaner handovers and Cyber Security gains better operational alignment. The result is a more consistent service, clearer accountability and less time spent solving the same problems repeatedly.

    • What it's like here:
  • Ambitious, but not political
  • High standards, but pragmatic
  • People who care about doing things properly — not just hitting numbers

    • You’ll get:

  • Real ownership of how sales evolves
  • Freedom to change things that don’t work
  • A team open to being challenged and developed
  • Direct access to leadership and influence over direction

    • What you get:
  • Unlimited annual leave
  • Private healthcare, life assurance, company shares
  • Electric car scheme
  • Flexible / remote working (with access to Tunbridge Wells & Paddington)
  • Team and company socials, including Illuminate Awards

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Commodities
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the founding Connected Supply Chain team, you will build and run the core services extending Kpler’s real-time trade intelligence platform beyond marine coverage into North American inland supply chains. Operating on a high-autonomy "you build it, you run it" model, you will carry sensor telemetry from field hardware to paying customers through streaming ingestion pipelines, robust APIs, and user-facing features. By uniting crude pipeline remote sensors, rail, and waterway data with existing maritime tracking, your work will directly deliver a single connected view from production basin to export terminal.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable ingestion and processing pipelines for sensor, rail, and waterway data using Python, Kafka, and Airflow.

  • Develop backend services using FastAPI and contribute to customer-facing web applications using TypeScript and Vue.

  • Implement data validation, system monitoring, and alerting to ensure noisy time-series data from field hardware remains accurate and complete.

  • Operate owned services end-to-end, taking charge of deployments, observability, and participation in the team's on-call rotation.

  • Collaborate closely with data science and sensor operations teams to transform raw telemetry into high-value, usable datasets for early customer adoption.

  • Drive continuous platform health by participating in technical design discussions, improving CI/CD workflows, and delivering tested, well-documented code.


Experience & Background

What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • 2 to 4 years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting production software.

  • Strong proficiency with Python and relational databases (SQL / Postgres).

  • Proven experience deploying, debugging, and operating backend services in cloud environments (AWS preferred).

  • Hands-on exposure to message queues, streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka), and RESTful API development.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a high degree of agency to move from ambiguous requirements to working code.

    • Nice-to-haves

    • Experience with FastAPI, Airflow, TypeScript, Vue, or Elasticsearch.

    • Prior exposure to time-series, IoT, remote sensor, or geospatial datasets.

    • Domain interest in energy, commodities, or logistics supply chains.

We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.
 
We build together
We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.
 
We are here to help
We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.
 
 
Our People Pledge
 
Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Format Foundations
jobs.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening and watching feel effortless, personal, and joyful for hundreds of millions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re seeking a Principal Product Manager to help lead the consumer experience across Spotify’s formats, including books, podcasts, and music. Format Foundations partners with the business teams behind each format to lead innovation in how users discover, engage with, and build lasting relationships with content on Spotify. You’ll set the product vision and strategy for your area and shape feature portfolios across formats. This role sits within Format Foundations in Core Experience, partnering closely with these teams to grow their businesses through product innovation.

 

 


What You'll Do

  • Lead product vision and strategy across Spotify’s formats, shaping how books, podcasts, and music become more engaging, lovable, and valuable for users, creators, and the business.

  • You have 10+ years of experience in product management and have led product work across several consumer media products at scale in large technology companies.

  • You have deep knowledge of the consumer media landscape across areas such as books, podcasts, or music, including competitive dynamics, creator and publisher ecosystems, and user behavior.

  • You have experience building for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user interfaces.

  • You understand how to build scalable systems and experiences that enable teams to move faster.

  • You actively use AI tools in your product development workflow, from research and analysis to iteration and prototyping.

Teamleiter Jahresabschluss / Steuerberater (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Teamleiter Jahresabschluss / Steuerberater (m/w/d)

Standort: Dresden | Voll- oder Teilzeit | Unbefristet

Für unseren Mandanten, eine mittelständische Steuerberatungs- und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft mit Standorten in Dresden, Chemnitz und München, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Teamleiter Jahresabschluss / Steuerberater (m/w/d) am Standort Dresden. Als Teil einer interdisziplinär aufgestellten Beratergruppe begleitet das Unternehmen Unternehmen, Unternehmerfamilien und Privatpersonen in steuerlichen, betriebswirtschaftlichen und prüfungsnahen Fragestellungen. Die Position verbindet fachliche Verantwortung in der Jahresabschlusserstellung mit der Führung und Entwicklung eines eigenen Teams und bietet damit erfahrenen Steuerberatern die Möglichkeit, den nächsten Karriereschritt in Richtung Führung zu gehen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Teamleitung: Fachliche und organisatorische Verantwortung für ein Teilteam von rund 10 Mitarbeitenden innerhalb eines insgesamt etwa 40-köpfigen Teams – mit dem Ziel, eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit und effiziente Abläufe sicherzustellen

  • Jahresabschlüsse & Steuererklärungen: Referenzierung und fachliche Beurteilung von Jahresabschlüssen sowie betrieblichen Steuererklärungen für Mandanten unterschiedlicher Rechtsformen

  • Fachliche Verantwortung: Einordnung komplexer handels- und steuerrechtlicher Sachverhalte sowie Begleitung fachlicher Stellungnahmen und anspruchsvoller Fragestellungen

  • Qualitätssicherung: Sicherstellung einheitlicher fachlicher Qualitätsstandards innerhalb des Teams und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung bestehender Prozesse

  • Mitarbeiterentwicklung: Fachliche Begleitung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeitenden – Wissen vermitteln, Feedback geben und individuelle Entwicklung gezielt unterstützen

  • Führungsverantwortung: Aktive Mitgestaltung der Zusammenarbeit im Bereich Jahresabschluss und Übernahme einer zentralen Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Mitarbeitenden und übergeordneter Leitung

Ihr Profil

  • Fachliche Qualifikation: Erfolgreich abgelegtes Steuerberaterexamen als Grundlage für die fachliche Verantwortung innerhalb des Teams

  • Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Steuerberatung mit fundierter Praxis rund um Jahresabschlüsse, betriebliche Steuererklärungen sowie handels- und steuerrechtliche Fragestellungen

  • Führungskompetenz: Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen oder disziplinarischen Führung von Mitarbeitenden – alternativ die klare Motivation, sich gezielt in eine Führungsrolle weiterzuentwickeln

  • Fachliche Sicherheit: Fundierte handels- und steuerrechtliche Kenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte sicher zu beurteilen und verständlich innerhalb des Teams zu vermitteln

  • Arbeitsweise: Selbstständig, strukturiert und unternehmerisch denkend – verbunden mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch und einem sicheren Blick für Prioritäten

  • Persönlichkeit: Kommunikationsstarke und wertschätzende Führungspersönlichkeit mit Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Mitarbeitende weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsam nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu erzielen

  • Softwarekenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV und MS Office sowie Offenheit gegenüber digitalen Prozessen und modernen Arbeitsweisen

Ihre Vorteile

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Arbeitszeitkonto, bis zu 3 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sowie 30 Urlaubstage

  • Finanzielle Zusatzleistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, 80 % Zuschuss zum Jobticket bzw. Deutschlandticket sowie wahlweise Konsumkarte oder EGYM Wellpass

  • Führungsperspektive: Verantwortungsvolle Position mit eigenem Teilteam und der Möglichkeit, die fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung von rund 10 Mitarbeitenden aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Entwicklung: Strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie bezahlte Weiterbildungen, Qualifizierungen und Schulungen zur gezielten fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung

  • Gesundheit: Gesundheitstag, regenerative Pausen und Lauftraining, Zuschüsse zu Massageangeboten sowie Teilnahme an gemeinsamen Lauf-, Wander- und Volleyballveranstaltungen

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Computertechnik und professionelle IT-Infrastruktur mit direktem Support durch einen hauseigenen IT-Service

  • Verpflegung: Kostenfreies Wasser, Kaffee und Tee sowie regionales und vom Arbeitgeber bezuschusstes Mittagessen

  • Unternehmenskultur: Kollegiale und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit innerhalb einer etablierten Beratergruppe – geprägt von fachlichem Austausch, persönlicher Wertschätzung und regelmäßigen Firmenfeiern und Teamevents

Senior Legal Counsel @ B10
jobs.description:
Oletko erityisesti yritysjärjestelyihin ja yhtiöoikeuteen erikoistunut juristi? Haluatko työskennellä osana kasvavaa ja tiivistä työyhteisöä, jossa jokaisen panos merkitsee ja jossa jatkuva kehittyminen on kulttuurin ytimessä?

Jos vastasit **KYLLÄ**, jatka lukemista, sillä tämä paikka voi olla juuri sinua varten!

**Etsimme nyt** B10:lle yritysjärjestelyihin ja yhtiöoikeuteen erikoistunutta juristia **Senior Legal Counsel** positioon. Tässä tehtävässä liityt osaksi B10 varallisuussuunnittelu & vero- ja lakipalvelut tiimiä. Tehtävässä raportoit vero- ja lakipalvelupartnerille.

**Tehtävä** on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen. B10 toimisto sijaitsee Helsingin keskustassa, Pohjoisesplanadilla ja sinulla on mahdollisuus työskennellä joustavasti myös etänä pari päivää viikossa.

**B10 Family Office** on kokonaisvaltaisen varainhallinnan asiantuntijaorganisaatio, joka on toiminut vuodesta 2012 lähtien Family Office -palvelujen edelläkävijänä Suomessa. B10 palvelee vauraita omistajayrittäjiä, heidän perheitään sekä yksityissijoittajia myös kansainvälisesti, ja kokonaisvaltainen varallisuussuunnittelu sekä pitkäjänteinen arvonluonti ovat toiminnan ytimessä. B10 on kasvanut viime vuosina merkittävästi, ja tänään noin 20 vero-, laki- ja varainhoidon ammattilaista työskentelee yhteisen tavoitteen eteen. B10 on kasvuhakuinen ja vakaasti kannattava organisaatio, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan sekä asiakkaiden että B10:n menestykseen. Lisätietoa löydät **täältä.**

_Tiimissämme on hyvä tekemisen meininki ja me teemme töitä tiiviisti yhdessä. Tähän porukkaan on kiva tulla mukaan. –Jesper Ahlgren, Senior Tax Advisor, Team Lead_

**Tässä avainroolissa** vastaat asiakkaiden yritys- ja omistusrakenteisiin liittyvistä laki- ja veroasioista. Roolissa yhdistyvät juridinen ja verotuksellinen asiantuntemus, strateginen ajattelu sekä mahdollisuus rakentaa pitkäaikaisia ja läheisiä asiakassuhteita. Päivittäisessä työssäsi vastaat omistusrakenteiden suunnittelusta ja yritysjärjestelyiden toteutuksesta, kuten sulautumisista, jakautumisista, liiketoimintasiirroista ja osakevaihdoista. Laadit ja kommentoit sopimuksia, pöytäkirjoja ja muita yhtiöoikeudellisia asiakirjoja sekä kehität omistus- ja verorakenteita asiakkaan pitkän aikavälin tavoitteet huomioiden. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä varallisuussuunnittelun ja varainhoidon asiantuntijoiden kanssa ja hoidat sekä suomalaisia että kansainvälisiä asiakaskokonaisuuksia, mikä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää ja kehittää kansainvälisen verotuksen osaamistasi.

**Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:**

- olet koulutukseltasi OTM ja sinulla on vähintään viiden vuoden relevanttia työkokemusta erityisesti yritysjärjestelyiden, yhtiöoikeuden ja sopimusoikeuden alalta. Aikaisempi työkokemus vero- ja/tai muiden lakiasioiden parista katsotaan eduksi;

- hahmotat hyvin kokonaisuuksia ja osaat soveltaa lainsäädäntöä käytännön liiketoimintatilanteissa; ymmärrät sekä yritys- että henkilöverotuksen peruskysymykset ja pystyt viemään monimutkaisenkin järjestelyn suunnittelusta toteutukseen saakka;

- olet vastuullinen ja nautit sekä itsenäisestä työskentelystä että tiimityöskentelystä. Arvostamme myös yrittäjähenkistä asennetta ja halua kehittää asiakkuuksia;

- sinulla on aitoa kiinnostusta ymmärtää asiakkaan liiketoimintaa ja perheen tilannetta pintaa syvemmältä ja haluat tarjota asiakkaille kestäviä juridisia ratkaisuja; ja

- sinulla on erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot ja kommunikoit sujuvasti sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti suomeksi että englanniksi – ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi.


**B10 tarjoaa sinulle:**

- mahdollisuuden työskennellä Suomen vaativimpien omistajayrittäjäasiakkaiden parissa tiiviissä ja erikoistuneessa asiantuntijaorganisaatiossa;

- henkilökohtaisen urapolun ja työyhteisön, jossa panostetaan sinun ammatilliseen kehitykseesi ja jossa opit tuntemaan asiakkaat ja heidän liiketoimintansa poikkeuksellisen hyvin;

- monipuolisen työnkuvan kansainvälisessä työympäristössä, joka avaa kiinnostavia yhteistyömahdollisuuksia sekä Suomessa että ulkomailla; sekä

- kilpailukykyisen kompensaation, kannustavan bonusjärjestelmän sekä kattavat edut, joista kerromme mielellämme lisää ensimmäisen haastattelun yhteydessä.


**Kiinnostuitko?** Lähetä meille CV:si ja hakukirjeesi hakujärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään **20.10.2026.** Jos haluat jutella positiosta tarkemmin, voit olla yhteydessä Minjonin rekrytoijaan Wilma Tuomiseen torstaista 15.10. eteenpäin (+358 40 515 3834 tai wilma.tuominen@minjon.fi).

jobs.title: Legal Trainees @ Stora Enso
jobs.description:
**Are you a law student who:**

- is eager to gain experience in varying legal tasks in an international environment?

- has previous experience working in a law firm or an in-house legal department?

- is at least halfway through your law studies? If you responded **YES** to all three questions, this position might be for you!


We are looking for **two Legal Trainees** to join **Stora Enso** for a 12-month fixed-term position. The first Legal Trainee term is scheduled to start in January 2027, and the second in September 2027. In your application, please indicate which term you are applying for or which term you would prefer. The position is full-time and based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki. Although this is a full-time role, there's flexibility for you to attend lectures and exams when necessary.

**In your day-to-day work**, you will gain comprehensive insights into different areas of the legal function and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across Stora Enso. You will support legal counsels with a range of day-to-day tasks, including conducting legal research, preparing corporate documents (e.g., AGM materials), and drafting, negotiating, and reviewing agreements (e.g., non-disclosure agreements). You will also work on compliance matters, including policy administration and contributing to AI-related projects.

In this role, you will work directly with internal stakeholders and take ownership of assignments independently, with the support of your colleagues whenever needed. This is an excellent opportunity for a law student to broaden their knowledge and develop practical skills across different areas of law.

Nordic Chem develops professional surface protection technology for the commercial cleaning industry, backed by more than 25 years of expertise in industrial coatings. Our coating, Nordic Chem 2.0, is applied to washrooms, floors, glazing, carpets and external paving. It is purpose-built for commercial cleaning to protect assets, improve standards and make maintaining surfaces faster and easier for cleaning teams.

Our clients include some of the leading names in facilities services and commercial cleaning in the UK. They see Nordic Chem as an operational tool that helps them improve margins, drive revenue and win more tenders.

Nordic Chem won the CBRE Cleaning Innovation Award 2025 and a Green Apple Environment Award, and is in use on more than 500 sites in London, including major airports, commercial office buildings and shopping centres. After several successful years in the UK, we are now expanding in the Nordics, with a growing presence in Sweden, Denmark and Norway to build on and a strong pipeline of opportunities already in place.

The role

We are looking for a Business Developer in Sweden to be the face of a proven product in a new market and help build the Nordic region. You will work closely with our team, with flexible working hours and support from a brand with a growing global footprint and colleagues who want you to succeed.

Pay is commission-based (provisionslön) and uncapped, with commission on new clients and on repeat orders from the clients you bring in. The more clients you build, the more you earn.

    A proven, award-winning product with documented results to use in sales conversations
    Product, market and sales training. No prior knowledge of surface coatings needed
    Sales and demo materials
    Qualified leads from our pipeline

    Prospecting by email, LinkedIn and phone

    On-site demonstrations and site evaluations
    Training clients on how to use the product
    Overseeing coating applications on client sites, and getting hands-on when needed
    Building long-term client relationships that lead to repeat orders
    Sharing market feedback to help shape our approach in the Nordics

Who we think will thrive

    Solution sellers: Curious, confident people who enjoy solving problems and selling
    Hands-on professionals: Happy to demo the product and follow it through to delivery on site
    Relationship builders: Good at turning one job into a long-term client

jobs.title: Fysioterapeut, Vårdverket Vårdcentral & Fysioterapimottagning
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med från början och påverka hur en helt ny vårdcentral och fysioterapimottagning ska byggas upp?

Under hösten 2027 planeras en ny vårdcentral och fysioterapimottagning att öppna i centrala Karlstad, inom Region Värmlands vårdval, Vårdverket Vårdcentral & Fysioterapimottagning. Verksamheten kommer att bedrivas på samma villkor och i samma konkurrensutsatta primärvård som regionens övriga vårdcentraler och fysioterapimottagningar.

Det här är en riktig nystart. Det finns i dagsläget inget färdigt team – i stället söker jag nu de personer som vill vara med och bygga verksamheten från grunden.

Om verksamheten

Bakom satsningen står Marcus Jangsjö, som har startat VV Vårdcentraler AB. Tanken är att bygga ett mindre, engagerat team med korta beslutsvägar och ett nära samarbete mellan medarbetarna.

Det finns en tydlig ambition och riktning, men mycket kommer att utarbetas tillsammans med de personer som kliver in tidigt i verksamheten.

Ambitionen är att skapa en vårdenhet med hög medicinsk kvalitet, god kontinuitet och hög tillgänglighet, där moderna arbetssätt och digitala verktyg används när de skapar verklig nytta.

Fysioterapin kommer att vara en viktig del av verksamheten från start och ha en nära samverkan med vårdcentralen. Målet är att skapa ett arbetssätt där patienten får tillgång till rätt kompetens på ett smidigt sätt och där olika professioner samarbetar kring patientens behov.

Din roll

Jag söker nu en fysioterapeut som vill bli en viktig del av den nya verksamheten. Du kommer in tidigt i uppbyggnaden och får därför stora möjligheter att påverka hur vårdenheten ska utformas – från arbetssätt och patientflöden till samverkan med övriga professioner.

Jag söker dig som vill ha en aktiv roll i att forma en ny verksamhet och som uppskattar korta beslutsvägar, nära samarbete och möjligheten att påverka. Du är engagerad, lösningsorienterad och kvalitetsmedveten och vill vara med och skapa en verksamhet med hög kvalitet och en god arbetsmiljö.

Erfarenhet från primärvård är ett krav och det är viktigt att du vill vara med och utveckla verksamheten från grunden.

Intervjuer sker löpande tills tjänsterna är tillsatta.

Jag ser fram emot din ansökan!

jobs.title: Ethics & Compliance Counsel @ Stora Enso
jobs.description:
**Hey Ethics & Compliance professional!**

Are you looking for a diverse role in ethics and compliance within a listed company? Would you be excited to join a team where your work helps build a more sustainable future?

If you are thinking **YES**, please keep reading because we are now looking for **a Legal Counsel, Ethics & Compliance** to join **Stora Enso's Ethics and Compliance Team**!

**In this role**, as a member of the Ethics and Compliance team, you will work with assignments on group level, and, at the same time, serve as the dedicated Ethics and Compliance resource for one or several of Stora Enso's Business Areas. More specifically, you will:

- Serve as the dedicated E&C resource for assigned Business Area(s), providing proactive and reactive legal support including risk assessments, policy interpretation, and compliance investigations

- Monitor relevant regulatory developments in Finland and across the EU, covering anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations

- Draft, update, and implement E&C policies and guidelines, ensuring consistent understanding and application across the organisation

- Develop and deliver E&C training and awareness initiatives, both in person, online and through e-learning programmes

- Contribute as an integrated member of the Group E&C team, taking ownership of group-level projects and supporting the Chief Compliance Officer as needed


Together with your team, you will also attempt to manage information in digital form by using AI, and thus continuously work towards making the routines more efficient and better.

**The Ethics and Compliance team** consists of 6 professionals in several global locations. The team is spread across multiple locations but operates as a genuinely close-knit group, with strong connections and active day-to-day collaboration across geographies. Team members support one another and are encouraged to challenge each other constructively. This is a team where you are expected to contribute, grow, and be heard - ambition is welcomed, and opportunities for development are real.

The position is based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki, but the position also involves occasional, pre-planned travel, mostly within Europe. You will report to the Chief Compliance Officer, who is based in Sweden.

**This position is a great fit for a candidate who has:**

- a Finnish law degree or other education and experience the employer deems relevant for this position;

- at least five years of relevant experience in ethics and compliance in an international environment, whether in-house or at a law firm;

- a strong knowledge of competition law, anti-corruption, trade sanctions, grievance handling and investigations, as well as business ethics and corporate values more broadly;

- a good understanding of the fast-moving regulatory landscape relevant to corporate ethics and compliance, including developments at both the Finnish and EU levels, particularly in the areas of anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations;

- project management experience and experience of rolling out cross-functional programmes in international organisations;

- proven integrity and high ethical standards as well as a strong drive to get things done and the ability to perform well under pressure and meet tight deadlines;

- strong interpersonal skills and a team player mindset; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required. Additional language skills, such as Swedish, German, Polish, Dutch or Chinese, are considered an advantage.


**What Stora Enso offers you:**

**A place for professional growth:** Stora Enso's innovative and high-speed environment offers you an opportunity to constantly develop professionally at all stages of your career.

**A diverse working culture:** You get to be part of highly skilled team within an international corporation where everyone is treated fairly and with respect.

**A commitment to sustainability:** Sustainability is at the core of Stora Enso's everyday activities, reflecting a strong commitment to compliance and doing things the right way.

**Benefits to support your well-being:** Besides industry-standard salary, you will receive a wide scale of benefits to support your health and well-being – of which we are happy to tell you more in our conversations.

_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. They believe that everything that is made from fossil-based materials today can be made from a tree tomorrow. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees and their sales in 2025 were EUR 9.3 billion. Stora Enso shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Oy (STEAV, STERV) and Nasdaq Stockholm AB (STE A, STE R). In addition, the shares are traded in the USA as ADRs (SEOAY)._

jobs.title: Söderköpings kommun rekryterar Samhällsbyggnadschef
jobs.description:
För dig som motiveras av att kombinera strategiskt ledarskap med samhällsutveckling erbjuder Söderköpings kommun en möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad och bidra till att forma framtidens kommun! I Söderköpings kommun vill vi skapa livsglädje. Alla dagar. Det är vår vision och något vi strävar efter. Här erbjuds du möjligheter och utmaningar i en attraktiv, mindre kommun, strategiskt belägen med närhet till universitetsstäderna Norrköping och Linköping. Delaktighet och närhet till beslut ger stora möjligheter till yrkesmässig och personlig utveckling. Tillsammans skapar ca 1 100 medarbetare en attraktiv arbetsplats, där vi bidrar till ett fortsatt växande Söderköping. Vår värdegrund: helhetssyn, nytänkande, engagemang och tydlighet visar hur vi som organisation vill vara och uppfattas. Välkommen att skapa framtiden tillsammans med oss!

Om rollen:

Söderköpings kommun befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsfas där samhällsbyggnadsfrågorna spelar en avgörande roll för kommunens framtida tillväxt, attraktivitet och hållbara utveckling. Vi söker nu en erfaren och strategiskt orienterad Samhällsbyggnadschef som vill leda och utveckla verksamheten i en kommun med höga ambitioner och stark framtidstro.

Som Samhällsbyggnadschef har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamhetsområdet och leder en organisation som omfattar enheterna Strategi och Planering samt Miljö och Bygglov. Till din ledningsorganisation rapporterar två enhetschefer med ansvar för respektive verksamhetsområde. Utöver det har du 6 direktunderställda medarbetare som arbetar med verksamhetsstöd. Rollen innefattar fullt verksamhets-, budget- och personalansvar samt ett övergripande ansvar för att leda, utveckla och samordna kommunens samhällsbyggnadsfrågor.

Du rapporterar till kommundirektören och ingår i kommunens ledningsgrupp där du bidrar aktivt till kommunens samlade utvecklingsarbete. Uppdraget präglas av ett långsiktigt och strategiskt perspektiv med fokus på samhällsplanering, infrastruktur, hållbar utveckling och tillväxt. Du har en central roll i kommunens fortsatta utveckling och förväntas aktivt bidra till arbetet med en hållbar samhällsutveckling, både stadsutveckling och utveckling av större infrastrukturprojekt.

Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och ett nära samspel med politisk ledning, kommunens verksamheter, medborgare, näringsliv och regionala aktörer. Söderköping värnar om god samverkan med kringliggande kommuner. Genom samverkan skapas förutsättningar för erfarenhetsutbyte, effektiv resursanvändning och utveckling av gemensamma strategiska frågor som stärker kommunens långsiktiga utveckling. Inom samhällsbyggnadsområdet finns redan idag ett långtgående samarbete med Valdemarsviks kommun som kan utvecklas ytterligare.

Placering: Söderköping

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har relevant akademisk utbildning eller annan erfarenhet vi bedömer likvärdig. Du har flerårig erfarenhet av strategiskt ledarskap, flerårig erfarenhet av arbete med samhällsbyggnadsfrågor och är väl insatt i de lagar och regelverk som reglerar området. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att leda genom andra chefer samt erfarenhet av systemledning, där du framgångsrikt har arbetat med att skapa riktning, samordning och styrning i komplexa organisationer. Erfarenhet från kommunal verksamhet eller annan politiskt styrd organisation är meriterande. Det är också meriterande om du har drivit förändrings- och utvecklingsarbete.

Vi söker dig som är en trygg och engagerande ledare med god kommunikativ förmåga och som skapar starka samarbeten. Du har ett strategiskt helhetsperspektiv, är lösningsorienterad och driver utveckling med fokus på resultat och långsiktig hållbarhet. Du arbetar strukturerat, prioriterar väl och skapar förutsättningar för verksamheten att nå sina mål. Med hög integritet och professionalism fattar du välgrundade beslut och bygger förtroende i ditt ledarskap.

Befattningen är inplacerad i säkerhetsklass, varpå en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kommer att genomföras före beslut om anställning.

Kontakt

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Söderköpings kommun med Jeffersonwells. Vi tar inte emot ansökan på mail pga av GDPR. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Therese Fyhr, 011-191898, Therese.fyhr@jeffersonwells.se.

Fackliga kontakter:

Vision: Li Sjöstrand; li.sjostrand@fv.vision.se



På Manpower, Experis och Jefferson Wells värnar vi om en trygg och transparent rekryteringsprocess. Vi kommer aldrig att be dig om betalning, bankuppgifter eller annan känslig personlig information i samband med en jobbansökan eller rekrytering. Om du får misstänkta meddelanden som sägs komma från oss ber vi dig att kontakta oss på contactcenter@manpower.se.
