jobs.title: Expansion Manager Sweden
jobs.description:
Loxone is opening up the Swedish market - and we are looking for the person who will make it happen. This is not a typical sales job. This is a leadership development track: you start with 12-24 months of full immersion at our HQ in Kollerschlag, Austria, learning our products, our sales method, and our way of thinking from the inside out. Then you move to Sweden and take ownership of the market you helped build. The long-term destination of this role is Country Manager Sweden. If a full relocation to Austria for a year or two sounds like the opportunity you've been waiting for - not a hurdle - keep reading. We are looking for builders, not maintainers: someone who wants to dig deep into the Loxone Way of Selling, learn every layer of our business from the ground up, and then build the Swedish market from scratch - with real autonomy, real ownership, and a real path to running the country. So if you have a technical background with motivation for sales - you are the right person for this oppertunity. Your tasks:

     Own outbound lead development for the Swedish market - calls, emails, follow-ups, pipeline building.
     Build and grow relationships with electricians and system integrators across Sweden.
     Deliver 1-hour planning sessions to Partners - start as observer, grow into full delivery.
     Handle technical questions from prospects and Partners with increasing depth over time.
     Take full ownership of the Swedish lead pipeline and Partner network as you grow into the role.
     Deepen your project-planning, product, and programming skills step by step.
     Set and hit concrete partner-growth and revenue KPIs - the foundation for the Country Manager conversation.
     Represent Loxone Sweden internally at HQ and externally with customers, Partners, and industry contacts.

Your profile:

     Native or fully fluent Swedish, plus fluent spoken and written English (Loxone's international working language).
     Willing and excited to relocate to Kollerschlag, Austria for 12-24 months. No hybrid, no partial. Full immersion is the model - and if it doesn't feel like an adventure, this role isn't for you.
     Comfortable with daily outbound calling and B2B sales.
     Technically curious - an electrical, automation, IT, or building-technology background is a strong plus.
     Self-driven - you deliver with limited supervision and don't wait to be told what's next.
     Genuinely aiming for a leadership / ownership track. This role is a launchpad, not a plateau.
     Growth mindset - you want to be shaped by the way we do things, not just fit in and coast.
     Flexible, agile, organized - cross-country moves and international teamwork energize you.
     A background in marketing, IT sales, or B2B business development is a plus; a real hunger to learn the Loxone business end-to-end is essential.

Onboarding & Work Setup:

     Full-time, office-based role - no remote, no hybrid.
     First 12-24 months at Loxone HQ in Kollerschlag, Austria (full relocation required). This is where you learn the system, the sales method, and the business inside out.
     Followed by relocation to Sweden - Stockholm or another Swedish city, depending on how the market develops.
     Loxone supports the relocation logistics on both ends.

jobs.title: Aarre Avustajat - Henkilökohtainen avustaja - Keski-Uusimaa
jobs.description:
Etsitkö mukavaa ja joustavaa palkkatyötä ilman koulutus- tai tutkintovaatimusta? Haluatko itse vaikuttaa omaan työmäärääsi sekä siihen, missä ja milloin työskentelet? Koetko muiden ihmisten auttamisen tärkeäksi ja haluat tehdä työtä, josta jää hyvä mieli?

Mikäli vastasit yllä oleviin kysymyksiin kyllä, suosittelemme sinulle henkilökohtaisen avustajan töitä Aarre Avustajilla. Alta löydät lisätietoja Aarre Avustajista ja henkilökohtaisen avustajan työstä sekä linkin työnhakulomakkeeseen, jonka kautta voit hakea meille helposti töihin ilman erillistä CV:tä. Otathan rohkeasti yhteyttä, mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää!

Helposti täytettävän työnhakulomakkeen löydät tästä linkistä: https://www.tuntinetti.fi/AarreAvustajatHakulomake.html

TÖITÄ TARJOLLA HENKILÖKOHTAISENA AVUSTAJANA
Etsimme nyt asiakkaillemme uusia henkilökohtaisia avustajia tärkeään, mutta joustavaan avustustyöhön. Työ on palkkatyötä yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja sopii niin kokopäiväistä, osa-aikaista, satunnaista kuin keikkatyötäkin etsivälle hyvälle tyypille. Henkilökohtaisena avustajana saat itse määritellä, kuinka paljon ja milloin työskentelet, joten avustajan työ sopii myös toisen työn tai opiskelun ohelle. Sinulla ei tarvitse olla erityistä koulutusta avustajan työhön, vaan oikea asenne ja luotettavuus ovat tärkeimmät ominaisuudet erinomaiselle henkilökohtaiselle avustajalle. Aarre Avustajilla saat jatkuvan tuen ja ohjauksen omalta toimihenkilöltäsi, etkä jää koskaan asioittesi tai kysymyksiesi kanssa yksin, sen lupaamme.

MITÄ HENKILÖKOHTAINEN APU ON JA MITÄ AVUSTAJA TEKEE?
Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, jossa henkilökohtainen avustaja toimii asiakkaan käsinä ja jalkoina toteuttaen niitä toimia, jotka asiakas tekisi itse, mutta ei niistä vamman tai sairauden vuoksi selviä yksin. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on auttaa asiakasta jokapäiväisissä arjen tehtävissä niin kotona kuin myös kodin ulkopuolella.

Avustustehtävät ovat usein tavallisia arkisia askareita, joita me kaikki toteutamme myös omassa arjessamme. Avustajan työhön ei siten sisälly tehtäviä, jotka vaativat erillistä, esimerkiksi lähihoitajan tutkintoa, vaan kuka tahansa voi toimia avustajana. Avustustehtäviä ovat esimerkiksi asiakkaan avustaminen kaupassa käynnissä, ulkoilussa, ruokailussa tai ruoanlaitossa, pukeutumisessa, harrastuksissa tai kodinhoidossa.

MILLAINEN HENKILÖ SOPII AVUSTAJAKSI?
Voimme useiden satojen henkilökohtaisten avustajien työnantajana todeta, että henkilökohtaisiksi avustajiksi sopivat parhaiten henkilöt, joilla on oikea asenne tärkeää avustamistyötä kohtaan. Avustajan on hyvä olla luotettava, positiivinen, avulias, ahkera ja ihmisläheinen henkilö.

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla aikaisempaa vastaavaa työkokemusta, sillä jokainen uusi avustaja perehdytetään kattavalla perehdytyksellä Aarre Avustajien omassa Aarre Akatemiassa ennen työn aloittamista. Avustamis- ja hoiva-alan kokemuksesta tai koulutuksesta voi kuitenkin olla hyötyä joidenkin asiakkaiden kohdalla.

MILLAISIA TYÖVUOROJA ON TARJOLLA JA VOINKO ITSE VAIKUTTAA NIIHIN?
Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, joka tapahtuu niin arkisin kuin myös viikonloppuisin ja mahdollisia työvuoroja on usein tarjolla aamusta iltaan. Aarre Avustajilla voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, miten paljon ja milloin haluat työskennellä sekä millaiselle asiakkaalle. Pyrimme yhdistämään asiakkaidemme avustajatarpeet ja avustajiemme työtoiveet niin, että ne sopivat kaikille. Saat aina tavata mahdollisen uuden asiakkaan ennen asiakassuhteen aloittamista, ja mikäli koet, että jokin asia ei toimi niin kuin ajattelit, voimme yhdessä etsiä sinulle sopivan vaihtoehdon. Meillä voit tehdä halutessasi avustajan töitä niin monelle asiakkaalle kuin itse haluat.

HAKEMINEN
Rekrytointimme on jatkuvaa, joten täytäthän työnhakulomakkeen tarkasti. Muista lisätä työnhakulomakkeeseen kaikki sinulle sopivat kunnat, joissa voit työskennellä, niin osaamme olla sinuun yhteydessä heti, kun löydämme sinulle sopivan asiakkaan. Työnhakulomakkeen täyttäminen ei vielä sido sinua mihinkään.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

jobs.title: Senior Credit Risk Business Analyst

Develop, maintain, and support the operation of credit risk models in accordance with business and regulatory requirements.

    

Create and maintain process descriptions, functional documentation, and other governance-related artefacts.

    

Assess the impact of new or changed system functionality on credit risk processes, models, and reporting.

    

Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, risk specialists, and IT teams to ensure successful delivery of initiatives.

Strong communication skills and the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.

Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to share knowledge and collaborate across functions.

jobs.title: Behandlingspedagog/socialpedagog till mindre HVB för barn 9-13 år – 100 %
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta nära barn och vara med och skapa trygghet, utveckling och positiva förändringar i deras vardag?

HVB Altero är ett mindre och familjelikt HVB med 5 platser för barn i åldern 9–13 år. Barnen som bor hos oss kan ha neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar, trauma, utagerande beteende och andra komplexa behov.

Vi arbetar i en strukturerad och naturnära miljö där relation, trygghet och förutsägbarhet är viktiga delar av vardagen. Vår målsättning är att varje barn ska få möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter och strategier som gör vardagen mer begriplig, hanterbar och meningsfull.

Nu söker vi en behandlingspedagog/socialpedagog på 100 % som vill bli en del av vårt team.

Om arbetet

Som behandlingspedagog/socialpedagog blir du en viktig person i barnens vardag. Arbetet handlar om att skapa trygga relationer samtidigt som du bidrar med struktur, tydlighet och ett professionellt bemötande.

I arbetet ingår bland annat att:

    skapa trygghet, struktur och förutsägbarhet
    arbeta relationsskapande och motiverande
    stödja barnen i att utveckla sociala och praktiska färdigheter
    planera och genomföra aktiviteter och meningsfull fritid
    arbeta utifrån barnens individuella behov och genomförandeplaner
    dokumentera och följa upp arbetet
    samarbeta med kollegor och andra viktiga personer runt barnet.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är trygg, stabil, engagerad och relationsskapande. Du behöver kunna behålla lugnet i utmanande situationer och samtidigt vara nyfiken på vad som ligger bakom ett barns beteende.

Vi uppskattar att du är:

    tålmodig och uthållig
    lekfull och engagerad
    tydlig och strukturerad
    flexibel i ditt bemötande
    bra på att samarbeta
    öppen för återkoppling och reflektion kring ditt eget arbetssätt.

Du är utbildad behandlingspedagog, socialpedagog, socionom eller har annan relevant eftergymnasial utbildning.

Erfarenhet från HVB samt arbete med barn och unga med NPF, trauma eller utagerande beteende är meriterande.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Att arbeta på Altero

Altero är en liten verksamhet. Det ger möjlighet att arbeta nära barnen och vara en del av en mindre personalgrupp där samarbete och delaktighet är viktigt.

Vi vill skapa en arbetsplats där medarbetare får möjlighet att utvecklas, ta ansvar och bidra till utvecklingen av verksamheten. Vi arbetar därför aktivt med kompetensutveckling, reflektion och utveckling av våra gemensamma arbetssätt.

Om tjänsten

Omfattning: 100 %

Arbetstid: Dag, kväll, helg och sovande jour

Anställningsform: Inledningsvis 6 månader med möjlighet till tillsvidareanställning

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

För arbete på HVB som tar emot barn krävs registerkontroll. Den som erbjuds anställning behöver därför visa utdrag ur belastnings- och misstanke register avsett för arbete på HVB.

Ansökan

Vi genomför urval och intervjuer löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan till HVB Altero!

jobs.title: Expert AI Specialist to Service Fulfilment & Operations

jobs.description:
Job ID: 6566

Welcome to Group Technology, where we engineer solutions that support Nordea's transformation and enable the Customer Vision and Business Strategy. As part of Nordea's 2030 strategic direction, we are modernizing our technology and data estate while accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled capabilities across the bank.

We are now looking for Expert AI Specialists to join our team. In this role, you will take technical ownership of reliable, secure and scalable AI-enabled platforms and applications. You will shape solution choices, build production-grade AI infrastructure and workflows, and guide teams in adopting AI responsibly in line with Nordea standards.

About our team

The team works closely with product owners, engineers, architects, cybersecurity, data governance and cloud platform teams to ensure our solutions are pragmatic, compliant and production-ready. You will bring deep hands-on engineering expertise, challenge and improve technical approaches, and communicate complex platform decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also support colleagues through practical guidance and help raise engineering standards across the wider organisation.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Take technical ownership of reliable, secure and scalable cloud and AI-enabled services, including participation in the 24/7 on-call rotation for business-critical applications
    Define and improve observability and operational practices across logging, monitoring, alerting, SLOs, incident response, resilience, cost control and production readiness, with a particular focus on Google Cloud
    Design and implement AI-enabled environments, including agentic AI solutions, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agents and end-to-end AI workflows
    Translate business and operational needs into sustainable technical solutions, identifying dependencies, risks and opportunities for improvement
    Provide expert guidance to users and engineering teams, resolve complex platform issues and support effective adoption of environments and tools
    Own the implementation and lifecycle of development, test and production platforms, ensuring stable, high-performing and maintainable solutions
    Drive technical decisions based on evidence, platform knowledge and long-term value, and align choices with architecture, security and governance requirements
    Act as an experienced technical partner who shares knowledge, reviews solutions and helps raise engineering quality across the team

This is a full-time permanent position with a hybrid working arrangement - up to 40% remote work is possible. We expect to hire in one of these cities: Gdańsk or Gdynia, Warsaw, Helsinki, Stockholm or Copenhagen.

Who you are

Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) mindset:

    Builds reliability into services from the start instead of reacting only after issues occur
    Uses monitoring, service-level objectives, and operational data to understand system performance
    Automates repetitive operational work and reduces unnecessary manual effort
    Designs systems to fail safely, recover quickly, and remain manageable in production
    Learns from incidents through root-cause analysis and blameless reviews, turning findings into practical improvements
    Balances delivery speed with stability, security, and responsible risk management

Your background and skills include:

    7 years of relevant experience in IT operations, site reliability engineering, platform engineering or cloud infrastructure, with a track record of owning complex production environments
    Strong DevOps and operations expertise across support, maintenance, deployment, automation and platform administration
    Deep experience with cloud operations in Google Cloud; knowledge of AWS or Azure is an advantage
    Advanced troubleshooting skills, including the ability to interpret logs, metrics and traces and resolve complex application and infrastructure issues
    Strong practical knowledge of Linux/Unix environments
    Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible and Git-based repository management
    Experience designing, integrating or operating AI-enabled solutions, such as generative AI services, agentic workflows or retrieval-augmented generation
    The judgement to make sound technical decisions in a regulated environment, balancing innovation with security, resilience, governance and maintainability
    A lead-by-doing approach: you combine deep technical expertise with hands-on delivery, practical guidance and a willingness to share knowledge
    Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in written and spoken English

It would be ideal if you also if you have any of the following:

    Have designed or implemented AI workflows and can demonstrate how you have moved AI use cases from experimentation towards reliable production use
    Have worked in a 24/7 operational environment and are comfortable joining an on-call rotation during normal working hours and, at minimum, one week every two months
    Have led the resolution of complex incidents, including root-cause analysis, change implementation and communication with customers and stakeholders
    Have experience releasing and operating new applications or platform capabilities used by internal or external customers
    Have contributed to technical standards, architecture decisions, code or solution reviews, or mentoring within an engineering community

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

jobs.title: Tiltaksarbeider, VR-Barneverntjeneste
jobs.description:
Værnesregionen barneverntjeneste omfatter kommunene Frosta, Meråker, Selbu, Tydal og Stjørdal.  Barneverntjenesten er en del av Sektor forebygging og mestring. Sektor forebygging og mestring er en av seks sektorer innenfor velferdsområdet, dvs. tidligere oppvekst- og omsorgsetater. 

VR-Barneverntjeneste er delt inn i følgende team; mottak, barneteam (undersøkelse og tiltak), ungdomsteam (undersøkelse og tiltak), omsorgsteam, barnevernvakta m/tilleggstjenester, tiltaksteam og administrativt team. 

Ved Værnesregionen barneverntjeneste er det ledig 100 % fast stilling som tiltaksarbeider.

Stillingen er for tiden tilknyttet vårt tiltaksteam.
Vi søker en medarbeider med kompetanse innen familieveiledning, miljøterapeutisk arbeid eller annet relevant oppfølgings- og endringsarbeid rettet mot barn, unge og familier.

Arbeidsoppgaver og ansvar

  • Gi oppfølging og veiledning til barn, unge og familier som mottar hjelpetiltak fra barneverntjenesten
  • Gjennomføre endrings- og utviklingsarbeid sammen med familier i tråd med vedtatte tiltak
  • Samtaler med barn, unge og foreldre
  • Bidra til å fremme barns medvirkning og involvering i eget hjelpetiltak
  • Observasjon, veiledning og praktisk oppfølging i familiens hverdagsarenaer
  • Delta i samarbeidsmøter rundt barn og familier
  • Samarbeide med familiens nettverk og aktuelle samarbeidspartnere
  • Dokumentere og evaluere tiltaksarbeid i henhold til faglige og juridiske krav
  • Delta i teammøter, fagutvikling og tjenestens utviklingsarbeid
  • Bidra aktivt til et trygt og positivt arbeidsmiljø
  • Noe arbeid på ettermiddag og kveldstid må påregnes

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Bachelor i barnevern, sosialt arbeid eller annen relevant høyskoleutdanning
  • Videreutdanning innen familieveiledning, relasjonsarbeid, miljøterapeutisk arbeid eller lignende er ønskelig
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med barn, ungdom og familier er en fordel
  • Kompetanse innen veiledning, endringsarbeid eller miljøterapeutisk oppfølging er ønskelig
  • God forståelse for barns utvikling og behov
  • Kompetanse i samtaler med barn og unge er ønskelig
  • Erfaring med tverrfaglig samarbeid og nettverksarbeid er en fordel
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne
  • Førerkort klasse B

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du har god relasjonskompetanse og evne til å skape tillit hos barn, unge og foreldre
  • Du er faglig trygg og bevisst på etiske problemstillinger
  • Du arbeider målrettet, selvstendig og strukturert
  • Du har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner
  • Du er fleksibel og trives med varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Du evner å stå i krevende situasjoner og samtidig bevare ro og profesjonalitet
  • Du bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet og spiller kollegaene dine gode
  • Du er engasjert i barnevernsfaget og ønsker å bidra til videre utvikling av tjenesten
  • Det vil bli lagt avgjørende vekt på personlig egnethet.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Faglig dyktige og engasjerte kollegaer 
  • Faglig og personlig utvikling 
  • Fleksibel arbeidstidsordning, noe ettermiddags-/kveldsarbeid må påregnes 
  • Utfordrende og meningsfylte oppgaver 
  • Et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø
  • Lønns- og arbeidsvilkår etter gjeldende avtaleverk
  • God pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Andre opplysninger:

For disse stillingene kreves det, i henhold til gjeldende lovverk, tilfredsstillende politiattest.

I samsvar med offentlighetsloven § 25 gjør vi oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkere kan offentliggjøres, selv om det er bedt om konfidensiell behandling. Søkere vil i tilfelle bli forhåndsvarslet om dette.

Stjørdal kommune ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold, og at våre ansatte skal gjenspeile befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn eller minoritetsbakgrunn.

Ønskelig med tiltredelse fra 04.01.27


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Værnesregionen er et godt etablert samarbeid om en rekke kommunale tjenester mellom de seks kommunene Tydal, Selbu, Malvik, Frosta, Meråker og Stjørdal. Værnes i Stjørdal kommune er det geografiske knutepunktet i regionen. Tjenestetilbudet i kommunene er godt, og avstanden mellom det urbane og det landlige er relativt kort innenfor regionen. Slagordet til Værnesregionen er "Fra fjord til fjell" - som er akkurat det de seks kommunene kan by på.

jobs.title: Tilkallingsvikarer barnevernsvakta
jobs.description:
Ved barneverntjenesten i Værnesregionen - Barnevernvakta, har vi  behov for flere dyktige og fleksible tilkallingsvikarer. Arbeidstid kan være på dagtid, kveldstid og i helger.

Værnesregionen barneverntjeneste omfatter kommunene Frosta, Meråker, Selbu, Tydal og Stjørdal.  Barneverntjenesten er en del av Sektor forebygging og mestring. Sektor forebygging og mestring er en av seks sektorer innenfor velferdsområdet, dvs. tidligere oppvekst- og omsorgsetater. 

VR-Barneverntjeneste er delt inn i følgende team; mottak, barneteam (undersøkelse og tiltak), ungdomsteam (undersøkelse og tiltak), omsorgsteam, barnevernvakta m/tilleggstjenester, tiltaksteam og administrativt team. Barnevernvakta skal ivareta akuttberedskap utenfor ordinær arbeidstid, starte eller overta saker og arbeidsoppgaver som øvrige team i barneverntjenesten følger opp, og tilby nye tjenestetilbud som ambulerende team for barn og ungdom, tilsyn i hjemmet og tilsyn ved samvær.

  • Håndtere akutte henvendelser og situasjoner knyttet til barn og familier i krise på kveld, natt og helg.

jobs.title: PhD position in Smart Ocean Observations and Drift Modelling for Marine Applications
jobs.description:
About us and the project

The Division for Oceanography and Maritime Meteorology (OM) at the Norwegian Meteorological Institute (MET Norway) in Bergen, Norway, is announcing a four-year PhD position in Smart Ocean Observations and Drift Modelling for Marine Applications

About us

The Norwegian Meteorological Institute forecasts the weather, monitors the climate, and conducts research. Since its establishment in 1866, Norwegian meteorologists have played a central role in the development of the field. Today, the institute is a leading international center of expertise. Our ability to communicate weather and climate information to different user groups results from the work of various professional groups within the institute. Collecting weather data and managing and efficiently analyzing large datasets are crucial for performing these tasks. Equally important is understanding how to present this information so that users can benefit from it. The institute develops and provides a wide range of useful services. We conduct extensive research and deliver climate data that can be used, among other things, to help society adapt to future climate conditions. We have a free and open data policy, meaning that anyone can use our data freely for the benefit of society. A common goal across all our work is to help safeguard lives and property. At the OM division in Bergen, maritime safety is a key focus guiding our activities. We are responsible for developing wave forecasting services and operational emergency models that simulate drift at sea (e.g., oil spills, vessels, and search-and-rescue objects). In recent years, we have invested significant resources in developing the new climate archive NORA3. We are also responsible for making meteorological and oceanographic (metocean) data available to public agencies, the offshore industry, and the offshore wind sector. These analyses involve extracting historical climate data on wind, waves, and sometimes currents, with the aim of providing an overview of average conditions and extreme values for specific locations or larger geographical areas. 

About the project

The position is part of the EU Horizon project EU-FUSION and the WaveForce project funded by Norwegian Research Council. The EU-FUSION aims to develop a Digital Twin Ocean (DTO) by integrating ocean, coastal, ecological, and socio-economic models into a modular and interoperable framework. The WaveForce project aims to improve the state of the art of oil spill models through a coordinated programme of research, technology development, lab and field work. The position also includes 25% duty work related to operational/research activities at MET Norway, including metocean studies, development of data processing workflows, and software tools.


About the position

The work will include:

  • Development of small directional buoys with telemetry for coastal applications in areas of intense wave-current interaction.
  • Develop the drift modelling framework, OpenDrift, to integrate observational data into drift simulations using Machine Learning (ML) techniques
  • Extending buoys with acoustic sensors
  • Field work at sea and along the coast
  • Contributing to the integration of developed tools and datasets into the European Digital Twin of the Ocean (EDITO) platform 
  • Supporting the development of visualization tools and open-access datasets
  • Collaborating with international partners and stakeholders to improve ocean monitoring and prediction systems

Qualifications and expected skills
  • The applicant must have obtained an MSc or similar in data science, computer science, physics, applied mathematics, oceanography, meteorology, or a similar field.
  • The applicant must satisfy the requirements for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Science and Technology, University of Bergen, Norway (average grade: C or better).
  • The candidate must be able to work effectively in English and demonstrate fluency, both written and oral. The working language at MET Norway is Norwegian. Foreign candidates must be willing to learn basic Norwegian.
  • Experience with programming in Python is required.
  • Experience with machine learning is an advantage.
  • Experience in embedded-systems programming and electrical engineering or similar is an advantage.
  • Experience with signal processing, Fourier analysis and acoustic modeling and analysis is an advantage.
  • Experience in field work or similar work is an advantage. 
  • Experience with git version control is an advantage.
  • The applicant should be independent and enjoy teaming up to reach common goals. 

Personal characteristics will be of importance, as well as ambition level and potential. The candidate must expect some traveling to present results at conferences, meetings, and research visits abroad of up to six months. Employment is contingent on the candidate meeting the academic requirements of the University of Bergen for enrolment in their PhD programme. The successful applicant will be enrolled at the Geophysical Institute at the University of Bergen and will be situated on the university campus.


We offer
  • Salary as a PhD research fellow (code 1017). This constitutes a gross annual salary span from NOK 575 000,- to NOK 650 000,-. Further salary increases are made according to length of service in the position.
  • Flexible working hours with summer time.
  • Possibility of one hour of training during working hours per week.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse (SPK) with good schemes for pensions, insurances and mortgages (read more here: https://www.spk.no/Medlemskap-i-SPK/). A 2% statutory contribution to the Statens Pensjonskasse is deducted from the salary.
  • Insurance and mortgage through SPK.
  • A pleasant working environment in a dynamic and enthusiastic group.
  • The first six months are a mutual trial period.

Diversity and positive action

We believe that diversity is a strength, and want employees with different skills, subject combinations, work experience, gender, life experience and perspectives. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply for a job with us regardless of ethnic background, age or ability.

MET practice positive action, and will call at least one qualified applicant in each of these groups for an interview: applicants with a disability, immigrant background or gaps in the CV. To be considered in one or more of these categories, you must mark the appropriate category in your application.

Functional impairment: applicants who need accommodation in the workplace or in the working relationship.

Immigrant background: applicants who have themselves immigrated to Norway. Or who was born in Norway with two parents who both immigrated to Norway.

Gaps in CV: applicants who have had a break from work, education or training for a total of at least two years in the last five years due to e.g. physical or mental illness or injury, intoxication or punishment.

The ticks can be used for anonymised statistics or reporting purposes.

Publication of applicant lists for public sector positions is an important principle to ensure transparency. If you want your name to be excluded from the applicant list, you must ask for it yourself, and give us a reason. In order to be exempted from the public applicant list, your justification for exemption must outweigh the consideration of transparency in the applicant list. If your request is not accepted, you will have the opportunity to withdraw your application.


The application

The application must be submitted electronically via Jobbnorge.no. Please attach CV, motivation letter, original and translated diplomas and transcripts of record in English or a Scandinavian language, list of publications (if relevant), and the names of two references.

Attach certificates and all pages of diplomas. The documents must be in Norwegian, a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized. Before any employment, we will check the documents. In the case of foreign education, we ask that you attach an explanation of the grading system.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Norwegian Meteorological Institute forecasts the weather, monitors the climate and conducts socially critical research. We have provided critical meteorological services to the Norwegian society for over 150 years. We ensure that rescue helicopters arrive safely, and that the emergency services are prepared for extreme weather and other dangerous weather. Our special services are used in the event of air pollution, oil spills, volcanic eruptions and nuclear accidents. Common to all our work is the main goal of securing lives and values. Every day, Yr is also part of the planning for people at home and abroad.

Modern meteorology requires the handling and analysis of enormous amounts of data, and offers great and exciting professional challenges.

We also have a research environment with around 180 researchers in weather, oceans, air quality and societal security. Today, we are a leading 
competence community in weather forecasting and climate research with head office located in Oslo, and offices in Tromsø and Bergen. Among our partners you will find Avinor, BaneNor, the Norwegian Institute of Public Health, the Norwegian Directorate for Civil Protection (DSB), the Norwegian Armed Forces, the Norwegian Civil Aviation Authority and many more. You can read more about what we do at strategi.met.no.

jobs.title: Psychiatry specialists for a permanent position in Hälsingland
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

We are currently looking for specialists in psychiatry to join a well-functioning psychiatric service in central Sweden.

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to work in a stable, supportive environment while still having the possibility to influence and develop the way care is delivered.

About the role

You will work with a combination of inpatient and outpatient psychiatry, with flexibility depending on your experience and interests.

In inpatient care, the focus is on patients requiring 24/7 treatment, including acute conditions. You will be involved in assessment, treatment planning, medication, and discharge planning together with the team.

In outpatient care, you will be part of a multidisciplinary clinic organised into specialised teams, including general psychiatry, diagnostics, bipolar disorders, and psychosis. This allows for both variation and the possibility to develop deeper expertise within specific areas.

The organisation is relatively small, which creates close collaboration between colleagues and shorter decision-making paths in everyday work.

The working environment

You will join a team with a strong collegial atmosphere, where several doctors have worked for many years. This provides stability, continuity, and a supportive way of working.

Collaboration is central, and you will work closely with nurses, psychologists, and other professionals with a shared focus on patient involvement and long-term care.

Development and future direction

The clinic is currently focusing on strengthening inpatient care, improving acute psychiatric services, and developing mobile psychiatric teams.

At the same time, there is an ongoing effort to create more flexible treatment options beyond traditional inpatient and outpatient care. As a specialist, you will have the opportunity to contribute to these developments in a meaningful way.

What we are looking for

    EU-recognised specialist certification in psychiatry
    Experience from both inpatient and outpatient psychiatry
    Ability to work independently as well as in a team
    Interest in supervision of junior doctors
    Motivation to learn Swedish
    Good skills in english

Additional information

jobs.title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen

The University seeks to appoint a tenure track assistant professor to commence 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Information on the department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/.

Subject area: Infectious disease epidemiology, modelling, animal health, One Health, and sustainable health systems

The Tenure-Track Assistant Professor will lead research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, with particular emphasis on how changes in environmental conditions, animal populations, production systems, and management practices influence disease emergence, transmission, and control. The position will combine infectious disease epidemiology, mathematical and statistical modelling, data science, and economic analysis to generate evidence supporting disease preparedness, prevention, and control.

The successful candidate will:

  • Lead independent research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, including the influence of environmental and production system changes.
  • Develop and apply simulation, epidemiological, and statistical models to assess disease and spillover risks, evaluate mitigation and control strategies, and quantify their economic implications.
  • Demonstrate strong programming skills in R and other relevant programming languages, including experience in managing, processing, and analysing large and complex datasets.
  • Have experience in developing and applying epidemiological disease-spread models, including model calibration, validation, parameter estimation, and calculation of epidemiological indicators such as the basic reproduction number (R₀) across different animal species and production systems.
  • Design and implement epidemiological modelling frameworks.
  • Validate and calibrate models using large-scale national datasets, ensuring scientific robustness, methodological validity, and relevance for policy and decision-making.
  • Translate research findings into evidence supporting risk-based disease prevention, preparedness, and control.
  • Establish and maintain collaborations with key stakeholders, including the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration, industry partners such as SEGES and Landbrug & Fødevarer (L&F), and international organisations such as the FAO.
  • Lead and secure independent research funding through competitive national and international funding calls. The position requires demonstrated experience in securing external funding, as well as the ambition to develop research ideas into externally funded projects and provide scientific leadership for such projects within the TIPTON Research Group.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of One Health and sustainability teaching, with a particular focus on infectious diseases, disease preparedness, and the interactions between animal, human, and environmental health.
  • Contribute to teaching in data science, including data management, dataset preparation and handling, statistical analysis, programming, and the analysis of large-scale and complex datasets.
  • Supervise students and contribute to research capacity building within infectious disease epidemiology, disease modelling, data science, and One Health.
  • Contribute to the delivery of government services undertaken by the Department, including research-based advice, preparedness activities, risk assessments, and other activities relevant to infectious disease modelling and control.
The position is expected to combine methodological excellence in infectious disease modelling and data science with applied epidemiological research, generating evidence that is directly relevant to disease preparedness, private and public bodies, sustainable production systems, animal health and resilient health systems.

The tenure track assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
The tenure track assistant professor’s performance will be evaluated through annual evaluations. Furthermore, the tenure track assistant professor will be evaluated in a mid-track appraisal.

After no more than six years of employment and on condition of a positive final appraisal, the tenure track assistant professor will be employed as associate professor. Find more information about tenure track at the University of Copenhagen.

Required qualifications
To be qualified for an assistant professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

Furthermore, each applicant must be able to document:

  • a PhD degree or similar qualifications within the subject area
  • research experience within the field of the position
The tenure track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

The assistant professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

Salary and employment conditions
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is permanent.

Employment is as Tenure Track Assistant Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations.

There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector at www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information, please contact Research Group Leader: Professor Beate Conrady, bcon@sund.ku.dk

Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

Application
The application must be submitted in English, and must include the following documents:

  • Application (Including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages))
  • Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding)
  • Diplomas (Master’s, PhD and other relevant diplomas)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Research plan (2-4 pages)
  • Teaching plan
  • Uploads of maximum 5 publications to be considered in the assessment
  • Teaching portfolio, if applicable (Guidelines)
Please note: It is mandatory to upload a teaching plan in the online application form. Should you not be able to produce a teaching plan, please upload a blank document in this box instead.

Application procedure
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

The application will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested in this post to apply.

Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, 18 November 2026.

Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 7 April 2027.

jobs.title: Evening Shift Supervisor in Facility Service
jobs.description:
Are you systematic, responsible and good with people? And do you thrive in a role where you work independently and are responsible for ensuring high quality for our customers? 

Then you may be the supervisor we are looking for to join our evening shift in Facility Service. 

As a supervisor, you will play an important role in ensuring high-quality cleaning services for our customers and in following up with the employees carrying out the work. You will work largely on your own and independently, so it is essential that you are able to structure your own working day, maintain an overview and take responsibility for ensuring that tasks are followed through to completion. 

At the same time, you need to be good with people. An important part of the job is following up on employees’ work and providing clear, respectful and constructive feedback, so employees know what is working well and where adjustments may be needed. 

Your responsibilities 

Your primary responsibility is to ensure that our customers receive the quality and service we have agreed with them. Your tasks will include: 

  • following up on cleaning services at our customers’ premises and ensuring that they meet the agreed service standards 

  • carrying out quality inspections and recording the results in our systems 

  • maintaining an ongoing dialogue with employees about the quality of their work 

  • providing specific and constructive feedback and following up when something needs to be done differently 

  • training and coaching employees at customer sites 

  • contributing to the start-up and quality assurance of services for new customers 

  • maintaining an ongoing dialogue with operations management about quality and follow-up 

  • responding and reporting when you identify errors, deficiencies or other issues at a customer site 

  • ensuring that cleaning rooms are kept tidy and that bicycles, carts and other equipment are properly maintained. 

Who are you? 

We place particular emphasis on how you work. 

You are systematic and have a natural sense of structure. As you will often work alone, you must be comfortable prioritising your own tasks and making the necessary decisions along the way. You take ownership and act when you see something that is not as it should be. 

At the same time, you understand that good quality is created together with the employees. You communicate clearly and respectfully and are comfortable having the conversation when something needs to be improved. 

You can give feedback in a way that is clear, respectful and helps the employee move forward. 

In addition, we expect that you: 

  • are service-minded and customer-focused 

  • work in a structured and efficient manner 

  • are solution-oriented and good at maintaining an overview 

  • have experience in commercial cleaning 

  • have knowledge of cleaning products, materials and equipment 

  • have experience training, guiding or managing employees 

  • are proficient in Danish and English, both written and spoken 

  • are comfortable cycling, as a bicycle is part of the working day. 

A role with freedom and responsibility 

This is the job for you if you enjoy taking responsibility and do not need someone looking over your shoulder. You will have an independent working day in which your systematic approach and judgement are essential. 

In return, you will become an important part of the quality our customers and employees experience every day. You are the person who notices when something works well and acknowledges it, while also taking responsibility for acting when something can be improved. 

Does this sound like you? We look forward to hearing from you. 

Terms of employment 

The position is full-time and subject to the applicable collective agreement. 

The work takes place in central Copenhagen, in Jeudan’s classic properties. You will cycle or walk around the area. You must be in good physical condition, as the properties also have stairs.

Application deadline
There is no application deadline, as we invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

Questions
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Operations Manager Gitte Enright on +45 70 10 60 70.

Please note: This document has been translated from Danish into English. In case of any discrepancies, the Danish version shall prevail.

jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

jobs.title: Develop your radiology career in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Radiologists career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden currently has a strong need for specialist radiologists within both general diagnostic radiology and several subspecialties. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, radiologists from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within the Swedish healthcare system.

We collaborate with hospitals and imaging departments across Sweden, ranging from regional hospitals to large university hospitals.

Our goal is to match your professional background, experience and preferences with the right workplace.

Radiologists in Sweden play a central role in clinical decision-making and work in close collaboration with physicians from many specialties. The work is primarily clinically focused and supported by modern imaging technology, digital reporting systems and well-structured workflows. Departments typically operate advanced diagnostic equipment including MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional radiography, supported by modern PACS systems.

Professional Development

The current need in Sweden is primarily for radiologists who wish to focus on clinical diagnostic work. Radiologists often work broadly within diagnostic radiology while gradually developing subspecialist expertise depending on their interests and the needs of the department. Multidisciplinary collaboration with clinicians is an important part of everyday work.

For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.

You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.

Support for your family

Many physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.

Language training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.

Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.

Requirements

We are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.

Interested?

Radiologists working in general diagnostic radiology as well as those with subspecialist expertise are welcome to explore opportunities with us.

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Senior AI Specialist to Service Fulfilment & Operations
jobs.employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
jobs.description:
Job ID: 6567

Welcome to Group Technology, where we engineer solutions that support Nordea's transformation and enable the Customer Vision and Business Strategy. As part of Nordea's 2030 strategic direction, we are modernizing our technology and data estate while accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled capabilities across the bank.

We are now looking for Senior AI Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will take technical ownership of reliable, secure and scalable AI-enabled platforms and applications. You will shape solution choices, build production-grade AI infrastructure and workflows, and guide teams in adopting AI responsibly in line with Nordea standards.

About our team

The team works closely with product owners, engineers, architects, cybersecurity, data governance and cloud platform teams to ensure our solutions are pragmatic, compliant and production-ready. You will bring deep hands-on engineering expertise, challenge and improve technical approaches, and communicate complex platform decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also support colleagues through practical guidance and help raise engineering standards across the wider organisation.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Take technical ownership of reliable, secure and scalable cloud and AI-enabled services, including participation in the 24/7 on-call rotation for business-critical applications
    Define and improve observability and operational practices across logging, monitoring, alerting, SLOs, incident response, resilience, cost control and production readiness, with a particular focus on Google Cloud
    Design and implement AI-enabled environments, including agentic AI solutions, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agents and end-to-end AI workflows
    Translate business and operational needs into sustainable technical solutions, identifying dependencies, risks and opportunities for improvement
    Provide expert guidance to users and engineering teams, resolve complex platform issues and support effective adoption of environments and tools
    Own the implementation and lifecycle of development, test and production platforms, ensuring stable, high-performing and maintainable solutions
    Drive technical decisions based on evidence, platform knowledge and long-term value, and align choices with architecture, security and governance requirements
    Act as a senior technical partner who shares knowledge, reviews solutions and helps raise engineering quality across the team
    Global collaboration with Nordea members across different countries

This is a full-time permanent position with a hybrid working arrangement, up to 40% remote work is possible. We expect to hire in one of these cities: Gdańsk or Gdynia, Warsaw, Helsinki, Stockholm or Copenhagen.

Who you are

Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) mindset:

    Builds reliability into services from the start instead of reacting only after issues occur
    Uses monitoring, service-level objectives, and operational data to understand system performance
    Automates repetitive operational work and reduces unnecessary manual effort
    Designs systems to fail safely, recover quickly, and remain manageable in production
    Learns from incidents through root-cause analysis and blameless reviews, turning findings into practical improvements
    Balances delivery speed with stability, security, and responsible risk management

Your background and skills include:

    5 years of relevant experience in IT operations, site reliability engineering, platform engineering or cloud infrastructure, with a track record of owning complex production environments
    Strong DevOps and operations expertise across support, maintenance, deployment, automation and platform administration
    Hands-on experience with cloud operations in Google Cloud; knowledge of AWS or Azure is an advantage
    Advanced troubleshooting skills, including the ability to interpret logs, metrics and traces and resolve complex application and infrastructure issues
    Practical knowledge of Linux/Unix environments
    Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible and Git-based repository management
    Experience designing, integrating or operating AI-enabled solutions, such as generative AI services, agentic workflows or retrieval-augmented generation
    The judgement to make sound technical decisions in a regulated environment, balancing innovation with security, resilience, governance and maintainability
    A lead-by-doing approach: you combine deep technical expertise with hands-on delivery, practical guidance and a willingness to share knowledge
    Great communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in written and spoken English (no Polish or Nordic languages expected)

It would be ideal if you also one or more from following:

    Have designed or implemented AI workflows and can demonstrate how you have moved AI use cases from experimentation towards reliable production use
    Have worked in a 24/7 operational environment and are comfortable joining an on-call rotation during normal working hours and, at minimum, one week every two months
    Have led the resolution of complex incidents, including root-cause analysis, change implementation and communication with customers and stakeholders
    Have experience releasing and operating new applications or platform capabilities used by internal or external customers
    Have contributed to technical standards, architecture decisions, code or solution reviews, or mentoring within an engineering community

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application in English language no later than 26/10/2026. Please note that we may proceed with suitable candidates during the application period.

For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

Vastuumyyjänä varmistat kaupan arjen sujuvuuden ja asiakastyytyväisyyden yhdessä marketpäällikön ja apulaispäällikön kanssa. Maito-osasto toimii yhtenä keskeisenä vastuualueena, mutta lopullinen päävastuuosastosi määräytyy osaamisesi ja toimipaikan tarpeiden mukaan. Purchasing Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Sine Engineering**

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, including communications, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations at scale. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our technology, and our solutions power many of today's active interceptor operations.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

**Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere.**

We build resilient communication, navigation, and coordination systems for the age of autonomy.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive **Purchasing Specialist** to develop and manage our Finland offices end-to-end procurement activities from creating purchase orders and validating supplier confirmations to ensuring timely deliveries and resolving shortages. You will maintain daily communication with suppliers, support onboarding and RFQ processes.

What we need is a strong procurement professional who will thrive in a global role with a lot of independence and responsibility, with the potential to grow into team leadership.

In this position you will be building the procurement process in Finland together with your international colleagues and manager. Your colleagues and stakeholders are spread across several countries, so you'll work in an international collaboration setup, but you will as well work closely with our Engineering and Finance teams, so you should have a good understanding of the Finnish procurement field.

With us you'll learn, develop, and grow right alongside a fast-moving global company. Because this is a key role in Finland, it is also an opportunity to develop something new, and a possibility grow into a leadership position.

**Location:** Tampere, on-site, fulltime, permanent position

**Key responsibilities**

- Create and manage purchase orders (POs) based on MRP, requisitions, or project needs


- Validate order confirmations: prices, delivery dates, quantities


- Follow up with suppliers to ensure on-time delivery


- Resolve delivery delays, shortages, and discrepancies.


- Follow up with warehouse team to have proper receiving within WH


- Maintain day-to-day communication with suppliers


- Support onboarding new suppliers by collecting documents and coordinating approval flows


- Request quotes (RFQs) and compare proposal


- Provide purchasing support during new product development (NPI)


- Support engineering changes (ECR/ECO) by updating suppliers and adjusting POs


**What we require**

To succeed in this role, you should have:

- Good knowledge of Finnish procurement process, limitations and constraints

- Good understanding of purchasing processes (RFQ, RFI, POs, contracts, and incoterms)

- Supplier management skills (evaluation, onboarding, performance tracking)


- Cost analysis skills like ability to compare quotes, calculate landed cost, evaluate TCO


- Knowledge of ERP/MRP systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.)


- Basic contract understanding like payment terms, delivery terms, warranty clauses etc.


- Strong ability to analyze prices, trends, and delivery performance


- Proficiency with Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation)


- Understanding demand planning and how it impacts purchasing


- English: B2 or higher


**What we see as a plus**

- Experience working at EMS factories

- Highly adaptable mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, embrace change, and solve problems beyond previous experience


**What We Offer**

**Paid Time Off**

The Employee is entitled to an annual holiday 4 + 1 weeks from the start **Health & Wellness Package**

- Lunch Benefit: daily lunch allowance up to the taxfree limit as a fringe benefit.


- Sport & Culture: annual budget for gyms, sports activities, cultural events, and hobbies.


- Wellbeing Allowance: additional allowance for massage and other wellness support.


- Extended Occupational Healthcare: enhanced coverage including partial dental care.


- Accident Insurance (24/7): full coverage for accidents during both work and free time.


- Business Travel Insurance: coverage for workrelated travel.


- Snacks & Office Comforts: coffee, snacks, fruits and other office perks.


**Work Model**

- Flexible Working Hours: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00.


- NoCrunch Policy: no systematic overtime; overtime is compensated or reimbursed.


- MeetingLight Culture: protected focus time and minimal unnecessary meetings.


**Growth & Innovation**

- HighEnd Equipment: premium laptop, monitor, and peripherals.


- Lab & Gadget Budget: annual budget for hardware, tools, books, and learning materials.


- Hackathons & Offsites: regular internal events focused on innovation and technology.


**Travel & Mobility**

- Business Travel Expenses: full coverage of tickets, accommodation, and transportation.


- Per Diem (Vero Max): daily allowances according to the maximum taxfree Vero rates.


**Impact & Culture**

- Low-hierarchy, engineering-driven environment with strong autonomy and zero micromanagement.


**Culture Statement**

Dont meet every requirement? Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Sine Engineering, we value authenticity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesnt perfectly match every listed requirement. You might be the ideal candidate for this role- or for another opportunity with us.

Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of UAV technology.

**Privacy Notice**

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes.

Your data will be handled in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Finnish Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. We will retain your application data for up to 2 years, unless you consent to a longer retention period.

You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting: privacy@sineeng.com

Position details

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI-Mediated Communication and Collaboration Norms at Work.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Emma Nordbäck (emma.nordback@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Associate Professor Emma Nordbäck (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship.
