jobs.title: 2 sygeplejersker til Nivå hjemmepleje - Dagvagt
jobs.description:
Sygeplejersker til Nivå hjemmepleje, Fredensborg kommune
En spændende arbejdsplads i udvikling

Bruger du din faglighed til at inddrage borgerens ressourcer? Formidler du viden og kompetencer til dine kolleger til gavn for borgeren?
Hvis ja, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Da nogle af vores nuværende sygeplejerske skal på uddannelse/kompetenceudvikling, søger hjemmeplejen i Nivå nu 2 engagerede sygeplejersker, som værdsætter at arbejde tæt på borgeren – både i sygeplejeklinikken og i borgerens eget hjem.

Her får du mulighed for at arbejde med alsidige opgaver og tænke innovativt i din opgaveløsning i samarbejde med forskellige faggrupper.

Den ene stilling er på 37 timer ugentligt i dagvagt med weekendvagt hver 6. weekend. Den anden er på 20-25 timer ugentligt i dagvagt med weekendvagt hver 6. weekend.

Hvem er vi?
Nivågruppen består af 2 teams med social- og sundhedshjælpere, omsorgsmedarbejdere, husassistenter, terapeuter, farmakonom, social- og sundhedsassistenter samt sygeplejersker.
Vi arbejder ud fra borgerens perspektiv og er godt i gang med at implementere ældreloven.

Vi lægger vægt på tværfagligt samarbejde. Vi har i de 2 teams ugentlige tværfaglige møder samt daglige koordinations- og triagemøder , hvor vi bla. i fællesskab styrker fokus på rehabilitering og tidlig opsporing.

I Fredensborg Kommune er sygeplejerskerne selvvisiterende.

Vores vigtigste mission i Nivågruppen er at:
  • Støtte borgerne i at leve et liv med størst mulig selvbestemmelse og selvstændighed
  • Forebygge uhensigtsmæssige indlæggelser og genindlæggelser
  • En koordineret indsats
  • Skabe sammenhængskraft på tværs af faggrupperne i hjemmeplejen
  • Sikre bæredygtighed i arbejdsgangene ved at dele gode idéer
  • Fremme et motiverende fællesskab for faglig udvikling som grundlag for engagement og arbejdsglæde
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø

Typiske arbejdsopgaver i Nivågruppen
  • Være mødeleder ved tværfaglige- og triage møder
  • Levere sygepleje, omsorg og pleje til borgere med komplekse sygeplejeopgaver
  • Kvalitetssikre plejeforløb for borgere, fx ved akut opstået sygdom, palliativ pleje, sårbehandling, smertebehandling, procedurer ved indlæggelser og udskrivelser samt særligt komplekse forløb
  • Vejlede og undervise kollegaer i sygeplejefaglige udfordringer, både aktuelle og inden for områder, hvor du har særlig ekspertise

Vi ønsker os en sygeplejerske, som synes det er spændende at:
  • Yde sygepleje til ældre borgere i den primære sektor
  • Tilrettelægge, udføre og evaluere sygepleje af høj kvalitet i samarbejde med andre faggrupper
  • Gå forrest med god praksis for dokumentation og understøtte andre faggruppers kompetencer inden for dokumentation og triagering
  • Samarbejde med mange forskellige kollegaer om både planlagte og mere akutte opgaver
  • Arbejde med dokumentation i Nexus

Vi tilbyder
  • En hjemmeplejegruppe med god energi og fokus på trivsel for både borgere og medarbejdere
  • En teamstruktur med gode samarbejdsrelationer
  • Positive, imødekommende og dygtige kollegaer samt spændende og udfordrende opgaver, hvor to dage sjældent er ens
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på sygeplejen
  • Sygeplejefaglig sparring
  • Medindflydelse
  • Nærværende ledelse

Yderligere oplysninger:

Eller Anne Grann E-mail: anmgr@fredensborg.dk Tlf.: 2182 9591

jobs.title: Kunnossapitoasentaja – elintarvikeala, Pyhäntä, vakituinen työ
jobs.description:
Etsimme **kunnossapitoasentajaa** elintarvikealan tuotantoympäristöön. Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten mekaanisten kunnossapitotöiden parissa sekä varmistamaan tuotannon laitteiden ja prosessien häiriöttömän toiminnan.

**Tehtävässä vastaat muun muassa**

- tuotantolaitteiden mekaanisesta kunnossapidosta

- vikojen selvittämisestä ja korjaamisesta

- uudisasennustehtävät

- ennakkohuoltojen toteuttamisesta ja kehittämisestä

- tuotannon toimintavarmuuden ylläpitämisestä.


**Odotamme sinulta**

- valmiutta myös mekaanisen kunnossapidon tehtäviin

- kykyä itsenäiseen työskentekyyn

- aikaisempaa kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta

- turvallista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- työturvallisuuden huomioivaa työtapaa

- positiivista asennetta ja halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi.

- hygieniapassi on hyvä lisä


Työ on **kaksivuorotyötä (aamu- ja iltavuoro)**. Tehtävässä **ei ole päivystystä** ja **työt tehdään aina samassa tehtaassa**.

**Asiakkaamme tarjoaa sinulle** monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän nykyaikaisessa kunnossapitoympäristössä, mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi sekä suuren yrityksen henkilöstöedut. Turvallisuus on heillä aina etusijalla. Työt alkaa nopealla aikataululla jo lokakuun aikana.

jobs.title: Erfaren konsulent til at understøtte folkeskoleområdet
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde tæt på de politiske dagsordener på folkeskoleområdet? Har du lyst til at være med til at skabe de bedste rammer for kommunerne på børne- og ungeområdet, og trives du i krydsfeltet mellem udvikling, interessevaretagelse og stærk formidling? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i KL's Kontor for Børn, Unge og Folkeskole.

KL's Kontor for Børn, Unge og Folkeskole varetager opgaver på hele 0-25-årsområdet med det mål at skabe de bedste rammer for kommunerne til at drive dagtilbud, fritidstilbud, folkeskole og ungepolitik.

Folkeskolen står højt på den politiske dagsorden, og derfor søger vi 1-2 nye kolleger, der kan hjælpe os med at indfri ambitionen om at styrke kvaliteten af den danske folkeskole.

Har du lyst til at arbejde med interessevaretagelse på kommunernes vegne?

Vi søger erfarne konsulenter til vores hold af dygtige og engagerede konsulenter. Dine opgaver vil ligge inden for KL's politiske og faglige interessevaretagelse på børne- og ungeområdet med hovedvægt på folkeskolen. Her arbejder vi med alt fra indholdet og kvaliteten af undervisningen, rekrutteringsdagsordenen, skolefravær og styrkede almene børnefællesskaber til AI's rolle i folkeskolen - og alt derimellem. Konkret vil du bl.a. komme til at arbejde med:
  • KL's politik på børne- og ungeområdet, herunder udarbejdelse af sager til KL's politiske udvalg, direktion, kontaktudvalg mv.
  • Interessevaretagelse i forhold til Christiansborg, ministerier, organisationer mv.
  • At vedligeholde og udvikle relationer og samarbejde med kommuner, ministerier, parter, vidensmiljøer mv.
  • Forberedelse og gennemførelse af konferencer, temadage, dialogmøder mv. samt udarbejdelse af inspirationsmaterialer
  • Understøtte kommunerne via udviklingspartnerskaber på tværs af kommuner

Om dig

Opgaverne i kontoret spænder bredt fra interessevaretagelse, politisk betjening, politikformulering og projekter til at udvikle og afholde temadage og konferencer. Arbejdet med KL's interessevaretagelse formes i et tæt samspil med resten af organisationen. Evnen til at kunne se og samarbejde på tværs af fagområder er en forudsætning for at skabe resultater i KL.

Ud fra dette lægger vi derfor vægt på, at du:
  • Har god politisk forståelse og kan navigere sikkert i en organisation med mange interessenter.
  • Du har en lang samfundsvidenskabelig eller en anden relevant videregående uddannelse, skriver godt og er god til den udadrettede kontakt, som kræves i samarbejdet med både medlemmerne og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Du har beskæftiget dig med folkeskoleområdet, politisk betjening og interessevaretagelse og har fx arbejdet i centraladministrationen, en kommune, en interesseorganisation, på Christiansborg el.lign, og du har flere års erfaring.
  • Du kender til den politiske arena, som KL er en del af.
  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, har blik for strategiske perspektiver, er analytisk stærk og idérig, kan arbejde med korte deadlines og er en god holdspiller.
  • Du kan se værdien af samarbejde med andre fagområder og har særligt blik for sammenhængen på tværs af 0-25-årsområdet.

Hvem er vi

Du bliver en del af et kontor med et stærkt fagligt miljø, og du får 25 engagerede kolleger. Vi tilbyder et udfordrende og afvekslende job, hvor du får både ansvar, gode udviklingsmuligheder og indflydelse på jobindholdet. Vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden, har fokus på samarbejde og på at give hinanden konstruktivt med- og modspil, så vi finder de bedste løsninger til gavn for kommunerne.

Vi sidder i storrumskontorer, som understøtter denne arbejdsform, og har alle nogle rejsedage indimellem. Vi har en uformel omgangstone, og vi er gode til at gøre plads til et grin i en travl hverdag.

Det praktiske

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning senest onsdag d. 21. oktober 2026.

Vi forventer, at første runde af samtaler gennemføres den 26. oktober 2026, og at anden runde af samtaler gennemføres den 28. oktober 2026. Vi håber på at kunne byde vores nye kollega velkommen snarest muligt.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst med mulighed for forhandling af tillæg på baggrund af personlige kvalifikationer.

Vil du vide mere, eller har du spørgsmål, kan du ringe til kontorchef Mette Arnsfelt McPhail på telefon 25 83 64 05 eller souschef Kristine Wiberg Plougsgaard på telefon 28 72 79 92.

KL er interesse- og medlemsorganisation for de 98 kommunalbestyrelser i Danmark. KL bidrager til at udvikle og fastholde et stærkt lokalt demokrati. KL varetager kommunernes fælles interesser og er kommunernes samlede forhandlingsorganisation, videnscenter og forum for fælles initiativer og beslutninger.

KL ser forskellighed i medarbejdersammensætningen og i ledelsen som en af vores styrker og opfordrer alle interesserede uanset personlig baggrund til at søge vores ledige stillinger.

Kig forbi vores KL Karriereunivers og lær mere om os som arbejdsplads og medarbejdere. https://www.kl.dk/karriereunivers/forside

jobs.title: Rengøringsvikar søges til skolerengøring i Stenløse – uge 43 og 44
jobs.description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder i Stenløse søger FIRMAVIKAR en mødestabil rengøringsmedarbejder til et kortere vikariat i uge 43 og 44.

Der er tale om almindelig skolerengøring med faste arbejdstider i de tidlige morgentimer. Vi søger en medarbejder, der har erfaring med rengøring, arbejder grundigt og selvstændigt og kan sikre, at skolens lokaler er rene og klar til dagens undervisning.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:

  • Daglig rengøring af klasselokaler og fællesområder

  • Rengøring af gange, toiletter og øvrige faciliteter

  • Aftørring af overflader og inventar

  • Støvsugning og gulvvask

  • Sikre en god hygiejnestandard på skolen

  • Øvrige almindelige rengøringsopgaver efter behov

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring med professionel rengøring, gerne fra skoler, institutioner eller lignende

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og har øje for detaljerne

  • Er mødestabil og kan møde tidligt om morgenen

  • Arbejder effektivt og grundigt

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og tager dine arbejdsopgaver seriøst

  • Har en positiv indstilling og er klar til at tage fat

Vi tilbyder

  • Et vikariat på 2 uger med faste arbejdstider

  • En arbejdsplads med ordnede forhold

  • En fast kontaktperson hos FIRMAVIKAR under hele vikariatet

Arbejdssted og arbejdstider

Arbejdssted: Stenløse
Periode: Uge 43 og 44 (19. oktober – 30. oktober 2026)
Arbejdsdage: Mandag til fredag
Arbejdstid: Kl. 04.30–08.30
Timetal: 20 timer om ugen
Opstart: Mandag den 19. oktober 2026

Ansøgning

Har du erfaring med rengøring, og passer arbejdstiderne dig, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@firmavikar.dk hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.description:
Vi mangler en dygtig og engageret maskinfører til vores entreprenørvirksomhed, der arbejder med jord, kloak, beton og anlægsopgaver i Københavnsområdet og andre dele af Sjælland.

Du bliver en vigtig del af vores team, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Betjening af gravemaskine i forbindelse med jord- og anlægsarbejde

  • Udgravning til kloak, fundamenter og terrænregulering

  • Samarbejde med formand og øvrige kollegaer på pladsen

  • Vedligeholdelse og dagligt tilsyn af maskiner

  • Andre forefaldende opgaver på byggepladsen

Det er vigtigt, at du er fleksibel og indstillet på, at der kan forekomme arbejdsopgaver ud over maskinføreropgaver, når behovet opstår.

Vi forventer at du

  • Har erfaring som maskinfører

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

  • Har forståelse for arbejde med jord, kloak og anlæg

  • Er mødestabil og samarbejdsvillig

  • Har kørekort (gerne BE)

Vi tilbyder

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer

  • Spændende og varierende opgaver

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Pension efter overenskomst

  • Fast arbejde i en virksomhed med ordnede forhold

  • Firmabil

jobs.title: Vi søger en dygtig rørlægger til vores team
jobs.description:
Dansk Bygge Rådgivning & Entreprenør søger en Rørlægger til Sjælland, primært i Hovedstadsområdet.

Har du hænderne godt skruet på, og trives du med en varieret hverdag fyldt med spændende opgaver?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Om stillingen:
Vi søger en engageret og fagligt stærk rørlægger, der kan indgå i vores team og være med til at løse både små og store opgaver inden for rørlægning.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:

-          Udførelse af kloak- og afløbsinstallationer

-          Renovering og nyanlæg

jobs.title: NTI Group is looking for a Global Software Partnerships Manager – Drive Growth Across 15 Markets
jobs.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, partnerships, and commercial growth? Are you motivated by working across countries, vendors, and cultures to create business impact?

At NTI Group, a leading Autodesk partner operating across 15 markets in EMEA and Brazil, we are looking for a commercially driven Global Software Partnerships Manager to take ownership of our portfolio of Global Software Partnerships solutions and accelerate growth across the Group.

Your mission

As Global Software Partnerships Manager, you will be responsible for driving the success of NTI Group's Global software Partnerships business across all markets.

You will act as the key link between software vendors, distributors, local teams, and Group leadership, ensuring strong partnerships, successful go-to-market initiatives, and sustainable business growth.

What you'll do

  • Own and develop NTI Group's Global Software Partnerships software portfolio

  • Build and strengthen strategic relationships with software vendors and distributors

  • Drive global go-to-market activities and commercial growth initiatives

  • Support local sales organizations with pipeline development and sales enablement

  • Lead vendor reviews, partnership activities, and follow-up actions

  • Monitor business performance, KPIs, and growth opportunities across markets

  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and build a strong international product community

What we're looking for

You bring solid commercial experience from software, partner, product, channel, or vendor management and have a proven track record of driving growth through partnerships and go-to-market initiatives.

We imagine that you:

  • Have 5+ years of relevant experience

  • Are experienced in working with software vendors and partner programs

  • Understand pipeline management, forecasting, and business performance metrics

  • Thrive in an international environment with many stakeholders

  • Combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach

  • Communicate fluently in English

Experience from software, AEC, manufacturing, or design technology industries is an advantage.

Why join NTI Group?

This is a unique opportunity to influence NTI Group's global software portfolio and play a key role in shaping strategic vendor partnerships across 15 countries.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary, pension scheme, and private health insurance

  • Excellent lunch arrangement with in-house chefs

  • A high degree of freedom, flexibility, and trust

  • A collaborative and supportive international environment

  • An inclusive culture where diversity is a strength

Travel

The role includes international travel for vendor meetings, business reviews, and collaboration with country organizations.

We hire when we find the right candidate, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Contact person:

Lars Kanneworff, Sales Director, +4544350737, LK@nti-group.com. Please note we do not receive applications and resumes by mail.

Learn more about us at www.nti-group.com

jobs.title: Director of Human Resources
jobs.description:
**Who We Are Looking For**

We are seeking an experienced, strategic and highly collaborative HR leader to join our School Leadership Team and lead the development of people strategy and HR practice across the school.

This senior leadership role requires excellent professional knowledge with sound judgement, courage, discretion and exceptional interpersonal skills. The successful candidate will be comfortable navigating complexity, providing trusted advice and constructive challenge, resolving conflict and leading sensitive and difficult conversations with clarity, empathy and confidence.

The Director of Human Resources builds trust and alignment while maintaining the professional independence necessary to provide clear HR advice, uphold organisational expectations and address challenging issues directly and constructively.

A strong understanding of employment law, collective agreements and the Finnish employment environment is important, together with the ability to lead strategically within a diverse international community.

**Key Responsibilities Include:**

- Lead the development and implementation of the schools HR strategy, ensuring that people practices, systems and structures support ISHs strategic priorities and mission.

- Partner closely with the Head of School and School Leadership Team, providing trusted advice, professional expertise and constructive challenge on workforce planning, organisational development and complex personnel matters.

- Drive continuous improvement in HR systems, policies and practices, identifying opportunities to strengthen organisational effectiveness, employee experience and accountability.

- Lead and oversee full-cycle recruitment, selection, onboarding and offboarding, ensuring rigorous, equitable and efficient processes aligned with school policies, safeguarding expectations and DEIJ principles.

- Lead performance and employee relations processes, including professional growth, workplace conflict, performance improvement, and disciplinary matters with clarity, empathy, and discretion.

- Build and sustain a culture of exceptional collaboration, trust and shared accountability, working across teams and perspectives to build alignment and address differences constructively.

- Ensure HR practices and decisions comply with Finnish employment legislation, applicable collective agreements, school policies and relevant regulatory requirements.

- Collaborate with the Director of Business and Operations and Head of School on compensation, benefits, leave and other employment conditions.

- Strengthen staff engagement and wellbeing through purposeful feedback mechanisms, effective communication and appropriate collaboration with occupational health services.

- Oversee employment contracts, absence procedures, HR digital systems, international recruitment and relocation procedures, and other key personnel processes.

- Champion the schools safeguarding culture through rigorous safer recruitment and HR practices, ensuring that employee-related safeguarding concerns are recognised, reported and addressed promptly in accordance with school procedures.


- Contribute actively as a member of the School Leadership Team, taking collective responsibility for whole-school priorities and helping to shape a positive, inclusive and high-performing organisational culture.


**What We Offer**

This senior leadership role offers a significant opportunity to shape ISHs people strategy, influence organisational culture and drive meaningful organisational development within a vibrant international learning community.

ISH offers competitive compensation and benefits and an environment in which professional expertise, initiative and leadership are valued. The successful candidate will have meaningful scope to influence organisational practice while working within a highly collaborative leadership culture built on trust, accountability, inclusion and shared responsibility.

**Salary:**

The salary will be commensurate with qualifications and relevant experience, in accordance with the ISH pay structure and applicable collective agreements.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- A university degree in Human Resources, employment law, business administration, organisational leadership or another relevant field.

- Significant professional experience within an established HR function, preferably including senior or leadership responsibility.

- Strong knowledge of employment law and working knowledge of collective agreements and the legal environment relevant to schools in Finland.

- Experience in international, multicultural and/or educational environments.

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex and sensitive employee relations matters, including performance concerns, workplace conflict and disciplinary processes.

- Confidence and capability to conduct difficult, courageous conversations and provide direct, constructive feedback.

- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to build trust, influence effectively, and collaborate across diverse teams while maintaining independent professional judgement.

- Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and manage organisational and employment-related risk.

- Adaptability, resilience and the capacity to prioritise effectively in a dynamic and complex environment.

- High levels of integrity, discretion and commitment to confidentiality.

- Excellent competence in HR technology and digital tools.


**Child Protection & Safeguarding** ISH is committed to the highest standards of safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. Successful candidates will be required to sign the schools Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct and successfully complete appropriate background checks, including police clearance and reference verification.

**Employment Start Date**

- As soon as possible, ideally December 2026 and no later than January 2027.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Would you like to build software that real companies use every day?**

CraftLeap is a software company founded in 2023. We develop easy-to-use software, particularly for **production and inventory management**, for companies in the manufacturing industry. Our product is already in active use by companies across Finland – and now we are looking for our first software developer to join us and help build the next stage of CraftLeap.

Our first customer joined us in 2023. We now have **almost 20 customers, with the majority joining us during this year**. Growth has been strong, and new customers are continuously coming in.

This is an exciting stage to join us if you want to have a real impact on a growing product.

What will you be doing?

You will be developing CraftLeap's web-based software together with the founder. Your work will include, for example:

- designing and implementing new features

- developing user interfaces and functionality

- improving and maintaining existing code

- investigating and fixing bugs

- developing the software based on customer needs

- building new integrations and backend services


As the product continues to grow, you will also have the opportunity to influence **what we build and how we build it**.

What kind of developer are we looking for?

We are primarily looking for someone who already has experience in software development and is comfortable taking responsibility for their work.

**Developers at the early stages of their careers are also very welcome to apply.** If you are familiar with software development, learn quickly, and are eager to work on a real software product, this could be a great opportunity for you.

Experience with technologies such as these is a plus:

- **JavaScript or TypeScript**

- **React, Angular, Vue or other modern web development**

- web-based application development

- REST APIs and integrations

- cloud services and cloud-based databases

- Git and modern software development tools


We are not looking for a long list of technologies on your CV. What matters most to us is that **you can build working software and solve problems independently**.

What is it like to work at CraftLeap?

CraftLeap is a small company, so you won't be one developer among a hundred others.

You will work directly with the founder. Decisions can be made quickly, new ideas can be tested, and your work will have a visible impact on the product.

The position is **hybrid, with a strong focus on remote work**. We do, however, hope that you can work together with us in the Seinäjoki area when needed.

There is no unnecessary bureaucracy or complicated organizational structure. If you see something that could be done better, you can say it – and even better if you can help make it happen.

Why join us now?

CraftLeap is at a point where the product is no longer just an idea or a prototype.

**The software is in production, we have customers across Finland, and our customer base is growing rapidly.**

We are now building the foundation for the next stage of growth. As one of the first developers at CraftLeap, you will have a significant role in developing the product and shaping the technical solutions as the development team grows.

Salary and applying

Salary will be agreed based on your experience and skills.

**Please include your salary expectation in your application.**

If this sounds like something you could be a good fit for, **we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement listed above**.

Tell us briefly about yourself, your previous experience and the kind of software you have worked with.

**More information:** craftleap.com

**Applications:** info@craftleap.com

jobs.title: Hertz Sandefjord søker helgevakter
jobs.description:
Er du en av våre nye kollegaer ved vår avdeling på Sandefjord lufthavn? Jobben passer for deg som har god sans for logistikk, rutiner, er utadvendt, samt liker å snakke med folk og jobbe med kundebehandling.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Håndtering og oppfølging av kundehenvendelser i butikk, epost og telefon.
  • Planlegging, kontroll og disponering av bilflåten på avdelingen.
  • Utleie av biler, samt salg av våre produkter og tjenester.
  • Kontroll og oppfølging av leiekontrakter og daglige gjøremål.
  • Sikkerhetskontroll og klargjøring av biler.

Du har:

  • Hatt førerkort for personbil i minst 1 år.
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige fremstillingsevner på norsk og engelsk.
  • Evne til, og trives med, å jobbe i en fartsfylt hverdag.
  • Mulighet til å jobbe i skiftordning.
  • Følgende egenskaper: liker å snakke med folk, har godt humør og er salgs- og serviceinnstilt, ansvarsfull, fleksibel og pålitelig.

Du får:

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Et aktivt og morsomt miljø.
  • Strukturerte arbeidsforhold.
  • Muligheter for personlig utvikling og for å lære mye om mennesker
  • Konkurransedyktige vilkår og attraktive bonusavtaler.

 

Som ansatt i Hertz er du med på laget til Norges største bilutleieselskap, der du er en del av et engasjert team som er opptatt av å levere kvalitet til hver eneste kunde.
Vår avdeling i Sandefjord er tilgjengelig alle dager så arbeidstiden vil være skiftbasert.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hertz – et ledende bildelingsselskap. Hertz er representert mer enn 150 land på samtlige kontinenter med over 11 000 lokasjoner. Hertz er Norges største bildelingsselskap og en betydelig aktør i den raskt voksende delingsøkonomien. De seneste ti årene har vi hatt en årlig vekst på ca. 20 prosent, og har nå over 500 utleiepunkter, inkludert samtlige flyplasser. Bilflåten i Norge består av flere enn 10 000 nye biler fra verdens ledende produsenter, som leies ut via et landsdekkende nettverk. Hertz vil være førstevalget innen bilutleie og en markant aktør i den nye delingsøkonomien med heldigitale delings- og mobilitetsløsninger. Vi har store ambisjoner for fremtiden og ser et betydelig vekstpotensial i at stadig flere vil leie og dele biler fremfor å eie selv. Samtlige lokasjoner i Hertz Norge er miljø- og kvalitetssertifisert gjennom standardene ISO 14001, 9001 og 45001 (HMS).

jobs.title: SEAI - Registered Domestic BER Assessor
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Building Envelope Technologies (BET) is one of Ireland’s leading specialists in building performance, energy efficiency and compliance. Due to continued growth, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Domestic BER Assessor to join our Sustainability team. This is an excellent opportunity for an SEAI-registered Domestic BER Assessor who wants to develop their career further. Whether your experience is mainly with one-off homes or larger residential developments, we would like to hear from you. For the right candidate, BET will also provide funded training and support to progress towards Non-Domestic BER Assessor status. The Role As a Domestic BER Assessor, you will: Carry out Domestic BER assessments in accordance with SEAI requirements. Complete site surveys for one-off residential properties and larger developments. Prepare accurate BER calculations, assessments and reports. Review drawings, specifications and construction details. Carry out U-value calculations and condensation risk analysis where required. Assess compliance with Part L of the Building Regulations. Provide clients with professional advice on energy performance and compliance. Work closely with our wider Sustainability and Building Performance teams. Have the opportunity to progress into Non-Domestic BER assessments. What We’re Looking For Essential: Currently registered with SEAI as a Domestic BER Assessor. Relevant Level 6 or higher qualification in Construction, Engineering, Architecture, Sustainability or a related discipline. Good understanding of residential construction and building energy performance. Strong IT skills, including AutoCAD, Microsoft Word and Excel. Full clean driving licence and willingness to travel to client sites. Strong communication and organisational skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Desirable Previous professional experience completing Domestic BER assessments. Experience working on residential developments or one-off properties. Knowledge of TGD Part L and Part F / NZEB requirements. Experience with Non-Domestic BER assessments is an advantage but not essential. Why Join BET? Generous and competitive salary, based on experience. Funded training and development. Clear opportunity to progress towards Non-Domestic BER Assessor status. Opportunity to broaden your technical knowledge across building performance and compliance. Work on a varied range of residential projects and developments. Join an established and growing team within one of Ireland’s leading building performance and compliance specialists.

jobs.title: Registered nurse opportunities in Northern Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Live and work in the heart of Northern Norway!

Are you a registered nurse looking for a rewarding career in a close-knit community surrounded by spectacular Arctic nature? We are recruiting nurses for a municipality in North Troms, one of Norway's most scenic regions, where mountains meet fjords and outdoor adventures are part of everyday life.

The exact location will be shared with selected candidates during the recruitment process due to confidentiality.

These are permanent full-time positions within a well-organised municipal healthcare service in North Troms. You will join a dedicated home care team providing high-quality healthcare services to people living in their own homes. The role offers a varied workday, close patient follow-up, professional responsibility and the opportunity to make a real difference in people's daily lives.

Main responsibilities include:

    Providing nursing care in both institutional and community-based services
    Health assessments, treatment and follow-up of patients
    Collaboration with physicians, physiotherapists and other healthcare professionals
    Participation in rehabilitation, preventive care and health promotion activities
    Supervision of students and colleagues when relevant
    Contributing to quality improvement and development of healthcare services

Qualifications:

    Authorisation as a registered nurse within an EU/EEA country
    Good communication skills in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish, or willingness to learn Norwegian
    For international candidates, Norwegian language training can be provided
    Valid police clearance certificate before commencement
    Driving licence category B is required

Personal qualities:

    Responsible and professionally engaged
    Positive and collaborative
    Flexible and comfortable with a varied workday
    Able to work independently while contributing to the team
    Motivated to provide high-quality patient care

What we offer:

In addition to a rewarding nursing career, employees in Northern Norway benefit from several financial incentives, including reduced income tax, free kindergarten and student loan benefits for eligible residents.

    Permanent full-time employment with a stable public-sector employer
    Competitive salary according to qualifications and experience
    Additional salary supplements for nurses
    Favourable pension and insurance schemes through the Norwegian public sector
    Assistance with relocation and finding accommodation
    Professional development opportunities and continuing education
    Free kindergarten in accordance with current regulations
    Reduced payment on Norwegian student loans for those eligible under the Northern Norway incentive scheme
    Lower income tax rates compared to most parts of Norway
    A safe and family-friendly community with affordable housing and short commuting distances
    Excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, fishing and outdoor activities throughout the year

Why choose this opportunity?

This is an opportunity to combine a meaningful nursing career with an exceptional quality of life in Northern Norway. The region offers breathtaking fjord and mountain landscapes, excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, fishing and outdoor activities, and a strong sense of community. Here, you'll have the chance to develop your professional skills while enjoying a calmer pace of life surrounded by nature.

Ready to apply?

Send us your application, and we will evaluate candidates continuously. Feel free to reach out for more information, I look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Hauswirtschaftskraft / Schulköchin (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Hauswirtschaftskraft (m/w/d) in Teilzeit gesucht!

Die Kindertagesstätte Winterspelt sucht zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine liebevolle und engagierte Hauswirtschaftskraft (m/w/d), die unseren Kindern (im Alter von 1 bis 6 Jahren) ein Lächeln aufs Gesicht zaubert.

Wenn Sie gerne kochen, ein Herz für Kinder haben und einen abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsplatz suchen, an dem Ihre eigenen Ideen und Ihre Kochkunst gefragt sind – dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!

Ihre Aufgaben:
• Für leckeres Essen sorgen: Zubereitung gesunder, kindgerechter Mahlzeiten (teilweise frische Zubereitung, teilweise Fertigstellung bereits zubereiteter Speisen).
• Kreativ planen: Erstellung abwechslungsreicher und ausgewogener Speisepläne.
• Ganz nah dran sein: Mithilfe bei der Essensausgabe direkt an unsere Kinder.
• Organisieren: Planung und Erledigung der Lebensmitteleinkäufe.
• Gute Seele im Hintergrund: Übernahme des Wäschedienstes (z. B. Handtücher) und weiterer hauswirtschaftlicher Tätigkeiten rund um die Küche.
• Sauberkeit garantieren: Einhaltung aller Hygienevorschriften und Standards der Lebensmittelsicherheit (HACCP) .

Das bringen Sie mit:
• Leidenschaft: Sie kochen aus Leidenschaft und haben große Freude am Umgang mit Kindern im Kita-Alter.
• Zuverlässigkeit: Eine strukturierte, saubere und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise ist für Sie selbstverständlich.
• Teamgeist: Sie sind aufgeschlossen, herzlich und arbeiten gerne Hand in Hand mit unserem pädagogischen Team.

Das bieten wir Ihnen:
• Teilzeitvertrag
• Arbeitszeiten: Montag bis Freitag von ca.10:30 Uhr bis ca.12:30 Uhr.
• Abwechslungsreiches Modell: Der Rhythmus sieht aktuell vor, dass Sie in einer Woche an 2 Tagen und in der Folgewoche an 3 Tagen arbeiten. Die genaue Aufteilung kann aber noch flexibel mit Ihnen vereinbart werden!
• Raum für Ideen: Ein kreativer Arbeitsplatz, an dem Sie den Speiseplan aktiv mitgestalten können.

Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We have recently reached an important milestone of 1B+ downloads worldwide, moving closer to our mission of supporting people on their self-improvement journeys.

At Radiotech, we believe music belongs to everyone - not just those who grew up taking lessons. As a product company inside the Gismart ecosystem, we've spent years building apps that make music feel approachable, fun, and deeply human. With 23 apps across iOS and Android and over 500 million downloads worldwide, our products have found their way into the hands of musicians, beginners, and curious souls across the globe. We see music as a universal language. Our job is to make sure more people can speak it.

  • Develop, maintain, and modernize existing iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit.

  • Define and evolve the architecture of the iOS codebase with a focus on scalability, modularization, and maintainability.

  • Design and implement efficient, testable technical solutions.

  • Prepare existing applications for gradual adoption of Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).

  • Participate in the migration of selected business logic and shared components to KMP.

  • Collaborate with Android and other engineers on shared mobile architecture and APIs.

  • Research technical challenges and propose appropriate architectural solutions.

  • Troubleshoot complex issues and optimize application performance and memory usage.

  • Perform code reviews and contribute to technical documentation.

  • Maintain and improve CI/CD and release workflows.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers on technical solutions, planning, and estimation.

  • Proactively suggest technical and product improvements.

  • Use AI coding tools and engineering agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar as part of the regular development workflow.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional iOS development experience.

  • Strong proficiency in Swift and modern language features.

  • Strong experience with Swift Concurrency (async/await) and reactive programming such as Combine.

  • Production experience with both SwiftUI and UIKit.

  • Strong understanding of iOS architecture, application lifecycle, and platform frameworks.

  • Experience with MVVM, Clean Architecture, modular architecture, and reusable components.

  • Ability to independently design and implement complex technical solutions.

  • Familiarity with Xcode, Instruments, SPM, CocoaPods, and Fastlane.

  • Understanding of App Store submission, signing, provisioning, TestFlight, and release management.

  • Experience with feature flags, remote configuration, and A/B testing.

  • Experience with CI/CD and automated testing.

  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants and engineering agents in daily development.

  • Mental and Physical Health: To help you stay happy and healthy, Gismart will partially cover your medical insurance, sports activities, therapy costs.

  • Time-Off Policy: Every employee gets 18 working days of paid vacation and 3 personal days per year, with an extra day added for each year at Gismart.

jobs.title: Vil du lede et driftsteknikerteam med varierte og spennende arbeidsdager?
jobs.description:
I Coop Øst er det stor aktivitet, og spesielt i vår avdeling for butikk- og eiendomsutvikling skjer det mye. Vår driftstekniker og innleide vaktmestere har ansvar for den daglige oppfølgingen våre 52 egeneiende eiendommer. For å møte veksten og den økte aktiviteten søker vi nå en teamleder.

Som teamleder vil du få ansvar for eget team med driftsteknikere/innleide vaktmestere, samtidig som du har ansvar for egen eiendomsportefølje på lik linje med de øvrige driftsteknikerne. Rollen passer for deg som trives med å kombinere praktisk og operativ eiendomsdrift med faglig oppfølging, planlegging, koordinering og teamlederansvar.

Butikk- og eiendomsutvikling i Coop Øst har ansvar for forvaltning og vedlikehold av våre butikker og eiendommer. Avdelingen teller 16 engasjerte ansatte med lang fartstid i bedriften, og det er 82 ansatte på hovedkontoret totalt. Per i dag forvalter Coop Øst ca. 287 000 m² eiendom med butikkdrift. Vi eier 52 eiendommer med butikkdrift (totalt 100 500 m²) som skal forvaltes og utvikles. Som teamleder for driftsteknikerne blir du en sentral bidragsyter i å sikre god struktur, effektiv ressursbruk og høy kvalitet i den operative eiendomsdriften.

Søknadsfrist: 20.10.2026
Søkere vurderes fortløpende.

Hva skal du gjøre?
Som teamleder vil du både jobbe med egen portefølje og ha et tydelig teamlederansvar for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere. Du vil følge opp teamet og bidra til god planlegging og koordinering, samtidig som du sikrer at oppgaver prioriteres og løses på en strukturert måte. Rollen innebærer praktisk arbeid ute på eiendommene og daglig drift og tilsyn. Du vil ha oppfølging av tekniske anlegg, følge opp eksterne leverandører og serviceavtaler, samt gi bistand ved ombygginger, oppgraderinger og prosjekter. I tillegg vil du være en tydelig faglig ressurs og koordinator for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere, bidra til god fremdrift i oppgavene og sørge for at avdelingen har oversikt over status, behov og prioriteringer. Du vil ha en viktig rolle i å bidra til sikker, kostnadseffektiv og forutsigbar drift av eiendommene, samtidig som du skaper gode rammer for teamet ditt.

Coop Øst har hovedkontor på Kolbotn og eget lager for verktøy og utstyrrett i nærheten. Du må påregne reisevirksomhet mellom våre ulike eiendommer. Dette er en selvstendig og mobil rolle hvor du primært vil jobbe ute med egen eiendomsportefølje og samtidig skal bidra til å planlegge, koordinere og følge opp arbeidsoppgavene i teamet.

Hva ønsker vi av deg?

  • Vi ønsker at du har yrkesfaglig bakgrunn, gjerne som tømrer, elektriker eller rørlegger eller er driftstekniker i dag. 
  • Det er en fordel med erfaring fra drift og vedlikehold av næringseiendom.
  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav. Førerkort klasse BE er påkrevd for stillingen. Kandidater som ikke har BE ved ansettelse må være villige til å gjennomføre og bestå førerprøven for klasse BE innen avtalt tid.
  • Det er viktig med gode samarbeidsevner og at du trives med en utadrettet og selvstendig arbeidshverdag.
  • I Coop Øst er vi opptatt av et godt arbeidsmiljø og det å være serviceinnstilt over dine kollegaer og våre samarbeidspartnere legger vi stor vekt på.
  • For god og grundig utførelsen av denne jobben er viktig å være strukturert og løsningsorientert


Hva kan du få hos oss?
Coop Øst er et fremoverlent samvirkelag hvor det skjer mye. Vi er opptatt av å utvikle våre ansatte og legger til rette for at du skal trives og få både den støtten og det faglige påfyllet som trengs hos oss. Du kommer inn i et godt onboardingsprogram og vil oppleve at hovedkontoret består av mange serviceinnstilte og hjelpsomme kollegaer. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktig lønn, telefonordning, arbeidsbil, helseforsikring og tilgang til firmahytter får du også. Som medeier og ansatt i Coop Øst får du 6% ansattrabatt/kjøpeutbytte. Ikke minst vil du få mange engasjerte og skikkelig dyktige kollegaer og jobb i et solid selskap. Vi tror det er bra å jobbe hos oss og vi vil ta godt vare på deg i Coop Øst. 

Coop Øst bruker sertifiserte arbeidspsykologiske testverktøy fra Assessio i rekrutteringsprosessen.
Vi benytter SEMAC bakgrunnssjekk på aktuelle kandidater.

Hvis dette er noe for deg gleder vi oss til å se eller lese søknaden din:-)

Kundene våre gjenspeiler befolkingen og det vil vi at våre ansatte også skal gjøre. Vi er opptatt av mangfold og ønsker alle søkere velkommen, uansett bakgrunn, erfaring, funksjonsevne, kjønn, legning eller religion. Coop Øst ønsker å være en arbeidsgiver for alle.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Coop Øst SA er Norges største samvirkelag med en omsetning på 10,2 milliarder i 2025. Vi har ca. 4400 ansatte og 211 butikker i de 5 fylkene Østfold, Akershus, Oslo, Buskerud og Innlandet med hovedkontor på Kolbotn i Nordre Follo. Coop har 6 kjedekonsepter; Coop Prix, Coop Mega, EXTRA, Matkroken, Obs og Obs BYGG. Coop er den eneste aktøren innen detaljhandel som er eid av forbrukerne og baserer sin drift på delingsøkonomi og utbytte til alle medeiere. Coop er opptatt av bærekraft, og omtanke for mennesker, dyr og miljø blir stadig viktigere for oss. Derfor jobber vi kontinuerlig med å redusere vår klima- og miljøpåvirkning. Vi har blant annet en nullvisjon for kasting av mat og fokus på bærekraftige produkter. For å lese mer se www.coop.no/coop-og-barekraft

jobs.title: Join us in our mission to find new ways of protecting neurons from neurodegeneration!
jobs.description:
About the position

We are looking for a highly motivated researcher to join our team at the Department of Microbiology, at the Institute of Clinical Medicine at the University of Oslo. The position will be associated with the young research group “Mitonuclear DNA Maintenance and Transcriptional Control“ and will be working on the Research Council of Norway funded research project “MIND: Mitochondria-Initiated Neuronal Defense against Parkinson’s Disease”.

The position is for 2 years, from 1st of January 2027. Start date is negotiable.


More about the position

This position offers a unique opportunity to help uncover how DNA repair and mitochondrial transcription shape neuronal resilience in Parkinson’s disease. You will be the main experimental researcher of Work Package 2, where we develop and apply a human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) based model of midbrain dopaminergic neurons and midbrain organoids. Using patient-derived iPSCs carrying an alpha-synuclein (SNCA) triplication and isogenic controls, you will investigate how loss of DNA repair enzymes alters mitochondrial transcription, alpha-syn aggregation, and neuronal survival.

The project explores a new idea in Parkinson’s disease (PD): that certain types of DNA repair deficiency can activate protective mitochondrial and transcriptional responses in neurons, rather than only causing damage. We focus on the DNA base excision repair (BER) enzymes and how their loss affects mitochondrial function, α-synuclein aggregation, and survival of dopaminergic neurons.

You will be employed at the Department of Microbiology, which is jointly affiliated with the University of Oslo and Oslo University Hospital. The institute hosts a strong but very social environment, with access to advanced core facilities. The research section in the department has 15 research groups and 6 project groups (https://www.ous-research.no/microbiology/) working in various fields, including brain cancer, microbiology, epigenetics causes of disease, as well as groups focusing on bioinformatics.

The department will be located in the new life science building from January 2027 located near Forskningsparken with easy access by public transport (metro, tram, and bus), bicycle routes. You will work in an international, interdisciplinary environment with close collaboration across research groups in Oslo and with our partners at the University of Edinburgh.


Why we are seeking a researcher

Parkinson’s disease is one of the fastest-growing neurodegenerative disorders worldwide, yet current treatments are not disease-modifying. The MIND project challenges the traditional view that mitochondrial DNA damage is purely detrimental and explores how specific DNA repair defects may activate protective transcriptional programs in neurons. We are seeking a researcher who can take a leading experimental role in WP2: to establish and characterize our human iPSC-derived midbrain dopaminergic neuron model and to dissect how DNA repair-dependent changes in mitochondrial and nuclear transcription contribute to neuroprotection against alpha-syn–induced stress.

You will work closely with the principal investigator Dr. Nicola Pietro Montaldo, Prof. Hilde Loge Nilsen (UiO/OUH), and Prof. Tilo Kunath (University of Edinburgh).

If you are excited by the idea of discovering new neuronal self-defense programs, reshaping how we think about DNA repair and mitochondrial stress in Parkinson’s disease, and contributing to future therapeutic strategies, we encourage you to apply.


Your main tasks will be

Culture of iPSCs and Dopaminergic neurons:

  • Establish differentiation protocol for human neuronal cultures
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC-derived midbrain progenitors into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Validate neuronal identity and midbrain/dopaminergic markers using immunocytochemistry and RT-qPCR

Model Parkinson’s disease in vitro:

  • Work with a defined panel of iPSC lines: A patient line with SNCA (α-synuclein) triplication (high α-syn levels and aggregation) Isogenic SNCA-corrected controls (reduced or no α-syn expression).Lines with BER knockout on the SNCA triplication background
  • Measure α-syn and phospho-α-syn (pSer129) levels and aggregation (Western blot, ELISA, immunofluorescence)
  • Use seed amplification assays to investigate spreading of misfolded α-syn species
  • Assess mitochondrial function and stress responses
  • Measure mitochondrial respiration (OCR), ATP production and responses to mitochondrial stressors such as MPP+
  • Analyze mitochondrial DNA integrity and basic nuclear DNA damage responses
  • Contribute to transcriptional and data-driven analyses
  • Prepare samples for RNA-seq and other omics readouts
  • Work with the PI and collaborators on basic analysis and interpretation of differential gene expression and pathway changes.

Functional readouts of neuronal health:

  •  Use microelectrode array (MEA) recordings (Maestro Pro Platform) to monitor neuronal network activity and relate this to α-syn load and mitochondrial status.

What you will gain:

  • Hands-on experience with human iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons and state-of-the-art PD models
  • Training in mitochondrial biology, DNA repair, and transcriptional regulation in neurons
  • Access to advanced infrastructure (imaging, MEA, sequencing, high-performance computing)
  • Close collaboration with leading groups in DNA repair (Nilsen), PD/iPSC modeling (Kunath), and a growing national BER network (BER Norway)
  • Opportunities to co-author publications and present your work at national and international meetings.

What skills are important in this role?

 Required qualifications:

  • A PhD (or equivalent) in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, neuroscience, biotechnology, or a closely related field
  • Documented experience with mammalian cell culture and standard sterile techniques, including primary cells, neuronal progenitor cells, and/or 3D/organoid cultures
  • Solid competence in core molecular and cell biology methods, such as: DNA / RNA extraction, PCR / qPCR / RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunohistochemistry / immunocytochemistry / immunofluorescence with associated fluorescence microscopy
  • Experience with multicolor flow cytometry and functional cellular or immune assays
  • Hands-on experience preparing high-quality samples for next-generation sequencing (NGS), ideally including single-cell or single-nucleus RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq) from complex tissues, together with standard quality-control metrics (e.g. Qubit, TapeStation)
  • Experience coordinating wet-lab work with bioinformatics and sequencing core facilities, and developing, optimizing, and documenting laboratory workflows
  • Experience with human iPSC-derived models, midbrain organoids, and/or neuronal differentiation (dopaminergic or other CNS lineages preferred
  • Good understanding of experimental design, protocol development and optimization, data documentation, reproducibility, and basic statistical analysis
  • Good written and oral communication skills in English
  • Ability to work independently at the bench while coordinating effectively with principal investigators, bioinformaticians, core facilities, and collaborators.

    • α-synuclein biology (expression, aggregation, or toxicity assays)   
  • Experience with mitochondrial biology, e.g.: 
    • Measuring oxygen consumption rate (OCR) or related metabolic assays
    • Working with mitochondrial toxins
  • Familiarity with bioinformatics / scripting (R, Python, or similar)
  • Microelectrode array (MEA) or other electrophysiological recordings (an advantage, not a requirement)

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Special Needs Education
jobs.description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year position as a Postdoctoral Fellow emphasizing research on special needs education for students with neurodevelopmental disorders. The position is to be based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo. 

In 2024, Norway implemented a change to the Education Act, adjusting the criteria used to allocate extra resources for children with special needs. This project will evaluate the impact of this legislative change on children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), focusing specifically on their transition from kindergarten to formal schooling, and their subsequent academic outcomes. 

To capture both pre- and post-reform conditions, the project will combine secondary and primary data. For the pre-reform period, the applicant will draw primarily on existing Norwegian data sources such as cohort studies and/or relevant national registries, which can be linked as appropriate to the research questions. The applicant will be responsible for identifying the most suitable data source(s) for the pre-reform period and applying for the necessary data access and approvals. The applicant will then collect new primary data to capture the post-reform period. 

Within this structure, the applicant has flexibility in developing the proposal to include the specific data source(s) and academic outcomes to be examined, in line with their own research interests. The significance and rationale for the selected data source(s) and outcomes should be well detailed and justified within the project description. The applicant is expected to outline plans for data collection, as well as the methodological and analytical approaches envisioned. The fellow will also be expected to apply for relevant ethical approvals, collect primary data, conduct data analysis, plan the scientific publications that are part of the fellowship, as well as be first-author on the agreed upon publications.


More about the position

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years, with 10 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will consist of presentation of project data at national and international conferences, authorship on scientific publications, potential supervision of Master and PhD candidates, and the possibilities of completing certification in Higher Education Pedagogy. Given that the position includes own data collection, the candidate is expected to be located in Oslo.

Depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended up to four years, with 25 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will in this case for example consist of various teaching tasks and obligations.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Special Needs Education, Psychology, or other relevant fields. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated knowledge about neurodevelopmental disabilities
  • Demonstrated knowledge in quantitative statistical analyses and data management. More specifically, strong quantitative skills and experience in applying quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-difference, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series) to evaluate policy or intervention effects
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with one of the following statistical programming softwares (Stata, R, Mplus or similar) is required
  • Strong scientific writing skills and a track record of peer-reviewed publication is required

The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • Experience with longitudinal quantitative methods will be considered a strength and emphasized
  • Demonstrated knowledge in empirical data collection will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Experience with large datasets will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Previous research experience, especially related to neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD, special education, or developmental psychology is considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Mastery of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage

Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Execution capability
  • Adaptability and flexibility
  • Good attention to detail and rigour

We need different perspectives in our work

How to apply

jobs.description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a three-year researcher position (80%) at the Institute of Health and Society as part of a Global Health research project, "Preventing Severe Hypertensive Adverse Events in Pregnancy and Childbirth" (PRESHA). The position is part of a new Norwegian Research Council-funded project (Research Projects for Scientific Renewal – Global Health) led by Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg at the University of Oslo. Intended starting date for the position is Autumn 2026. 

The appointment is a part-time 80% position and is made for a period of up to three years. The researcher will work closely with Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.

The candidate is welcome to participate in building a long-term research program with particular emphasis on thematic areas fitting within a broader perspective on global women’s health across the life course.


More about the project

The PRESHA project is an ambitious project that aims to prevent maternal and perinatal death and disability due to pre-eclampsia in low-resource settings through improved prediction, prevention and clinical management. The project takes place in Mwanza, Tanzania. The official project period is from 2023-2028. The project partners are from Norway, Tanzania and the Netherlands. The project is unique in that it combines the introduction of biomarker PlGF/Sflt-1 for pre-eclampsia prediction with strengthening the organization of existing care processes. We will use a combination of disciplines and innovative methodological approaches to explore existing implementation challenges and co-create, implement and evaluate a package of interventions for prevention and management of pre-eclampsia that is adapted and relevant to the Tanzanian context.

For more information about the project, or further inquiries about the position please contact Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.


Your main tasks will be: 

The researcher will have a central role in the implementation phase of PRESHA, while also conducting analyses of cohort data. Key responsibilities include:

Research position

  • Lead the day-to-day coordination of the implementation phase in close collaboration with partners in Tanzania, the Netherlands and Norway.
  • Organize and support implementation of the PRESHA quality-of-care package (PRESHA-QoC), including training, supervision, co-creation workshops and audit cycles.
  • Coordinate the stepped-wedge implementation of biomarker-based risk prediction (PRESHA‑TRIAL) across participating facilities.
  • Oversee timelines, documentation, reporting, ethics renewals and regulatory requirements related to the implementation phase.
  • Facilitate communication between clinical teams, research staff, community partners and the international study group.
  • Contribute to data quality assurance, protocol adherence and monitoring of implementation processes.
  • Analyze cohort data related to the social determinants of health and their impact on outcomes related to hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
  • Lead and co-author scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Contribute to methodological innovation in implementation research.
  • Work closely with the PI and team on developing and writing research grant applications (e.g. for project extension, new related studies).

Engage in dissemination, policy briefs and knowledge translation activities towards Tanzanian and international stakeholders.


Qualification requirements 

Qualification requirements

  • A PhD (or equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree) in global health, public health, epidemiology, medical sciences, social sciences with strong health focus, or a closely related field. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved.
  • Documented experience with mixed-methods research (both quantitative and qualitative).
  • Strong skills in quantitative analysis, preferably including:
    • cohort or longitudinal data analysis
    • regression modelling
    • handling of routine health dataexperience with statistical software (e.g. Stata, R, or similar).
  • Experience with qualitative methods (e.g. interviews, focus groups, observations) in health research.
  • Demonstrated interest in or experience with implementation research, quality improvement or health systems research.
  • Familiarity with maternal health, hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, or related fields in global women’s health.
  • Familiarity with the thematic areas of the project and the complexity of maternal health is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English is required.

Desired qualifications

  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language and/or Kiswahili would be an asset.
  • Previous experience working East Africa/sub-Saharan Africa and in multidisciplinary and international teams will be an advantage.
  • Experience with social determinants of health, food security, or equity-focused analyses in health research is particularly desirable.
  • Experience in grant writing or participation in funding applications is an advantage.
  • Demonstrating previous experience of working with mixed-methods research, implementation research and working in a multidisciplinary team in low-resource settings would be an advantage. 

Personal skills

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is highly motivated to pursue an academic career.
  • Can work independently and systematically, while being an engaged team player.
  • Has strong organizational and project management skills and can handle complex coordination tasks across partners and countries.
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can communicate effectively with clinicians, researchers, students, community representatives and policymakers.
  • Can take initiative and demonstrate strong, equitable and shared leadership skills in an international, multidisciplinary environment, fostering co‑ownership among partners 
  • Is willing and able to spend longer periods in Tanzania (e.g. for fieldwork, coordination and collaboration).

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description
 

As a member of one of our platform engineering squads, you will leverage your experience and expertise to design and develop cloud-based solutions. This means implementing massively scalable services, automating all system operations, measuring and continuously improving service quality, and making the lives of other developers easier. 

You will play a key role in helping our product reach its next stage of evolution and delight our users and customers. 


What you will do

  • Develop, enhance, and operate cloud solutions on AWS with a focus on automation, high performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.

  • Take part in the definition of novel cloud solution designs and lead their development.

  • Work in sprints with other engineers (backend, frontend, SRE, and other CPEs) as part of a cross-functional team to deliver new features into production. 

  • Collaborate with other squads in Product Development and Mission Control to ensure solutions fit into the Sonar platform.

  • Contribute to your squad’s efforts in operating its services through, i.e., definition and upkeeping SLOs, investigate alarms and respond to incidents to maintain a high quality of service.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Must Have: 

  • 2+ years of experience with architecting, developing, and operating cloud solutions on AWS for Web/API applications.

  • Knowledge of AWS networking and the following core AWS services: CloudFront, CloudWatch, ECS, Lambda, RDS, andSNS, SQS. 

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with at least one of the following tools: AWS CDK (preferred), AWS CloudFormation or Terraform/OpenTofu.

  • Experience with at least one scripting language such as Bash or similar.

  • Experience with on-call for operating global services.

  • Experience working in an agile environment.

  • Strong DevOps mindset.

  • Proficiency with Ansible or other IaC solutions.

  • Experience with distributed application architecture and development.

  • AWS Developer Associate Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, or other valid, relevant AWS certifications.

  • Experience with one or more programming languages such as Python (preferred), Java, or similar.

  • Experience with AI enablement platform.

    This role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Risk Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Swissblock is a private investment firm dedicated to cross-asset investing. We employ a systematic framework that integrates robust algorithmic trading with exhaustive market analysis. We manage a diverse range of multi-strategy portfolios across all major asset classes through dedicated teams, including purely systematic groups.

The Role:

We’re building the risk infrastructure for our traditional-financing trading groups from the ground up, and we’re looking for a Senior Quantitative Risk Manager to help shape it. You’ll report to the Head of Risk, work closely with portfolio managers and engineers.

Location

Switzerland (role can be based anywhere in Switzerland). Our office is based in Baar, Zug. Hyrbid with the option to work from home up to four days a week.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Build the risk engine: VaR/CVaR, stress testing, and scenario analysis across all strategies
  • Co-design the limit framework with the Head of Risk
  • Independently validate systematic strategies
  • Own daily monitoring and escalation of market, liquidity, and counterparty risk, and produce the daily and monthly risk reports
  • Develop AI-assisted risk workflows with clear guardrails and human sign-off
  • Bring the risk perspective to new products, strategies and firm-wide projects


What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years in quantitative or investment risk at a hedge fund, proprietary trading firm, or multi-strategy platform; Bank market-risk experience covering trading books is also welcome
  • A degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, engineering, economics or finance. An MSc or PhD preferred, and FRM, CFA, CQF is a plus
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of VaR, CVaR, stress and scenario analysis, backtesting, including their limitations
  • A solid grasp of equities, fixed income, FX, commodities/energy, and credit, including their derivatives
  • Production-quality Python and solid SQL, and experience working in shared codebase with version control and CI/CD
  • Experience designing and implementing risk management frameworks
  • Initiative, the ability to work independently and the drive to automate processes where it adds value and reliability
    A collaborative approach in a small, hands-on team
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken), German is an advantage


Why Swissblock?

At Swissblock, we provide a dynamic and diverse environment with flat hierarchies and excellent colleagues. As a profitable company, our culture is built on responsibility and performance, with empowerment as a core value. This is reflected in career opportunities that grow alongside the company.

What we offer

  • Ownership & impact: A collaborative, high-ownership environment and excellent colleagues
  • Growth & development: Empowerment and career development that grows with the business
  • Remote-friendly culture: Modern office in Baar, Switzerland, with the flexibility to work remotely
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation, including a performance-based annual bonus
  • Time off: 25 days of paid leave
  • Community: Regular company events
  • Benefits: Progressive social benefits
