jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja
jobs.description:
Kangasalla palkitseva ja kannustava työilmapiiri ovat työssä viihtymisen ja onnistumisen kulmakiviä. Hyvä työilmapiiri säteilee hyvää koko kaupunkiin. Meillä Kangasalla arvostetaan oman osaamisen ja työyhteisön kehittämistä, joten kaupunki tarjoaa paljon koulutusmahdollisuuksia. Meillä saa kokeilla, onnistua ja erehtyä. Kaikista kokeiluista opimme uutta. Me tuemme ja kannustamme sinua pitämään huolta itsestäsi niin työssä kuin vapaa-ajallakin. Työhyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi meillä on käytössä uintietuus Kangasalan uimahallissa, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaetuus (Epassi) sekä hyvät ennaltaehkäisevät työterveyshuoltopalvelut. Kangasalan kaupungille on neljännen kerran myönnetty Hyvän mielen työpaikka -merkki, joka kuvaa tekemäämme työtä henkilöstömme mielen hyvinvoinnin saralla.

Avoinna oleva määräaikainen liikunnanohjaajan tehtävä ajalle 2.11.2026-31.7.2028 sijoittuu sivistyskeskukseen, hyvinvointi- ja vapaa-aikapalveluiden palvelualueelle. Hyvinvointi- ja vapaa-aikapalveluiden palvelualueeseen kuuluu kirjasto-, kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja nuorisopalvelut, hyvinvoinnin ja terveyden edistäminen sekä taiteen perusopetus ja kansalaisopistopalvelut.

Liikuntapalvelut edistää kaupunkilaisten kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia ja motivoi heitä liikunnalliseen elämäntapaan. Liikunnanohjaajan tehtäviin kuuluu liikunnanohjaus, liikuntaneuvonta, kouluyhteistyö, liikuntatilojen tilavarausten hallinnointi sekä erilaiset tapahtumat. Liikunnanohjaus tapahtuu eri toimintaympäristöissä sisältäen myös sosiaalisen median kanavat.

Hakijalta edellytetään liikunnanohjaajan tutkintoa (AMK), liikuntaneuvojan tutkintoa tai muuta vastaavaa soveltuvaa alan koulutusta. Työ vaatii itsenäistä työotetta sekä hyviä organisointi- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Työtehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Työaika on 38,25 h/vko. Palkkaus on KVTESin mukainen ja tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2700,00 €/kk. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Työ- ja opiskelutodistukset tarkistetaan mahdollisessa haastattelutilaisuudessa. Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikostaustaote ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista.

Hakemukset pyydetään jättämään 21.10.2026 klo 15 mennessä. Rekrytointikeskustelut pyritään järjestämään viikolla 44.

Liity hyvän piiriin ja tule töihin Kangasalle!

Mikäli muutat Kangasalle kauempaa, autamme mielellämme vuokra-asunnon haussa.

jobs.title: AI Lead, Marine
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Lead for the Marine Business Unit to take ownership of Marine-specific AI development and turn business and engineering needs into practical solutions.

As part of the Marine Business Unit strategy, we are increasing our focus on artificial intelligence to improve competitiveness, efficiency, engineering processes, and ways of working. The role bridges technology, engineering and business, turning Marine challenges into AI-driven solutions and leading initiatives from idea to implementation.

Your role and the team

As our Marine AI Lead, you will drive the adoption and development of AI solutions across our Marine Business Unit. You will identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical development initiatives, and lead projects from concept to implementation. You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions
- Driving and prioritizing a strong pipeline of AI initiatives
- Making informed technology and development decisions
- Improving engineering productivity and processes through AI
- Creating competitive advantage through Marine-specific AI applications

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

This position can be based in Turku or Espoo. Please let us know your preferred location in your application.

What helps you succeed in this role

- Relevant educational background
- Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, and AIOps
- Hands-on experience in developing and implementing AI solutions
- Experience in maritime, shipbuilding, engineering, CAD/CAE, PLM, or other industrial environments is an advantage
- Ability to turn business and engineering needs into practical technical solutions
- Understanding of software development, system architectures, integrations, and data flows
- Strong project ownership, collaboration, and communication skills
- A curious, pragmatic, and business-oriented mindset

What we promise you

Interesting and challenging projects with a team that supports each other. Modern tools. Hybrid working flexibility to balance work and free time. Training and mentoring to help you grow, and our warm EloWe culture built on respect, equality, kindness, and support.

Learn more about us: [Visions of Tomorrow, Engineered Today - Elomatic](https://www.elomatic.com/)
Get to know your future colleagues: [Meet Us! videos](https://www.youtube.com/@ElomaticOy/shorts)

Please share your thoughts regarding salary expectations in your application. Our compensation aligns with trade union recommendations and reflects your future role, capabilities and skills, working experience and specialization. Additionally, we offer versatile employee benefits, including comprehensive insurance and support for sports and cultural activities.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

If you share our values and are ready for this exciting opportunity, apply with your CV and cover letter in English or Finnish by October 11th at the latest. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and working styles, because different perspectives make us stronger. We review applications continuously and are ready to start interviews during the application period.

For more information, feel free to contact us on Fridays between 8-11

Director, Digital Transformation: Nico Lehtinen, +358504530901 or nico.lehtinen@elomatic.com #_msocom_1

And remember to follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/elomaticoy/) and [LinkedIn!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/elomatic/)

___________________________________________________________________________

Building tomorrow. Elomatic is an international consulting and engineering company dedicated to creating solutions that improve the wellbeing of people and the environment. With over 50 years of experience, we are known as pioneers in the development of design methods. Our 1,300 professionals provide exceptional value across the entire life cycles of products, services, and digital solutions.

What we do

Elomatic specializes in

- Marine
- Pharma, and
- Industry, covering process and energy industries, machinery, and equipment manufacturing.

We offer a comprehensive range of services, including engineering and consulting, project management, technical analysis and visualization, as well as product and service development. Additionally, we deliver products and overall solutions that complement our core services.

jobs.title: Would you like to help shape the next chapter of Aimo Park’s commercial development?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Commercial Director who will take a key position in Aimo Park Norway’s management team, with a clear mandate to strengthen the commercial organisation and drive further profitable growth.

The role:

As Commercial Director, you will have overall responsibility for New Business in Norway and lead the commercial sales team. You will identify new market opportunities, develop strong customer and partner relationships, and contribute to the development and commercialisation of new services, concepts and business models.

The role spans strategy and execution. You will develop the sales strategy, drive structured sales processes, identify new revenue opportunities and play a key role in major tenders, contract negotiations and commercial discussions. You will also work closely with colleagues across Operations, Finance, Legal, Technology and Marketing.

An important part of your mandate will be to further develop the commercial function - its people, processes and ways of working - ensuring that the organisation is equipped for continued growth.

You have:
  • a university degree in Business, Economics or equivalent
  • a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience with a proven track record in commercial roles
  • solid experience in B2B sales and business development
  • proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and lead a commercial team
  • experience in strategic sales and in translating strategy into tangible commercial results
  • strong commercial and financial acumen
  • experience with complex customer processes, contracts and negotiations
  • an analytical approach and the ability to use data and market insight to identify opportunities for growth and profitability
  • excellent communication skills in both Norwegian and English, written and spoken
It is an advantage if you have:
  • experience from real estate or other transaction- and contract-intensive businesses
  • relevant industry experience
  • experience in developing and commercialising new services, concepts or business models
  • experience with partnerships and the development of new revenue streams
Who are you?

We believe you are self-driven, curious and results-oriented, with the ability to see both the bigger picture and what it takes to turn opportunities into tangible results.

You are comfortable challenging established ways of working, while doing so constructively. You build trust, bring people with you and combine analytical strength with creativity and commercial instinct. Most importantly, you are motivated by creating and developing, rather than simply managing what already exists.

Why Aimo Park?

At Aimo Park, you get the strength and stability of an established market leader - combined with the opportunities of a market undergoing rapid transformation.

Digitalisation, changing customer expectations and evolving business models are reshaping both parking and mobility, creating significant new commercial opportunities.

You will have considerable influence, short decision-making paths and a genuine opportunity to help define how Aimo Park will grow and compete in the years ahead.

 

Location: Oslo
Application deadline: 8 November 2026

 

Aimo Park is partnering with Jefferson Wells for this recruitment. For further information about the position, please contact Senior Advisor Kristine Bugge Lie Owe at Jefferson Wells at Kristine.owe@jeffersonwells.no or +47 40 72 40 05.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Aimo Park is a leading provider of parking and mobility solutions in Norway - and a trusted partner to property owners across the country. With a strong market position, solid financial foundation and a continuous focus on developing new digital solutions and services, we have a strong platform for growth. Now, we are ready for the next step.

jobs.title: Seasonal hotel cleaners / Hotellisiivoojia talvisesonkiin, Kemi
jobs.description:
Our team is looking for

SERVICE PROVIDERS TO HOTEL CLEANING FOR WINTER SEASON 2026-2027 IN KEMI

At SOL, job satisfaction and a supportive atmosphere are of utmost importance to us. Our operations are guided by sunny customer satisfaction, everyday creativity, entrepreneurship, reliability, and joyful working. If these values resonate with you, you might be the person we are looking for!

As a Service Provider, your duties will include cleaning hotel rooms. You will be independently responsible for your own floor and rooms, ensuring cleanliness and high hygiene standards according to Nordic Swan Ecolabel criteria. You will work in a multicultural environment, and communication within the work community is mainly in English. The work is physical and requires good tolerance for pressure.

What we expect from you?

- You must be of legal age (18+).

- Flexibility with varying working hours.

- Motivation and willingness to commit to quality work.

- Good interaction skills, as you will communicate with both the work community and customers.

- Sufficient English language skills to ensure safety and quality training. Finnish skills are considered a plus.

Earlier experience from cleaning and / or degree is considered a plus but not necessary.

Non-EU/EEA applicants must already hold a valid residence/work permit that allows employment in Finland.

What we offer you:

- Comprehensive orientation and training.

- Support from a tight-knit work community.

- SOL Life program to support well-being and occupational safety.

Salary, working hours, and employment relationship

- Employment is temporary and part-time seasonal work. The contract starts on November 23, 2026, and ends on April 4, 2027. The possibility for continuation can be assessed in the spring.

- Working hours vary according to occupancy rate approximately 20–30 hours per week. Shifts are scheduled between Monday and Sunday, between 8 AM and 4 PM (08–16).

- Salary: In accordance with the collective agreement for the facilities services sector, pay group 3 (13,22 €/h) for housekeeping tasks.

Interested? Great!

Please apply by filling out our online application form. Please note that we only process applications received through our recruitment system. We value skills and workmanship. We ensure strong know-how with custom introductions to work, internal trainings as well as institutional cooperation. Advancement is possible through various career paths. Your own supervisor and the whole team offer you encouragement and support in your work.

Happy working and encouraging ethos are important to us at SOL. With our SOL Life program, we develop work well-being and invest in the work safety of our employees.

We value diversity in the workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of different ages and genders, as well as those who belong to linguistic, cultural, or other minority groups.

jobs.title: MECÂNICO E REPARADOR DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRÓNICOS
jobs.description:
Procuramos técnico(a) de reparação para integrar a nossa equipa na loja RM Tech Store (RM Mobiles and Laptops Repairing), especializada na reparação e manutenção de smartphones, tablets e outros equipamentos de comunicação.

FUNÇÕES:
- Diagnóstico e reparação de smartphones e tablets (todas as marcas: iPhone, Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, entre outras);
- Substituição de ecrãs, baterias, conectores de carga, câmaras, altifalantes e outros componentes;
- Reparação ao nível da placa (board-level repair), incluindo soldadura de microcomponentes SMD e substituição de ICs;
- Instalação e atualização de sistemas operativos (iOS, Android), firmware e software especializado;
- Recuperação de dados e desbloqueio de equipamentos (dentro do enquadramento legal);
- Diagnóstico de problemas de hardware e software com recurso a ferramentas específicas;
- Atendimento presencial ao cliente, receção de equipamentos para reparação, elaboração de orçamentos e explicação técnica ao cliente;
- Emissão de faturas e recibos através do software de faturação da loja;
- Gestão de garantias em conformidade com o Decreto-Lei 84/2021;
- Comunicação com fornecedores internacionais de peças de substituição (principalmente Ásia).

PERFIL DESEJADO:
- Mínimo 2 anos de experiência comprovada em reparação de smartphones e tablets;
- Experiência efetiva em reparação ao nível da placa (soldadura BGA, substituição de ICs, uso de estação de rework);
- Conhecimento de ferramentas de diagnóstico e programação (JC Pro, Magico, Chimera, Octoplus ou similares);
- Experiência em atendimento ao público em ambiente de retalho;
- Domínio de inglês para comunicação técnica com fornecedores;
- Fluência em urdu ou tagalo será valorizada para comunicação com fornecedores de componentes na Ásia;
- Autonomia, organização, boa apresentação e sentido de responsabilidade.

O Terapeuta Ocupacional com formação especializada na promoção da autonomia, funcionalidade e qualidade de vida dos indivíduos ao longo das diferentes fases da vida. Profissional responsável, empático e orientado para a pessoa, com capacidade para avaliar as necessidades individuais e desenvolver planos de intervenção adequados às características, objetivos e contextos de cada utente.
Possui competências na avaliação e intervenção ao nível das atividades da vida diária, motricidade, integração sensorial, funções cognitivas e participação ocupacional, procurando potenciar a independência e o desempenho funcional dos utentes nas suas atividades significativas.
Destaca-se pela capacidade de estabelecer uma relação terapêutica de confiança, bem como pelo sentido de responsabilidade, organização, capacidade de adaptação e aprendizagem contínua. Valoriza uma intervenção individualizada e centrada na pessoa, promovendo também a participação ativa da família e dos cuidadores no processo terapêutico.
Apresenta facilidade em trabalhar em equipa multidisciplinar e em articular com diferentes profissionais e contextos, contribuindo para uma abordagem integrada e eficaz. Motivado para integrar uma equipa dinâmica e desenvolver continuamente as suas competências, procura contribuir de forma ativa para a promoção da autonomia, inclusão e bem-estar dos utentes, mantendo sempre uma postura ética, dedicada e profissional.

Monitorovať KPI ukazovatele a poskytovať analýzy výkonnosti. Vytvárať a spravovať reportingové nástroje a dashboardy. Spolupracovať s internými stakeholdermi na finančných analýzach a ad hoc reportoch.

jobs.description:
Zabezpečovať realizáciu poradenských aktivít v školách prezenčným, alebo dištančným spôsobom: - realizovať individuálne poradenstvo pre pedagogických zamestnancov (PZ), vedúcich pedagogických zamestnancov (VPZ), - realizovať návštevy hodín PZ a VPZ s cieľom zvýšenia kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - poskytovať im spätnú väzbu na pozorované edukačné aktivity, - navrhovať odporúčania na zvýšenie kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - identifikovať a diagnostikovať problémy PZ a VPZ, - podporovať PZ a VPZ pri tvorbe návrhov možných riešení ich problémov, - pomáhať im pri aplikácii týchto riešení vo výchovno-vzdelávacom procese v triede a práci so žiakmi, - vedieť poskytovať poradenstvo v niektorých z uvedených oblastí: vzdelávacie programy (ŠVP, ŠkVP), hodnotenie vzdelávacích výsledkov žiakov, vzdelávací proces a vyučovací štýl učiteľa, personalizácia vyučovania a inkluzívne vzdelávanie, digitalizácia. Realizovať skupinové formy rozvoja spôsobilosti PZ a VPZ vo vyššie uvedených oblastiach - formou poldňových/celodňových workshopov, - formou organizovania učiacich sa skupín/organizácie prednášok a diskusií, Monitorovať potreby PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl v regióne - formou dotazníkov pre PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl a školských zariadení, - formou individuálnych rozhovorov s PZ, VPZ a riaditeľmi škôl a školských zariadení. Vykonávať administratívne úlohy spojené s pracovným miestom: - vyplnenie pracovného výkazu, - vedenie dokumentácie o činnostiach, - iné podľa potreby EduHubu. Vykonávať pracovné činnosti podľa potreby a pokynov zamestnávateľa.
Výhody:- flexibilný úväzok 40 – 100 percent , - organizácia času podľa dohody min. 2 dni v týždni, súvisle 7,5 h , - zaujímavá pracovná príležitosť v oblasti školstva na nepedagogickej pozícii, - flexibilita. Ak ešte nemáte absolvované vzdelávanie v mentoringu alebo koučingu 50 h , zabezpečíme a uhradíme ho za vás. Hľadáme predovšetkým ľudí, ktorí sú ochotní vydať sa na cestu rozvoja škôl vo svojom regióne.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov
jobs.description:
Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni
jobs.description:
Umývate riad a udržiavate čistotu v kuchyni, aby ste sa naučili dôležitosti hygieny a organizácie. Pripravujete suroviny, čistenie a krájanie zeleniny, čím sa zlepšíte v kuchynských zručnostiach. Upratujete kuchyňu a zabezpečujete, že je vždy pripravená na ďalšie varenie. Dodržiavate hygienické a bezpečnostné predpisy (HACCP), takže sa naučíte, ako sa starať o bezpečnosť potravín. Po riadnom zaškolení sa samostatne staráte o prípravu raňajok, čo vám dáva možnosť ukázať svoje zručnosti. V prípade potreby a po zaučení zastupujete šéfkuchára. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, aby vyhovoval potrebám nášho tímu a zohľadňoval vašu pohodu. Typická pracovná doba je delená a to od 7:00 hod do 12:00 hod následne 16:00 hod až 21:00 hod (závisí od vyťaženia), pričom sa prispôsobuje aktuálnej prevádzke.
Výhody:Vychutnaj si chutné a kvalitné jedlá v hotelovej reštaurácii za výhodné ceny. V prípade vzdialeného bydliska nad 30 km od hotela poskytujeme ubytovanie 1 € noc. Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Uži si prácu v úspešnej reštaurácii, ktorá je známa svojou kvalitou a štýlovým prostredím. Ak máš záujem, pošli svoj životopis alebo nás kontaktuj osobne v Hoteli GOLFER , Kremnica. Tešíme sa na nového kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorý á bude s nami tvoriť príjemnú atmosféru pre našich hostí aj celý tím!

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.description:
Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

jobs.title: Working Student - Sales Operations (f/m/d)

Stableton is a globally leading, tech- and data-driven institutional investor in private blue-chip tech companies. We empower institutional investors, private banks, and wealth managers to benefit from the value creation of the world's most valuable technology companies through our unique unicorn index investment funds and institutional thematic investment mandates.

With our disruptive mindset, fast-paced culture, and track record of innovation, we are reshaping private market investing. With seven years of 100%+ annual growth, we are scaling globally, and we're just getting started.

Your Role

This is a part-time role supporting our sales team. You will take ownership of the data and material groundwork that makes client work run smoothly: keeping our CRM accurate, building and qualifying target lists, and preparing client-facing materials.

We are a tech-enabled firm and we expect you to work that way. Using AI tools to speed up repetitive work is part of how the role is done.

This is not an internship. It takes a few months to learn how we work, so we are looking for someone who wants to stay in the role and grow with it, not for short-term cover.

  • Prepare and update client-facing materials and presentations
  • Support the sales team with analysis and document work
  • Support prospecting by building, researching, and qualifying target lists
  • Maintain and improve CRM data quality, including deduplication, enrichment, and consistent record keeping
  • Take on ad hoc requests across the team as they come up

Requirements

  • Currently in a Master's program at a leading university in Switzerland or Germany
  • Prior internship experience at a financial services or fintech firm
  • Available 40–50% alongside your studies, based in or near Zurich or Frankfurt
  • Ready to commit for at least six months, ideally twelve
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with a CRM is an advantage
  • Fluent with AI tools and quick to figure out where they save time
  • Precise and structured. You care whether a record is correct, not just filled in
  • Comfortable working independently and asking when something is unclear
  • Fluent in English; German is a plus
  • Right to work in the chosen base location (Switzerland, Germany) at time of application; the firm is unable to provide visa sponsorship

Benefits

  • Real ownership of the CRM and prospecting groundwork, not shadowing
  • Insight into how an institutional private markets investor approaches client work
  • Close collaboration with a small, senior sales team
  • Flexible hours around your study schedule and a hybrid setup in Zurich or Frankfurt
  • A role you can grow into over at least six months
  • If it works well on both sides, we'd be glad to keep you on full-time after you graduate

Stableton is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Je komt met verbetervoorstellen en bent betrokken bij het optimaliseren van facilitaire werkprocessen. Je schrijft beleidsnotities en treedt op als projectleider bij complexe projecten. Daarnaast neem je deel aan diverse werkgroepen en projectteams, denk je mee over verschillende vraagstukken en oplossingen en geef je huisvestingsadvies.

Als Projectleider Facilitair & Huisvesting ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de totstandkoming en uitvoering van de projectenkalender voor verbouw- en nieuwbouwprojecten. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met de bouwkundige projectleiders. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met de facilitaire adviseurs, die goed weten wat er op de zorglocaties nodig is om de bewoners een prettige en veilige omgeving te bieden om te wonen en/of te werken.

Na afronding van een project zorg je voor een goede overdracht aan de beheerorganisatie. Je bent proactief en ondernemend en weet onverwachte ontwikkelingen te vertalen naar concrete projecten. Daarbij zoek je actief de verbinding binnen en buiten de facilitaire afdeling.

Je standaard werkplek is Assen. In overleg is thuiswerken ook goed mogelijk.

Wil jij jouw ervaring met facilitaire dienstverlening en projectmanagement inzetten voor projecten die echt impact hebben? Als Projectleider Facilitair en Huisvesting werk je aan uiteenlopende, complexe projecten binnen Vanboeijen. Van huisvestingsprojecten tot het optimaliseren van het FMIS systeem jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen tijd, budget en kwaliteitseisen worden gerealiseerd. Daarbij verbind je verschillende disciplines en zorg je ervoor dat de facilitaire dienstverlening steeds beter aansluit bij wat nodig is voor de bewoners en medewerkers.

Vanboeijen ondersteunt ruim 700 kinderen, jongeren, volwassenen en ouderen met een verstandelijke beperking in Drenthe en omgeving. Met ongeveer 1600 medewerkers wordt dagelijks gewerkt vanuit de missie Goed leven, Mooi werk, Met elkaar.

Dein zukünftiges Team

Bei Meierhofer treiben wir die Digitalisierung von Spitälern, Reha und psychiatrischen Kliniken voran. Mit unseren Softwarelösungen für Klinikprozesse, Patientenmanagement und digitale, versorgungsübergreifende Workflows gestalten wir die Patientenversorgung effizienter und sicherer. Als Sales Manager verbindest du Neukundengewinnung mit strategischer Account-Entwicklung und baust unsere Marktposition im Schweizer Healthcare-IT-Markt weiter aus. Dich erwarten komplexe Sales Cycles, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Healthcare-IT-Expert*innen.


Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Du gewinnst neue Spitäler und steuerst den Sales Cycle bis zum Abschluss
  • Du entwickelst Accounts weiter und hebst Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale
  • Du gewinnst Entscheider*innen in Management, IT und Fachbereichen
  • Du steuerst Ausschreibungen, Offerten und Vertragsverhandlungen mit unseren Fachteams
  • Du präsentierst unsere Lösungen überzeugend auf Management- und C-Level
  • Du verfolgst Markttrends, pflegst dein Netzwerk und vertrittst Meierhofer auf Branchenevents


Das sind deine Stärken & Skills

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb komplexer Software oder SaaS, idealerweise für Softwarelösungen für Kliniken
  • Du hast nachweislich Neukunden gewonnen und komplexe Sales Cycles abgeschlossen
  • Du kennst das Schweizer Gesundheitswesen und den Vertrieb in regulierten Märkten
  • Du bist versiert in Ausschreibungen, Offerten und Verhandlungen mit mehreren Stakeholdern
  • Du kommunizierst und präsentierst sicher auf Management- und C-Level
  • Du bist innerhalb der Schweiz und bei Bedarf im DACH-Raum reisebereit


Was wir bieten

  • Sinnstiftende Produkte und Projekte zur Digitalisierung des Gesundheitswesens
  • Mobiles Arbeiten an bis zu drei Tagen pro Woche sowie Sabbaticals
  • GA auch zur privaten Nutzung 
  •  Reka-Pay oder Internetzuschuss
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding und persönliches Mentoring
  • Interne Meierhofer Akademie und individuelle Weiterbildung


Innovativ – Kundenzentriert - Leistungsstark im Team

Seit fast 40 Jahren verbindet Meierhofer Erfahrung mit Innovationskraft und digitalisiert die Patientenversorgung in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Applied AI Engineer - Consulting Manager
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Job description
Requisition ID:  1730791
Applied AI Engineer - Consulting Manager

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

You will work across a diverse portfolio of clients spanning Financial Services, the Public Sector, and the Private Sector. Our Applied AI Engineering teams deliver production-grade AI systems in regulated financial institutions as well as government, health, infrastructure, consumer, industrial and energy organizations. This cross-sector model gives you broad exposure to different regulatory environments, data landscapes and operating models, while building deep engineering capability that transfers across industries.

Role purpose

Operate as a hands on engineer within a squad, taking ownership of defined components and delivering AI capabilities (e.g., agents, RAG pipelines) that meet enterprise standards for reliability, security and observability. Strengthen your foundations through the Applied AI Engineering Academy while taking on more responsibility for solution shaping and stakeholder engagement.

Your key responsibilities

Client facing engineering & delivery

• Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders; translate requirements into engineering tasks; support workshops, demos and solution reviews; drive adoption through testing and iteration.
Solution design & implementation
• Design and implement RAG pipelines, agents, microservices and integrations; apply monitoring, evaluation and Responsible AI guardrails.
Product mindset & continuous improvement
• Shape MVP scope, backlog and release planning; capture reusable patterns and contribute to shared accelerators.

What we're looking for

• Strong Python/TypeScript; async patterns; API design; testing/CI; microservice fundamentals.
• Hands on LLMs, embeddings, vector databases; retrieval strategies and grounding.
• Cloud engineering (Azure preferred), Docker/Kubernetes, serverless; secure networking/IAM.
• Data engineering fundamentals (Spark/Databricks; ETL/ELT) and operational handover.
• Consulting behaviors: stakeholder engagement and clear, client ready communication.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role.
• Fluent written and spoken English, French/German is a plus.

Ideally, you'll also

• Document/graph stores; streaming (Event Hub/Kafka); cloud architecture exposure and governance credentials.

What we offer you
At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

As a global leader in providing managed services to the financial industry, Deloitte is deeply committed to expanding its Operate offering in the banking space, a model where Deloitte takes ownership of running critical middle- and back-office processes on behalf of banking clients, combining operational excellence with innovative technology.

Our Banking Operate practice has already identified and validated a comprehensive portfolio of services to be launched, covering multiple banking value chains. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Service Functional Descriptions (SFDs) across our target service catalogue. jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN ATOMISTIC MODELLING OF FERROELECTRIC DYNAMICS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with atomistic modelling (DFT, second-principles, machine-learned force fields), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of ferroelectricity and/or molecular dynamics is a strong asset.

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 Months (14 +22+12 )
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. The Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb, is one of the leading research and higher education institutions in Croatia, offering advanced training and research infrastructure in chemistry, biochemistry, nanotechnology, biosensors, environmental health, and biomedical sciences. The host group has expertise in Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) approaches, nanomaterials, advanced analytical methods, and translational biomedical research.

How will you contribute?
As a PhD Student within the AIM-PACE project, your main responsibilities will include:
• Supporting the scoping analysis of the AIM-PACE scenarios and products, as part of the SSbD framework implementation.
• Conducting a comprehensive literature review and data collection on hazard profiles of existing substances/materials and use of computational modelling for data gap filling.
• Identifying, reviewing and using models and tools for hazard screening, exposure assessment and risk assessment in the context of SSbD.
• Application of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including in vitro and computational tools, for hazard, exposure and risk assessment of AIM-PACE materials.
• Collaborating with project partners in integrating safety output with sustainability, techno-economic and social indicators.
• Collaborating with the team of Dr. Ivana Vinkovic Vrček to explore research activities, scientific training, conferences, and dissemination activities, and complete all doctoral requirements according to University of Zagreb regulations.
• Contributing to the dissemination of results through peer-reviewed scientific publications, conference presentations, and technical reports.
• Actively participating in AIM-PACE consortium activities, including meetings, workshops, and stakeholder engagement.

• Familiarity with in vitro toxicology methods and/or New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) is an asset.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:



CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.



COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.



BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Accountant
jobs.description:
About the Role 

Imagine this. You join a fast-moving finance team where accuracy, speed, and good judgement really matter. As our Accounts Payable Accountant, you will take ownership of a high volume of supplier invoices, work extensively with purchase orders, resolve discrepancies, and make sure transactions move smoothly through our systems. This is a hands-on role for someone who already knows their way around accounts payable and is ready to contribute from day one. 

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Process and book a high volume of supplier invoices accurately and on time 
  • Work extensively with purchase orders, checking invoices against POs and identifying and resolving discrepancies 
  • Review invoice details, approvals, supporting documentation, and accounting information before posting 
  • Handle questions, clarifications, and follow-ups related to supplier invoices and payments 
  • Investigate invoice discrepancies and work with internal teams and suppliers to get issues resolved quickly 
  • Work daily with Microsoft Dynamics and ExFlow to process and manage invoices 
  • Maintain accurate vendor and accounting records and ensure transactions are properly documented 
  • Support the wider finance team during periods of high workload and help keep accounts payable processes moving efficiently 
  • Contribute to improving accounts payable processes and identifying practical ways to make daily workflows more efficient 
  • Support month-end activities and other accounting tasks related to accounts payable when required 

Requirements

What You’ll Need 

  • Around 4 to 6 years of relevant professional experience in accounting, accounts payable, vendor accounting, or a similar finance role 
  • Practical experience processing and booking supplier invoices in a high-volume environment 
  • Strong experience working with purchase orders and PO-based invoice processes 
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics is required 
  • Experience with ExFlow is highly valued 
  • Accounting education or professional training in accounting or finance 
  • Previous professional accounting experience within a company in Switzerland 
  • Good understanding of Swiss accounting practices and day-to-day finance processes 
  • Strong attention to detail and confidence working with large volumes of financial data and documentation 
  • Fluent English is required 
  • German or French is a strong plus 
  • Higher education or a university degree is not required 
  • Previous aerospace or defense experience is not required 

Who You Are 

You are comfortable in a busy finance environment where there is always something that needs to get done. You know how to work independently, stay organized when invoice volumes increase, and spot when something does not add up. You are not afraid to ask questions, chase missing information, or dig into a discrepancy until it is resolved. You bring solid accounting experience, a practical mindset, and the reliability to take ownership of your work while collaborating closely with the wider team.

jobs.title: Clinical Lead
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced clinical development professional looking for the opportunity to take scientific ownership of a clinical program and help shape the future of a differentiated compound?

We are looking for a scientifically curious, strategic and hands-on Clinical Development Lead to provide clinical and scientific leadership across the design, execution and interpretation of clinical studies. In this role, you will play a central part in translating scientific insight into high-quality clinical evidence and development decisions that can make a meaningful difference for patients.

You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, Biostatistics and other cross-functional partners to ensure that the clinical program is scientifically robust, operationally feasible and aligned with the compound’s development objectives. This is an opportunity to combine scientific depth with visible cross-functional leadership in an entrepreneurial, collaborative and fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities
The Clinical Development Lead is the expert responsible for leading the delivery of clinical program objectives for an assigned compound, in line with Company strategy and agreed development plans.

Main responsibilities include:
•Lead the Clinical Team at project level and provide clear scientific direction, alignment and guidance across the clinical program; may include line management responsibility.
•Lead the scientific development and delivery of clinical sections of trial- and program-level regulatory documents, including Investigator’s Brochures, briefing books, safety updates, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Drive the clinical component of the development program in close partnership with global line functions, ensuring scientific quality, clear priorities and timely delivery.
•Provide ongoing clinical and scientific review, interpretation and communication of clinical trial data to inform program strategy and development decisions.
•Serve as a core member of the Safety Management Team and contribute to the assessment and communication of the compound’s benefit-risk profile.
•Support the preparation of safety-related documents, including Periodic Safety Update Reports, Drug Safety Update Reports and other safety documentation, in collaboration with the Project Physician and Drug Safety Physician.
•Maintain a strong understanding of the therapeutic area, competitive landscape, relevant mechanisms of action and evolving standards of care.
•Lead clinical contributions to scientific communications, including study abstracts, posters, oral presentations and manuscripts.
•Represent the clinical perspective in cross-functional discussions and contribute to the continuous evolution of the clinical development strategy.

Candidate Requirements
•Advanced degree in life or health sciences, such as PhD, PharmD, MD, MSc or equivalent.
•At least seven years of relevant experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
•Proven experience contributing to the planning, execution, reporting and publication of Phase II to IV clinical trials in a global, cross-functional and matrix environment.
•Demonstrated experience leading clinical projects or substantial clinical development workstreams through to completion.
•Strong experience in the preparation of clinical and regulatory documentation, including Investigator’s Brochures, protocols, briefing books, clinical study reports, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Experience supporting regulatory submissions, such as INDs, NDAs and MAAs, and contributing to interactions with Health Authorities, including pre-IND, pre-NDA, end-of-Phase II and SAWP/CHMP meetings.
•Excellent understanding of global drug development, from first-in-human studies through post-approval activities.
•Strong knowledge of clinical trial design methodology and statistics applied to clinical research.
•Ability to interpret and integrate preclinical, translational and clinical data into clinical trial design and development planning.

**Salary:** competitive

**Hours:** Full\-time (100%), 42 hours per week (standard office hours, with some flexibility of commute), unlimited employment

**Start Date:** Now

If you’re motivated by meaningful work, strong customer relationships, and continuous learning, this role is for you. Help deliver technology that makes a real difference in public safety while building trusted relationships with key customers across Switzerland.

**Company Overview:**

Buddi is a fast\-paced, high\-growth UK based technology company that is a global leader in the design, manufacture and supply of equipment to the Criminal Justice Sector around the world.

Buddi has a long\-standing contract for its supply within Switzerland, and this is managed from our office in Lausanne.

Buddi has hubs, such as we have in **Lausanne, Switzerland** in many other parts of the world where that is necessary and improves the quality of our delivery and customer support.

Buddi’s parent company, Big Technologies PLC, is listed on the UK stock market and provides the financial resources and stability for the company to expand the supply of the equipment to new areas. Europe is a particular area for such expansion.

**Role Overview:**

As the **Operations Specialist**, you will join a small team in Lausanne and support our contract delivery within Switzerland. You may also support our wider operations in the region. Some flexibility with partially working remotely.

Fluency, written and verbal, in English language and either German, French or Italian is a necessary requirement to support our Cantonal customers in Switzerland. Any other languages, at any level, would be beneficial though not essential.

From the Lausanne office you will manage the stock of equipment, including in country logistic supply via the postal service and provide the first line of direct customer support, whether through telephone or email engagement.

Alongside the day\-to\-day operations conducted from the office there will be a necessity for some travel to customer offices within Switzerland, specifically those that are German or French speaking, for face\-to\-face meetings and delivery of some training relating to the equipment and software. Training will predominantly be supplied in Lausanne however it may also be preferable to attend Buddi’s UK office occasionally.

You will help in identifying and nurturing good practice, helping maintain strong customer relationships, and ensuring we meet and exceed our service delivery standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide operational support to help customers meet their Electronic Monitoring (EM) objectives, including timely and accurate equipment deliveries and technical advice.
