Bh LOF Midtjylland

jobs.title: Chip Ecosystem Partnership and Funding Manager, The position is a Senior Advisor at TEK Innovation
jobs.description:
Do you want to help facilitate and grow the semiconductor and chip ecosystem in Denmark and beyond, working with the leading researchers in the field, and to turn potential into opportunities, partnerships and projects? Then this job could be for you.  

About the position 

SDU Microelectronics at TEK, headed by professor Farshad Moradi, is part of the Danish Chips Competence Centre (DkCCC) - the new Danish hub for chip technology and your strategic platform. The position offers an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening Denmark’s chip ecosystem and to help connect the ecosystem with fast-growing application areas such as drones, robotics, sensors and autonomous systems, where advanced chip technology is becoming increasingly critical for performance, reliability, energy efficiency and future innovation. 

You will work closely with SDU researchers, DkCCC partners, Danish universities, companies, incubators, industry organizations, funding advisers and European chip networks. Learn more here www.dkccc.eu 

The position involves regular travel within Denmark and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe. 

Your main responsibilities will include:  

  • Identifying relevant national and European funding opportunities in chip technology, semiconductor development, and chip-enabled applications. 

  • Developing and maintaining a strategic pipeline of funding calls, project ideas and potential consortium partners. 

  • Engaging proactively with Danish start-ups, SMEs and established companies to understand their technological needs and funding requirements. 

  • Connecting companies with relevant researchers, facilities and competencies at SDU and other Danish universities. 

  • Helping companies and researchers translate technical and business ideas into fundable project concepts. 

  • Initiating and facilitating Danish and European consortia for chip-related funding calls and identifying opportunities to join existing consortia. 

  • Promoting Danish chip competencies and contribute to the visibility and strategic development of DkCCC.  

  • Supporting the full process of funding applications, from project objectives and facilitating consortiums, to coordinating proposals with partners and funding advisers. 

  • Building relationships with key stakeholders, organizing activities, and events supporting the ecosystem.   

Your profile 
You have a relevant master's degree, for example within engineering or natural sciences, business development or innovation management, economics or business administration, European studies or public policy, research and innovation management, or another relevant field. 

You have documented experience in one or more of the following: 

  • National or European research and innovation funding 

  • Development of collaborative funding proposals 

  • Consortium building and partner identification 

  • University–industry collaboration or innovation/business development 

  • Supporting start-ups, SMEs or deep-tech companies 

  • Stakeholder management and professional networking 

We are looking for a colleague who: 

  • Is proactive and comfortable initiating contact with companies, researchers and potential partners.  

  • Is a strong relationship builder who can establish trust across organizational and disciplinary boundaries 

  • Understands both commercial needs and academic interests and can structure complex consortium-development processes, while maintaining momentum towards a deadline 

  • Communicates clearly with different stakeholders, technical, academia and experts, business 

  • Works independently and is persistent and solution oriented, while also contributing actively to a team 

Experience with semiconductors, microelectronics, integrated circuits, quantum technologies, photonics, sensors or other deep-tech fields is a significant advantage — though you don't need to be a chip designer. What matters more is your ability to grasp technology-based opportunities, engage technical specialists, and turn complex ideas into fundable partnerships. Knowledge of European research and innovation programs, including EU Chips Act calls, is also an advantage. 

What we offer 

  • Become part of SDU’s growing environment for microelectronics and chip technology. 

  • Build partnerships that may lead to new products, technologies, companies, and investments. 

  • Work directly with promising Danish start-ups, companies and research environments. 

  • Help create new university–industry collaborations. 

  • Develop national and European networks within a strategically important technology area. 

  • Influence the formation of projects from their earliest stages. 

  • Work in. 

  • Collaborate with leading researchers and industry specialists, in an international and interdisciplinary environment. 

  • A role with considerable independence and the opportunity to shape the methods, networks, and activities used to identify funding opportunities and develop consortia. 

Your organizational home will be TEK Innovation, the research support and innovation unit at TEK, where you will have colleagues with similar jobs, supporting emerging ecosystems, as well as funding advisors and project managers. Your academic home with SDU Microelectronics, where you will work closely with professor Farshad Moradi and his team.  

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Thit Juul Hvid, Head of TEK Innovation, The Technical Faculty at The University of Southern Denmark tjuul@tek.sdu.dk 

Professor Farshad Moradi, SDU Microelectronics, The Technical faculty at The University of Southern Denmark at moradi@sdu.dk  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).

First Interview: week 46, second interview, week 47.

The startdate will be January 1, 2027, or at the earliest convenience.

Salary and employment terms:  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and exam certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All documents must be in English and PDF format.  All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.  

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Sisustustyönjohtaja
jobs.description:
Riverco Oy on keskisuuri konepaja-, laivankorjaus- ja laivanrakennusalan yritys, joka on kansainvälisesti menestynyt ja alallaan tunnettu. Pääasiakkaitamme ovat muun muassa maailman johtavat risteilyvarustamot ja telakat.

Olemme osa erittäin vakavaraista ja 60 vuotta toiminutta monialaista yritysryhmää. Konserni toimii konepaja- ja laivanrakennusteollisuuden lisäksi sähkö- ja putkiurakoinnissa, kiinteistötoimialalla sekä kaupan alalla. Yrityksen toimipaikat sijaitsevat Turussa, Raisiossa, Paraisilla ja Nousiaisissa.

Tyypillisiä työkohteitamme ovat laivojen teknisten ja sisustusalueiden kokonaistoimitukset sekä laivojen tekniset järjestelmät. Toteutamme useille kansainvälisille varustamoille muun muassa vaativia muutos-, kunnossapito- ja huoltotöitä.

Osaavaan tiimiimme olisi nyt haussa kotimaassa ja ulkomailla toteutettaviin laivanrakennus- ja laivankorjausprojekteihin:

**SISUSTUSTYÖNJOHTAJA**

**Työnkuva**

Sisustustyönjohtajana vastaat laivojen sisustus- ja muutostöiden käytännön toteutuksesta työmaalla. Johdat ja ohjaat asentajia sekä aliurakoitsijoita ja huolehdit siitä, että työt etenevät suunnitelmien, aikataulujen ja laatutavoitteiden mukaisesti. Ennen projektia osallistut esivalmistuksen ohjaamiseen ja ostotoimintaan.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- työmaan päivittäisen toiminnan ja työn etenemisen suunnittelu ja johtaminen

- oman henkilöstön ja aliurakoitsijoiden työnjohto sekä työn organisointi

- töiden aikatauluttaminen ja resurssien suunnittelu yhdessä projektiryhmän kanssa

- työpiirustusten ja muiden suunnitelmien läpikäynti sekä niiden toteutuksen valvonta

- materiaalien, työkalujen ja muiden työssä tarvittavien resurssien koordinointi

- työn laadun ja aikataulujen valvonta sekä tarvittavien muutosten koordinointi

- projektien valmisteluun, työmäärien arviointiin ja toteutuksen suunnitteluun osallistuminen


Työtehtävät vaihtelevat projektien mukaan, joten työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden olla mukana sekä pienemmissä korjaus- ja muutostöissä että laajemmissa laivanrakennusprojekteissa.

Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista projektiryhmää, mutta tehtävässä korostuu myös itsenäinen ote, päätöksentekokyky ja vastuunotto omasta työmaasta.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Arvostamme soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta tai aikaisempaa kokemusta laivanrakennuksen tai rakennus- ja teollisuudenalan työnjohdosta. Erityisesti kokemus laivojen sisustustöistä, muutostöistä tai telakkaympäristöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

- käytännönläheistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta

- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- kykyä ohjata erilaisia työryhmiä

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa

- kykyä lukea teknisiä piirustuksia ja suunnitelmia

- matkustusvalmiutta kotimaassa ja ulkomailla

- suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen sekä itsenäisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset työskentelemään kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja mielenkiintoisten projektien parissa.

Tehtävässä pääset näkemään projektit alusta loppuun ja osallistumaan niiden valmisteluun, toteutukseen ja viimeistelyyn. Työ tarjoaa vaihtelua, vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista laivanrakennuksen ja laivankorjauksen monipuolisissa tehtävissä.

Työskentelet osana kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista projektiorganisaatiota, jossa yhteistyöllä ja käytännön tekemisellä on tärkeä rooli projektien onnistumisessa.

Jos olet käytännönläheinen, vastuullinen ja yhteistyökykyinen tekijä, joka viihtyy vaihtelevissa työympäristöissä ja haluaa olla mukana toteuttamassa vaativia laivanrakennus- ja laivankorjausprojekteja, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

jobs.title: Svenskspråkig barnvakt för en barnfamilj i Åbo
jobs.description:
Vill du ha ett meningsfullt och flexibelt deltidsarbete där du får hjälpa barnfamiljer som behöver stöd i vardagen? Då kanske du är vår nästa **helppare**!

Oavsett om du är studerande inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen, pensionär eller en erfaren yrkesperson med utbildning inom social- och hälsovård, är det din entusiasm och genuina vilja att hjälpa till med stort hjärta som är det viktigaste i den här rollen!

Vi är Hemby – ett företag som modigt förnyar hemtjänsten för äldre, barn och egentligen människor i alla åldrar som behöver hjälp i vardagen. Vi vill skapa glädje och trygghet i våra kunders vardag, och vårt motto är: **vi hjälper som om det vore vår egen mamma, pappa, vän eller vårt eget barn.**

Vad är en helppare?

En helppare är en person som erbjuder praktisk hjälp och sällskap till en person som behöver stöd i vardagen, till exempel ett barn. Helpparen hjälper kunden med olika vardagssysslor, såsom att gå ut, delta i dagliga aktiviteter, ta ut soporna eller helt enkelt finnas där som sällskap och hjälpa till.

Med tiden kan helpparen, kunden och kundens familj få en nära och förtroendefull relation.

Alla som är över 18 år kan arbeta som helppare – från studerande till pensionärer. Det viktigaste är en positiv inställning till arbetet och en genuin vilja att hjälpa andra.

Vi söker utbildade yrkespersoner inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen till vårt team för att hjälpa barnfamiljer

Våra kunder är både barn och barnfamiljer. I den här rollen får du stötta barnfamiljer i en hektisk vardag genom att erbjuda din värdefulla tid och hjälpa till med sådant som får vardagen att fungera.

Arbetsuppgifterna kan vara allt från att leka med barnen och gå ut tillsammans till hushållssysslor, såsom att ta ut soporna. Ibland kan besöken helt enkelt bestå av att göra något tillsammans, till exempel färglägga i en målarbok.

Vad krävs av en helppare?

Framför allt en genuin vilja att hjälpa andra. Våra helppare förenas av viljan att tillbringa tid med människor som behöver stöd.

I det här arbetet får du möjlighet att på riktigt påverka och göra våra kunders vardag bättre och enklare. Vi ser det som en extra merit om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barnfamiljer!

Vad är det bästa med att arbeta som helppare?

Vi frågade våra helppare, och så här svarade de:

Att få möta människor utan stress och bli vän med kunden.

Att hjälpa någon annan och känna att arbetet är meningsfullt.

Att få vara en del av Helppar-gemenskapen.

Som helppare får du:

- **En egen namngiven kund**, som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och finns där som sällskap.

- **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt att kombinera med exempelvis studier eller ett annat deltidsarbete. Den typiska arbetstiden är 1–2 gånger i veckan, några timmar åt gången.

- **Konkurrenskraftig timlön:** 13,20–15,98 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning.

- **Goda möjligheter att utvecklas:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro-helppare eller guru-helppare och få högre lön!


Om du har frågor om att bli helppare, skicka ett mejl till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

Straffregisterutdrag som krävs för arbetet

- För arbete med barn krävs ett straffregisterutdrag enligt lagen om kontroll av brottslig bakgrund hos personer som arbetar med barn (504/2002).

jobs.title: HSE Specialist
jobs.description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

We are looking for a HSE Specialist to join our HSE Team in Vaasa, Finland. In this role, you will support our Finnish projects in the Nordic Operation Unit (OU) and focus on the HSE tasks in the HSE department and throughout the projects life cycle. You will be ensuring that the highest standards of health, safety and environmental performance are documented, monitored and maintained. You will also be driving continuous improvement in all areas of HSE.

The Nordic OU HSE Team is a network of experienced health, safety and environmental professionals supporting the delivery of complex construction, energy and industrial projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark. We support highly skilled site teams in delivering world-class projects through professionalism, quality and operational excellence, creating environments where safety is the natural outcome of doing the job right. Working closely with project management, customers and contractors, we provide expertise and practical support throughout the project lifecycle. Our focus is on enabling disciplined planning, effective risk management and high-quality execution that protects people, enhances performance and strengthens project outcomes.

Our strength lies in our people. We bring together talented professionals with experience from the energy sector, industrial construction and major infrastructure projects. We value expertise, integrity and a willingness to take initiative. We are a team that shares knowledge openly, learns from each other and works together to solve challenges in demanding project environments. We welcome individuals from diverse professional backgrounds who are motivated by continuous development and a desire to make a meaningful impact.

We believe that excellence comes from combining technical competence with personal accountability. We encourage constructive challenge, transparent communication and the confidence to speak up when improvements can be made. By maintaining high professional standards and supporting one another, we help project teams achieve results while protecting people, the environment and the long-term success of our projects.

We challenge established practices and continuously look for better ways to manage risk, support project teams and improve performance. \- Review HSE documentation from all Hitachi Energy subcontractors and support subcontractors to meet internal and Project HSE requirements.

**Your background**

\- Previous experience of HSE tasks in projects

\- Professional HSE certification is seen as a plus

\- Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certifications

\- Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to operate within global teams

\- Self-driven and persistent attitude towards challenges. You work actively and professionally both independently and as a part of a team.

\- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English and Finnish. Swedish is seen as a plus.

jobs.title: Prosessi-insinööri, Keliber-litiumhanke
jobs.description:
Sibanye-Stillwaterin Keliber-litiumhanke on aloittanut Euroopan ensimmäisen omaan malmiin perustuvan akkulaatuisen litiumhydroksidin tuotannon vaiheittaisen käynnistämisen. Toiminta kattaa koko arvoketjun malminetsinnästä litiumhydroksidin jalostukseen ja vahvistaa Euroopan akkuarvoketjua. Rikastamo sijaitsee Kaustisen Päivänevalla ja litiumjalostamo Kokkolan suurteollisuusalueella (KIP).
Litiumhydroksidi on keskeinen raaka-aine litiumioniakuissa, jotka mahdollistavat sähköautot, energian varastoinnin ja monet digitaalisen arjen ratkaisut.
Keliber on kansainvälisen kaivos- ja metallinjalostusyhtiön Sibanye-Stillwaterin tytäryhtiö, ja sen toiseksi suurin omistaja on kotimaista akkuarvoketjua kehittävä Finnish Minerals Group.
Haluatko tarttua ainutlaatuiseen tilaisuuteen ja tulla luomaan uuden sukupolven suomalaista teollisuutta?
Haemme nyt litiumjalostamolle Kokkolaan


PROSESSI-INSINÖÖRIÄ (paineliuotus)
tukemaan käyttöönoton valmistelua. Tuotannon käynnistyttyä olet mukana litiumjalostamon operatiivisessa toiminnassa varmistamassa prosessien turvallista ja tehokasta käyttöä. Raportoit tehtävässäsi litiumjalostamon tehtaanjohtajalle.
Lisäksi tehtäviisi kuuluu
seisokkien ja huoltopysäytysten suunnittelu yhdessä käynnissäpidon kanssa
osallistuminen litiumjalostamon vuosibudjetointiin ja kustannusten seurantaan
tuotannon operaattoreiden koulutus, ohjeistukset ja riskinarviot
tiivis yhteistyö jalostamon operaattoreiden ja insinöörien kanssa

Odotamme sinulta
kemian, prosessi- tai konetekniikan korkeakoulututkintoa
työkokemusta (vähintään 5 vuotta) autoklaavi- tai paineliuotusprosessista
erinomaisia yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä suomen että englannin kielellä.


Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan, hyvät työsuhde-edut sekä erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittyä ammatillisesti osana kunnianhimoista ja innostunutta työyhteisöä. Meillä turvallisuus on aina etusijalla, ja teollisuusyrityksenä kiinnitämme erityistä huomiota ympäristöasioiden kestävään hoitamiseen. Ymmärrämme työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamisen merkityksen hyvinvoinnille, jota tuemme mm. liukuvalla työajalla ja mahdollistamalla etätyö työtehtävien salliessa.
Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa litiumjalostamon Tehtaanjohtaja Heikki Pihlaja, puh. 050 363 7324, heikki.pihlaja@sibanyestillwater.com
Hae tehtävään 25.10.2026 mennessä.


Sibanye-Stillwaters Keliber lithium project has begun the phased ramp-up of Europes first battery-grade lithium hydroxide production based on its own ore. The operation covers the entire value chain from ore exploration to lithium hydroxide processing and strengthens Europes battery value chain. The concentrator is located in Päiväneva, Kaustinen, and the lithium refinery is in the Kokkola industrial park.
Lithium hydroxide is a key raw material in lithium-ion batteries, which power electric vehicles, energy storage, and many everyday digital solutions.
Keliber is a subsidiary of Sibanye-Stillwater, a multinational mining and metals processing Group, with Finnish Minerals Group as the second largest shareholder, a state-owned company developing the value chain of lithium-ion batteries.
Would you like to take on this unique chance and create new generations industry in Finland?

We are now looking for a



PROCESS ENGINEER (pressure leaching)

to support preparations for operational readiness. Once production begins, you will be involved in the day-to-day operations of the lithium refinery, ensuring the safe and efficient operation of the processes. You report to the refinery's site manager.

In addition, your duties include:

Planning outages and maintenance stops in collaboration with maintenance
Participating in annual budgeting and cost monitoring
Training operators, making guidelines and risk assessments
Close collaboration with refinery operators and engineers

In order to succeed, we expect You to:
Have a Masters/Bachelors degree in chemical, process or mechanical engineering
Have minimum 5 years work experience in autoclave or pressure leaching process
Have excellent cooperation skills both in Finnish and English


In addition to competitive salary and good benefits, we offer excellent opportunities for professional development in an ambitious and exciting work community. For us, safety is always a priority, and as an industrial company we give special attention to handling environmental matters sustainably. We understand the significance of balance between work and private life and support this for example with flexible working hours and providing the option for remote work when possible.
For further information please contact Vice President, Lithium Refinery Heikki Pihlaja, tel. +358 (0)50 363 7324, heikki.pihlaja@sibanyestillwater.

Apply by 25 October 2026

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö
jobs.description:
Asiakuuspäällikkö, Oulu / Pohjois-Pohjanmaa

Haemme TEPJO tekijöille asiakuuspäällikköä vahvistamaan myyntiämme Oulun/Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueelle!
Oletko tavoitteellinen jo kokemusta omaava myynnin ammattilainen, joka viihtyy asiakasrajapinnassa ja haluaa rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita? Etsimme nyt asiakkuuspäällikköä vastaamaan henkilöstöpalveluiden myynnistä ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä Oulun alueella.

Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään erityisesti rakennus-, infra- ja teollisuusalan asiakasyritysten parissa ja rakentamaan ratkaisuja heidän henkilöstötarpeisiinsa.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä vastaat alueesi asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä ja henkilöstöpalveluiden myynnistä. Työsi on monipuolinen yhdistelmä uusasiakashankintaa, aktiivista asiakastyötä ja pitkäaikaisten kumppanuuksien rakentamista.
Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:
- uusien asiakkuuksien aktiivinen hankinta ja myyntityö
- potentiaalisten asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja tapaamisten sopiminen
- nykyisten asiakassuhteiden ylläpito ja kehittäminen
- asiakkaiden henkilöstötarpeiden kartoittaminen ja niihin sopivien ratkaisujen tarjoaminen
- tarjousten ja sopimusten tekeminen
- oman alueen asiakkuuksien ja myynnin tavoitteellinen kehittäminen.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on aikaisempaa kokemusta henkilöstöalan myyntitehtävistä ja ymmärrystä henkilöstöpalveluiden toimintaympäristöstä.
Toivomme sinulta:
- kokemusta B2B-myynnistä ja uusasiakashankinnasta
- mielellään aiempaa kokemusta henkilöstöpalveluiden myynnistä, rekrytoinnista tai vastaavista tehtävistä
- aktiivinen ja tavoitteellinen ote tekemiseen
- hyvät neuvottelu- ja vuorovaikutustaidot
- kyky rakentaa ja ylläpitää pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita
- itsenäinen ja oma-aloitteinen työskentelyote
Rakennus-, infra- tai teollisuusalan tuntemus katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on vahva myynnillinen ote ja ymmärrys henkilöstöpalvelualasta.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden ottaa vastuuta ja rakentaa merkittävää roolia kasvavalla Oulun ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan markkina-alueella.
Tarjoamme:
- kannustavan ja avoimen työympäristön, missä on oikeasti mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan työhönsä
- palkka 3 400–4 500 €/kk kokemuksesta ja osaamisesta riippuen
- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman alueesi asiakkuuksiin ja myynnin kehittämiseen
- monipuolisen ja itsenäisen työnkuvan
- mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakkuuksia ja kasvattaa omaa verkostoasi
- ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen ja mahdollisuuden kehittyä henkilöstöpalvelualan myynnin ammattilaisena.
- loistavan työilmapiirin

TEPJO tekijät on Pohjois-Pohjanmaalla toimiva henkilöstöratkaisujen ammattilainen, joka on erikoistunut tarjoamaan laadukasta työvoimaa rakennus-, teollisuus-, logistiikka- sekä kaupanalan tarpeisiin.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta ja sinulla on näyttöjä henkilöstöalan myynnistä, haluamme kuulla sinusta!
Lähetä meille CV ja hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Kerro hakemuksessasi lyhyesti aiemmasta myyntikokemuksestasi, saavutuksistasi sekä siitä, miksi juuri tämä tehtävä kiinnostaa sinua.
Tule rakentamaan kanssamme kasvua Oulun ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueella!

jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Veaceslav Diaciuc T/A Slav Construction Building Contractor is seeking a fully qualified and experienced Plasterer to join their growing team. The successful candidate will carry out high-quality internal and external plastering and rendering works across various residential and commercial construction projects in Ireland. This role requires precision, physical stamina, a strong commitment to health and safety standards, and the ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative site team. Location: 34 Sandhills, Hacketstown Road, Carlow Town, Co. Carlow Key Duties and Responsibilities Surface Preparation: Clean, prime, and prepare internal and external walls, ceilings, and other building surfaces to ensure optimal plaster adhesion. Secure wire mesh, laths, and corner beads securely to surfaces when required. Material Mixing: Mix dry plaster, gypsum, mortar, cement, or stucco solutions with water to the correct ratios and desired consistencies using hand and power tools. Plaster Application: Apply layers of wet plaster, skim coats, and external renders to walls, ceilings, and building partitions using trowels, hawks, floats, and spray equipment. Finishing and Levelling: Level, smooth, and finish surfaces to a high standard, ensuring they are free from defects and ready for painting or decoration. Drylining & Drywall Installation: Measure, cut, place, and fix internal plasterboard, wallboard partitions, and drywall insulation systems safely. External Works: Apply weatherproof protective coatings and decorative finishes, such as sand or cement render and pebbledash, to building exteriors. Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free work environment in absolute compliance with site health and safety rules. Qualifications and Requirements Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of proven, verifiable experience working as a professional Plasterer in commercial or residential construction. Skills: Proficient in using specialized hand and power tools (trowels, floats, mixing drills, jointing knives). Comprehensive knowledge of different plastering materials, structural coatings, and mixing techniques. Total remuneration for this role is €36,605 to €50,000 per annum based on experience. jobs.title: Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 1. november - Book en samtale i dag!
jobs.description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi har opstart den 1. november med mulighed for firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

Er du interesseret? Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com for at høre mere, vi vender retur indenfor 24 timer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Mission Execution
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer, Mission Execution, you'll build the software backbone that carries mission plans from the planner to the field. You'll own the infrastructure that executes missions on autonomous robots and multi-agent systems. You'll work closely with the Mission Planning engineer, simulation engineers and product teams to make sure our systems are reliable, testable, and predictable in live operations.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the mission execution infrastructure that turns planned missions into reliable, real-time behavior across fleets of autonomous systems.

  • Develop scalable backend services and APIs for mission guidance, orchestration, agents communication, and execution.

  • Set and defend a high quality bar: CI/CD pipelines, testing, code review standards, observability, and release discipline.

  • Write production-grade C++ and Python that runs in real-time and resource-constrained environments.

  • Partner with Mission Planning, and product teams to ensure algorithms are integrated cleanly, tested thoroughly, and deployable in the field.

  • Analyze logs and telemetry from tests and live operations to find failure modes and drive systemic fixes.

Candidate Requirements

  • Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Technical skills: Strong coding in C++ and Python, with solid software engineering fundamentals (system design, concurrency, testing, debugging).

  • Experience building and shipping production software: Ideally with distributed or real-time systems.

  • Nice to have: Experience in robotics, embedded software, or video game development (game engines, simulation, deterministic replay, tooling). Experience in aerospace or defense. Familiarity with simulation frameworks.

  • Mindset: Strong communication skills, Rigor, ownership, and a strong instinct for quality.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

  • German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää käytännönläheistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta, hyviä yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä ottaa vastuuta ja tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer, Electrical
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Commissioning Engineer, Electrical with a main responsibility for planning and supervising electrical installation and commissioning activities at the project site. This position will therefore see you traveling abroad, around the world, approximately 250 days a year. The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Turku or Helsinki, Finland.Please note that living in one of the preferred office locations is not mandatory.


Your role and responsibilities

This position offers you an opportunity to use and enlarge your expertise in an international and dynamic environment, working on new-build power plant installation and commissioning works. Projects, production locations, Wärtsilä offices, customers, and suppliers can be found around the world. We offer you an interesting position and the possibility to work with a successful global team in an international company.



Responsibilities during installation:

Guide electrical subcontractor(s) at the site
Ensure that planned works are executed according to the Last Planner System




Safeguard compliance with HSSE policies and minimize risks in electrical installations and tests


Coordinate construction and installation works in cooperation with civil and mechanical disciplines


Perform inspection of received material and goods at the site


Participate in the electrical weekly site meetings


Perform quality control and installation inspections at the site


Guide the subcontractor(s) with electrical design and installation instructions


Assist the subcontractor(s) in planning, organizing, and executing electrical works


Advise and support the client in planning, organizing, and executing tests


Ensure that safe inspections and test procedures are followed


Instruct the subcontractor to use accepted test and inspection methods and proper test equipment


Perform testing of installed equipment and document test results






Responsibilities during commissioning:

Perform start-up and tests of equipment within the scope of the contract


Follow the commissioning plan


Follow commissioning and performance test procedures


Ensure that all test results are documented according to Wärtsilä instructions


Safeguard compliance with EHS policies and minimize risks during commissioning


Ensure that safe commissioning practices are followed


Resolve and record technical problems during commissioning


Participate in the site commissioning meetings


Ensure that safe and calibrated test equipment is used



Guide operation personnel with plant design and functionalities


Assist the client with commissioning procedures and testing


Ensure safe and reliable function of the plant and equipment





Responsibilities during both installation and commissioning:
Maintain good reporting practices
Ensure that as-built drawings are completed and communicated
Maintain the punch list
Ensure that all required documents are submitted and signed by the client for plant takeover



To be successful in this role, we expect you to have:

B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering


Familiarity with relevant codes and standards


Understanding of utility generation construction and commissioning practices, working experience in similar tasks is preferred


Good communication and team-building skills


Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies


Willingness to travel


Ability to adjust to a wide range of conditions and cultural environments


Good command of English, both oral and written


Other language skills are seen as an advantage




Contact & next steps
We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Silkeborg
jobs.description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.
Det vigtigste er, at du går op i dit håndværk og afleverer et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Samtidig skal du have lyst til at være en del af en ny afdeling, hvor ikke alt nødvendigvis er fastlagt på forhånd.
Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op sammen med dine nye kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

  • Er uddannet autolakerer og har relevant erfaring
  • Har høj faglig stolthed og sans for kvalitet
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • Er løsningsorienteret og tager ansvar
  • Trives i en travl og ordreproducerende hverdag
  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er fleksibel og klar på de opgaver, der følger med opstarten af en ny afdeling
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden

Vi tilbyder

Du får en særlig mulighed for at komme med helt fra begyndelsen og være med til at sætte dit præg på vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Samtidig bliver du en del af en stor organisation med erfarne kolleger og masser af faglig sparring. Selvom afdelingen er ny, står du derfor ikke alene.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En central rolle i opstarten af en helt ny afdeling
  • Mulighed for at præge arbejdsgange og den daglige drift
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab på tværs af Byens Bilpleje.com
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og godt humør
  • Grundig introduktion til virksomheden og vores processer
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension
  • Mulighed for at vokse med afdelingen i takt med, at forretningen udvikler sig

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kollega.

Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke ansøgninger via e-mail, og ansøgninger fremsendt på mail vil derfor ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leon Clausen på 22 43 31 76.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Mechanical Design), Dieffenbacher / Lahti, Nastola
jobs.description:
About the role

Dieffenbacher is a German, globally operating machinery manufacturer focusing on the design and manufacture of press systems and complete production lines for the panel industry.

In this role, you will play a key part as a member of a \~20-person mechanical design team in Nastola. You will be responsible for specific equipment entities and perform related design work. You will work in close cooperation with automation designers and the chief mechanical designer to ensure projects progress smoothly. Additionally, you will guide external consultants and ensure the quality of the work.

Every project brings something new, giving you the opportunity to challenge yourself with new practices and possibilities.

Why Join Us?
Our mechanical engineering relies strongly on our own expert know-how and a broad network of specialists. We offer you a responsible and diverse role where you can solve interesting technical challenges. With us, you will work in a close-knit atmosphere from the drafting board straight into practice.

Work tasks
- Equipment Responsibility: You will be responsible for designated equipment packages, overseeing equipment improvements, cost tracking, supporting project planning, and equipment documentation.
- Design: You will design custom customer assignments (heavy structures) using Creo & AutoCAD.
- Quality Assurance and Partner Guidance: You will direct design work done by consultants and ensure the output meets high quality standards.
- Practical Collaboration and Inspections: You will collaborate with the workshops, automation design, and R&D, perform equipment inspections, and communicate with customers as needed.
- Fieldwork: You will participate in troubleshooting at installation sites when necessary (site visits approx. 5–15 days per year).

We are looking for

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.
- Solid design experience (preferably over 4 years) in heavy structures (1–20 t), machinery, and machine parts manufactured by welding or machining.
- Fluent English skills.
- Ability to work full-time at the Nastola office during the trial period. Option for 2 remote workdays per week after the trial period.
- Readiness to travel abroad approx. 5–15 days per year.
- Accountability, a proactive and precise working style, and good interpersonal skills.

Considered an Advantage:
- Good proficiency in Finnish.
- Understanding the requirements and possibilities of different manufacturing methods.
- Experience in structural strength calculations and motor sizing.
- Previous hands-on experience in welding or installation work.

 

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Vi søker deg som kan jobbe i fast og 100% stilling.

Arbeid i helger og ettermiddager må påregnes. Bærekraftsenteret har et dynamisk miljø, og det er gode muligheter for varierte arbeidsdager.


Dine arbeidsoppgaver

En kundeveileder på Rebell har ulike ansvarsoppgaver:

  • Kundebehandling i drive-in varemottak og butikk
  • Mottak, testing og klargjøring av gjenbruksvarer
  • Mindre reparasjoner
  • Prising og systematisering, forefallende lagerarbeid
  • Vareplassering i butikk, utstillinger og kampanjer
  • Betjening av kassapunkter
  • Vertskapsoppgaver ved kurs, møter og arrangementer

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner
  • Du har et engasjement for bærekraft, gjenbruk, redesign eller miljøet. - Eller alt på en gang!
  • Du er glad i å være med mennesker og behandler alle med respekt
  • Du håndterer hektiske perioder - og evner å fylle rolige stunder med arbeidsoppgaver
  • Du vil lære av andre og dele egne kunnskaper
  • Du kan å smile :-)
  • Du er bittelitt REBELLsk!

Vi tilbyr
  • Anledning til å være med og forme Nord-Norges kuleste Bærekraftsenter
  • Et dynamisk og trivelig miljø
  • En varm velkomst i Remiks-familien
  • Fast heltidsstilling, med gode lønns- og pensjonsvilkår
  • All nødvendig opplæring
  • Relevant kurs- og kompetanseheving
    (truckførerbevis, opplæring datasystemer m.v.)

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Remiks som eier Rebell er et avfallsselskap som samler inn, håndterer og behandler avfall i Nord-Norge. Vi tilbyr avfallsløsninger for næringslivet og utfører lovpålagte oppgaver gjennom innsamling av husholdningsavfall i Tromsø og Karlsøy kommune.
Vi jobber med utgangspunkt i våre verdier miljøbevisst, pålitelig, nyskapende og tilgjengelig. Disse verdiene er forankret i alt vi gjør og våre ansatte er våre fremste ambassadører for disse verdiene.
 

Rebell Remiks Bærekraftsenter skal gå til kamp for miljøet og en levedyktig klode. Bærekraftsenteret er et fyrtårn for miljøsamarbeidet i Nord-Norge. Vårt mål er å pirke i miljønerven din, utvikle den slik at du gir noen andre muligheten til å gjenbruke det du ikke har bruk for selv, og likens skal du også kunne fryde deg over dine egne skills innen ombruk, fiksing og reparasjoner.

Rebell er mer enn en bruktbutikk. I tillegg til et stort utvalg gjenbruksvarer finner du kurs og arrangementer, happenings og aktiviteter og ikke minst et trivelig sted å være, med lave skuldre og stor takhøyde.

Vi er underlagt offentlighetsloven, og vi gjør oppmerksom på at du som søker kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. CV kan også bli benyttet til utvidet søkerliste. Du vil i søknadsprosessen kunne anmode om å ikke bli oppført i søkerlisten, og må da angi en begrunnelse. I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, 2. ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. Du vil bli varslet om anmodningen ikke tas til følge.

jobs.title: Group Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Would you like to play a key role in further developing the finance function of an international software and consulting group? We are currently seeking a Group Financial Controller who will take on an important role in our ongoing financial transformation journey.

This is an exciting opportunity for an analytical and hands-on finance professional who enjoys working with financial control, group reporting, consolidation, and business analysis in an international environment. You will work closely with the Group CFO and existing Controllers and play a central role in the Group’s reporting, consolidation, and financial follow-up processes.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the monthly reporting process and period-end close

• Prepare group reporting, including analyses and recommended actions

• Short term forecasting and business controlling

• Perform group consolidation

• Budgeting and long-term forecasting – Take lead in technical modelling.

• Monitor and ensure compliance with the Group's transfer pricing policy

• Monitor liquidity and complete cash flow forecasts

• Assist with audits

• Support and act as backup for Controllers and the CFO when required

• Support potential M&A activities

• Assist the CFO with financial modelling, scenario analysis, and decision support

We are looking for an analytical, independent, and solution-oriented professional who thrives on responsibility and wants to make a visible impact.

• Experience with group reporting and consolidation in international organizations

• Ability to combine financial controlling and business controlling

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable business insights

• Advanced Excel skills

• Experience working with ERP systems, preferably PowerOffice

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal (the primary working language is English)

It Would Be an Advantage If You Also Have

• Experience with BI tools, automated reporting, or AI-based finance solutions

• Experience from consulting, software, and/or project-based businesses

• Commercial mindset

What We Offer

• A key role in a growing international software group

• The opportunity to contribute to the further development of the finance function and business processes

• Close collaboration with leaders and key stakeholders across the Group

• A high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and influence in your role

• An informal and inclusive work environment with skilled colleagues across the companies within Star Group

• Flexible working arrangements and the possibility of remote work

• Fitness allowance and other attractive employee benefits

• Competitive pension and insurance schemes

• Modern office facilities and a strong social working environment

Location: Trondheim or Bergen

Start Date: As soon as possible

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interested candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible.

Star Information Systems, together with Premas, Infoship, Nozzle, and Sharecat Solutions, forms an international group providing software solutions and services to the maritime and energy industries.

Our values, Genuine, Curious, Collaborative, and Committed, shape how we work together, take responsibility, and create results.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Multi-modal microscopy and tomography of virus-infected organoids
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in the development of multimodal microscopy for studying viral infection in organoids, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

Investigating viral interactions within host cells at the single-particle level poses significant challenges due to the resolution limitations of conventional microscopy, particularly in complex organoid tissue sections and lack of multi-modality approach. To overcome these obstacles, it is necessary to develop and apply multi-modal optical microscopy methods, such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy and label-free optical diffraction tomography and quantitative phase microscopy. Another important aspect of this project is to perform advance image analysis on correlative datasets to extract the underlying knowledge. The technical aspect of this project aims to integrate two cutting-edge microscopy platforms, photonic chip-based multimodal microscopy and quantitative phase microscopy (QPM)/optical diffraction tomography. These instruments will be used to study viral infections in organoid models (such as gut and brain). Post-imaging, we will conduct advanced image analysis, develop different models for correlative imaging and on label-free images. As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other DC such as DC 1, DC 6 DC 8 and DC 10.


Job description

At the University of Oslo in Norway, we are looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC 5) to work on WP 3. The main responsibilities of the DC 5 will be:

  • To develop and adapt a multi-modal optical microscopy platform with focus on two modalities, a) photonic chip-based super-resolution optical microscopy and b) optical diffraction tomography & quantitative phase microscopy.
  • To perform correlative fluorescence optical microscopy with 3D quantitative phase tomography to facilitate virtual specificity
  • To generate correlated datasets for analysis of microenvironmental changes during HIV-1 and VEEV infection. To use organoid sections, intact organoids and cells models in this study.
  • Apply advanced image analysis including AI assisted segmentation, classification and correlation
  • Support and collaborate with other doctoral candidates related to imaging, analysis and training.

The doctoral candidate will be guided during this research project by Prof. Balpreet Singh Ahluwalia and Prof. Dag Kristian Dysthe. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered.


How to apply

Technical information:

Position location: Oslo, Norway
Application deadline: October 30, 2026
Project start date: April 1st, 2027
Duration: 3 years

Please follow this link to apply for this position and for more detailed instructions on the application: 
Doctoral Candidate 5 Vacancy — MERIT


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or engineering or related field in biomedical engineering and biophysics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system. Master dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date,
  • Solid, hands-on experience with experimental optical instrumentation, including the development, alignment, operation and/or application of optical microscopy systems,
  • Strong background in image analysis or similar scientific data analysis using Python or MATLAB,
  • An interest in working in a multidisciplinary research group.

Desired qualifications:

  • Background in adapting or development of optical microscopy platforms such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy, diffraction tomography or quantitative phase microscopy systems,
  • Machine learning or AI-assisted analysis of microscopy or other high-dimensional imaging datasets,
  • Image reconstruction and computational microscopy, including algorithms for super-resolution microscopy, phase retrieval, quantitative phase imaging, or optical diffraction tomography,
  • Advanced image analysis, including image registration, segmentation, feature extraction, classification, and correlative/multimodal image analysis.
  • Experience in bioimaging and handling of biological samples,
  • As the target applications involve organoids and viruses, it is beneficial if the candidate have experience working with various biological specimen such as tissue sections or organoid samples,
  • Willingness to collaborate within an international research network and undertake research visits, secondments and training activities at partner institutions.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


General MERIT eligibility criteria
  • Candidates must not have been awarded a doctorate previously
  • Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country or recruiting institution for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the date of recruitment, 1 April 2027. See https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/actions/doctoral-networks
  • Candidates must meet the entry requirements for admission to the PhD-program of the institution to which they apply, see below for more details.

Language requirements

  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8
     

In addition to the eligibility criteria above, candidates admitted to the PhD programme at the University of Oslo must fulfill the grade requirements, see www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7. The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The average grade point for courses included in the master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system.

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. It is essential that the researcher can effectively communicate with the collaborators within the EU project in the field of biology,
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks,

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in molecular fingerprinting in organoids using Raman and autofluorescence micro-spectroscopy, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

This doctoral project will develop and apply advanced label-free optical spectroscopy approaches to investigate molecular and metabolic changes in organoid models of viral infection. The project will combine Raman micro-spectroscopy and UV–visible autofluorescence (AF) spectroscopy, providing complementary information on the biochemical and metabolic state of biological samples without requiring external fluorescent labels. Raman micro-spectroscopy, primarily using 785 nm excitation, will obtain molecular fingerprints associated with lipids, proteins, nucleic acids and metabolites. Complementary UV–visible autofluorescence spectroscopy in the 350–500 nm spectral range will probe endogenous fluorescence signatures associated with cellular metabolism and biochemical composition. The project will investigate both free-space spectroscopy and waveguide-enhanced spectroscopic approaches, including waveguide-enhanced Raman and waveguide-based autofluorescence spectroscopy, with the aim of improving sensitivity to subtle molecular changes.

Photonic waveguides provide strong and spatially extended light–matter interaction through the evanescent optical field, offering opportunities to enhance Raman signals and AF-signals and improve sensitivity compared with conventional free-space measurements. Particular emphasis will be placed on identifying spectral signatures associated with early molecular alterations and metabolic reprogramming that may precede observable structural changes. AI-assisted spectral analysis will be explored to analyse the high-dimensional Raman and autofluorescence datasets. Machine-learning approaches will be used to identify spectral features and molecular signatures associated with infection, distinguish different biological states, and correlate spectroscopic changes with disease progression. The project will use organoid models of HIV-1 and Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV) infection.

As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other doctoral candidates (DC): DC 5, DC 9-10 and DC 12.

jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.description:
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)

Luxembourg
Line of Service Advisory
Industry/Sector Banking and Capital Markets
Specialism Fraud, Investigations & Regulatory Enforcement (FIRE)
Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you?

Your Mission:

In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes.

As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation.
Be a part of our team where you will:

Client Risk Assessment and Advisory

• Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;
• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;
• Assist in designing and implementing financial crime compliance frameworks tailored to client risk profiles.

Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence

• Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;
• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;
• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

• Design and implement transaction monitoring systems to detect suspicious activities across multiple risk typologies;
• Analyze transactional data to identify unusual patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or sanctions breaches;
• Support clients in investigating alerts and preparing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for competent authorities.

Sanctions and Screening Controls

• Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;
• Review and validate screening results, investigate potential matches, and escalate confirmed hits;
• Advise clients on integrating sanctions screening tools and maintaining up-to-date watchlists.

Fraud and Bribery/Corruption Risk Management

• Assist clients in developing anti-fraud and anti-bribery policies and controls;
• Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures;
• Support investigations into suspected fraud or corruption cases.

Monitoring, Reporting, and Regulatory Support

• Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for senior management and regulators;
• Support clients during regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses;
• Maintain and file confidential compliance documentation in accordance with legal requirements.

Training and Awareness

• Deliver training sessions on financial crime compliance, including AML, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery measures;
• Promote awareness of emerging risks, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Let's talk about you. If you have/are:

• Hold a university degree (minimum Bac+3) in Law, Finance, Compliance, or a related field;
• Have at least 3–5 years of experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or regulatory advisory within financial services or consulting;
• Possess strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulations, FATF standards, and global compliance frameworks;
• Bring proven experience in transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud risk management, and investigations;
• Demonstrate excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex projects and multiple priorities;
• Are fluent in English and French and/or German;
• Hold certifications such as CAMS, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or equivalent, which are highly desirable.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,800 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 370,000 people in 149 countries.
