jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Core (Android)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do substantive knowledge work from their phone.

A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone.

As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline.

 - Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality.

 - By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone.

 - Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus.

 - Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus.

 - Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus.

 - AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THIS JOB

We're looking for a Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations to run the business side of marketing. Our marketing team went from two people to 25 this year, organized around four functions: product marketing, brand and consumer, enterprise, and growth. This is the first operations hire on that team. You'll own the marketing budget with Finance, run our planning cycle and operating cadence, keep hiring aligned with the plan, and partner directly with the CMO on how marketing sets priorities and tells its story to the executive team and the board.

It's a role for someone who has sat close to a CMO and a CFO, likes turning ambiguity into a plan people can execute, and is comfortable building the function themselves before building a team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Budget & Financial Operations

 - Own the marketing budget end to end with Finance: allocation across teams and channels, tracking against plan, forecasting, variance flags, and the tradeoff conversations that follow

 - Build the layer of visibility leadership needs (spend by team, channel, and program) on top of the spend-tracking tools we already have, so decisions get made with numbers

 - Run quarterly, half-year, and annual budget planning, and make marketing's case to Finance and the executive team

 - Own marketing's vendor and agency contracts end to end: evaluations, procurement, renewals, and a clear view of what we pay for and why



Planning & Operating Cadence

 - Own marketing's planning cycle: translate company goals into marketing objectives, OKRs, and resourced plans, and keep them current as priorities shift

 - Bring a point of view. Pressure-test plans, frame the tradeoffs, and help the CMO decide where marketing places its bets

 - Design the lightweight processes and internal tools (planning, intake, reporting) that let a 25-person team operate like a much bigger one

 - Run the operating rhythm for the marketing leadership team: meetings, all-hands, team-wide readouts, agendas, decisions, and follow-through

 - Keep the marketing functions connected so plans, launches, and budgets move together



Executive Partnership

 - Partner directly with the CMO on board materials, executive readouts, and strategy documents. Own first drafts and make them data-backed and on-message

 - Extend the CMO's reach across the team: surface risks early, chase decisions to closure, and keep priorities clear week to week

 - Represent marketing in cross-functional planning with Finance, Sales, and Product



Hiring & Org Operations

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition and marketing leads on headcount planning, requisition tracking, and interview process, and keep hiring plans aligned with budget and org design

 - Standardize the basics across sub-teams (job descriptions, interview loops, scorecards) and help new leaders land well




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 10+ years in marketing strategy and operations, business operations, strategic finance, management consulting, or a similar role supporting a CMO, GM, or business unit leader

 - You've owned a sizable marketing or departmental budget end to end and can talk about spend, forecast, and variance the way Finance does

 - You've built or run a planning cycle (annual or half-year, OKRs) and an operating cadence for a leadership team

 - You've drafted board or executive materials for a senior leader and know the difference between a readout and a narrative

 - Experience with headcount planning and hiring operations alongside a Talent team

 - You've run vendor evaluations and procurement alongside Finance and kept a clean view of contracts and renewals

 - Comfortable as an individual contributor. This is the first ops hire; you'll do the work before you have a team

 - You scope light and move fast. We plan in weeks, not quarters, and you build just enough process to keep a fast team aligned

 - You build trust quickly, from individual contributors to the C-suite

 - Bonus: you're comfortable building your own tools with AI. We use Replit to run Replit



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Software Factory
Software Engineer, Mobile Platform (iOS)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the iOS platform that helps engineers ship confidently. As Notion’s mobile team grows, we’re turning the first generation of mobile foundations into a durable platform: clearer architecture, ergonomic testing, dependable observability, and faster CI/CD. This role is broad—you’ll shape the iOS stack end to end, from shared frameworks and build systems to release quality, with opportunities to work across our shared Rust layer and AI infrastructure for mobile development. You’ll pair with mobile AI and core product engineers to understand friction, evaluate new iOS capabilities, and decide what should become part of the platform.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Make the iOS platform agent-ready: Give engineers and agents dependable ways to build, run, test, screenshot, and iterate through the app so mobile teams can move faster without lowering the quality bar.

 - By the end of your first year, define how iOS features are built: establish architecture and ship developer tools, then partner with product engineers to adopt them.

 - Raise the bar for iOS reliability and release quality: Improve the systems that catch regressions, prevent incidents, and help engineers understand issues quickly across builds, tests, observability, and CI/CD.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Deep iOS engineering experience at scale: You’ve helped build and deploy mobile applications used by millions, and understand the reliability, performance, and operational practices required at that scale.

 - Platform or infrastructure experience: You’ve worked below the product-feature layer on mobile CI/CD, testing platforms, build systems, developer tooling, or shared frameworks—and can turn recurring friction into durable systems.

 - Strong architectural judgment: You’re familiar with multiple approaches to iOS architecture and can explain the trade-offs clearly, choosing patterns that make features easier to build, test, and maintain.

 - Cross-functional influence: You can partner closely with product engineers, understand their pain points, and earn adoption for new platform APIs, workflows, and standards without relying on authority.

 - AI-native engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective.

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
jobs.description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

Site Maintenance Planner, for Anaerobic Digestion Plant Facility in Tibohine, Roscommon, Ireland Biocore is a well-established and fast-growing company in the industrial renewable/process sector in Roscommon. This position is designed to strengthen the plant’s maintenance strategy, contractor coordination, and operational monitoring. The company is currently undergoing significant growth, with plans to double the size of the site and bring several new plants online in the near future. Key Responsibilities Monitor plant performance via SCADA systems and proactively identify issues such as system faults, pressure anomalies, and equipment alerts. Liaise with engine maintenance contractors for scheduled servicing, troubleshooting, and resolution of mechanical issues. Develop and maintain the facility’s preventative maintenance plan, including procedures, part replacements, and documentation. Manage tracking and ordering of critical spare parts for mechanical plant systems (e.g.,pumps, mixers, motors, valves). Coordinate closely with internal operations staff to support daily plant performance and reliability. Ensure procedures and contractor activities meet operational and safety standards. Contribute to operational readiness and planning for upcoming site expansion. Participate in a light on-call rota (1 week in every 4). Candidate Profile Engineering degree (mechanical/process/electrical) with 1+ year experience preferred OR 5–6 years of experience as a technician in a process, utilities, or manufacturing environment Strong working knowledge of plant equipment such as pumps, mixers, gearboxes, and associated mechanical systems Experience with SCADA or process monitoring systems Understanding of industrial engine/generator systems is an advantage Proven ability to coordinate contractors, write procedures, and maintain maintenance schedules Excellent communication and organisational skills Comfortable working with Excel and basic maintenance tracking tools Full driving licence Biocore is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply as we believe a diverse team enhances innovation and drives success. Send applications to the HR Manager: lmckenna@biocore.net

jobs.description:

Role: School Aged Childcare Deputy Manager Reporting to: Centre Manager & Company Directors Essential Qualifications: QQI Level 7/8 Early Years Graduate (or equivalent) & 3+ years in a lead practitioner role Hours: 45 hours per week Rate of Pay: €18.50 per hour OVERALL DUTIES Report directly to the Manager and act as Designated Person in Charge in their absence. Assist in staff recruitment, management, training, motivation, and performance monitoring. Ensure delivery of a dynamic emergent curriculum meeting individual children's needs. Maintain quality and safety standards across all operations at all times. Monitor child protection, complaints, incidents, and near-misses; take prompt remedial action and report child protection concerns to Tusla using Children First Guidelines. Maintain professional relationships with external agencies (TUSLA, Dept of Education, Pobal, EHO, Early Intervention Team). Serve as Designated First Aid, Fire Safety, and Deputy Child Protection Person. Facilitate inspections and ensure all required information is provided. Oversee daily service closing at 6:30pm. CHILDREN Provide room relief coverage during staff absences. Ensure all care and educational delivery is child-centred and aligned with Síolta and Aistear frameworks. Oversee developmental observations, Aistear assessments, and individual care/learning plans, including for children with additional needs. Promote equality, diversity, and inclusion within curriculum delivery. Ensure compliance with the Child Care Act 1991 (Early Years Services Regulations 2016 / School Age Services Regulations 2018) and relevant standards. STAFF Provide direction, leadership, and support to childcare practitioners and students. Maintain statutory staff:child ratios and monitor daily staffing levels, rotas, and breaks. Conduct regular staff review meetings and address performance issues in line with company policy. MANAGEMENT / ADMINISTRATION Maintain required administrative records, incident/accident logs, fee records, and visitor logs. Ensure all centre policies and procedures (childcare, employment, health & safety) are implemented and reviewed regularly. HEALTH AND SAFETY Ensure health, safety, and well-being of all children and report potential risks or hazards promptly. PARENTS / GUARDIANS Maintain professional communication and constructive feedback with parents/guardians. Organize and host welcome evening sessions for parents and follow up on queries. TRAINING AND MEETINGS Attend and encourage staff participation in required meetings and training (e.g., First Aid, Manual Handling). FLEXIBILITY Maintain flexibility and complete self-directed professional development as needed. COMMUNICATION Communicate clearly and professionally with internal personnel and external stakeholders/agencies. CONFIDENTIALITY The person appointed to this job shall not during the period of employment maintain professional confidentiality.

jobs.title: Lead Architect Cloud Workspace Platform (OpenStack / VDI / Multi-Région) - Freelance (H/F)
jobs.description:
Taux journalier (TJM): 600

Modalités de la mission

*

   Démarrage : ASAP

*

   Durée : 6 mois renouvelables

*

   Rythme : hybride, 2 jours de télétravail par semaine

*

   Lieu : Paris

Contexte

Un grand acteur du secteur bancaire, construit une plateforme Cloud Privé multi-région. Nous cherchons un architecte senior pour piloter la définition, le sourcing et la mise en œuvre d'un service de workstations à la demande destiné aux équipes de développement, d'administration et d'exploitation.

La cible doit permettre le provisionnement self-service de workstations Linux sur un périmètre distribué de 3 régions et 9 sites, avec des exigences élevées de sécurité, de résilience et de continuité de service. L'architecture s'appuiera sur OpenStack et Apache Guacamole.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

In this role, you own the engagement outcome. You will lead our most complex, multi-workstream engagements in Korea, decide when Forward Deployed Engineers are needed for code-intensive work, and coach others to raise the bar across our Services practice.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead Notion’s most complex, multi-workstream customer engagements in Korea end to end, from scoping and discovery through launch, adoption and handoff, often where the future state and success measures are not yet defined.

 - Shape Services scope, effort estimates and implementation strategy with account teams during pre-sales, then deliver against the agreed scope, timeline and outcomes, recovering engagements that go off track.

 - Drive executive alignment on ambiguous, high-stakes decisions: facilitate discovery and architecture workshops, frame tradeoffs clearly and deliver hard messages directly.

 - Decide where Notion should own, complement or connect to existing systems, and design scalable architectures and AI-native workflows to a production quality bar, including permission design, AI evaluation, human-in-the-loop controls and operational ownership.

 - Orchestrate Forward Deployed Engineers, partners and internal teams: define when deeper engineering is required and set clear scope, ownership and handoffs.

 - Lead change management and adoption through stakeholder alignment, champion programs, phased rollouts and enablement, so customer teams sustain usage and realize measurable value.

 - Coach other architects and partners, and scale the Korea Services practice through reusable reference architectures, packaged solutions and localized enablement.

 - Turn field patterns into evidence-backed product signals (customer pain, business impact, expected outcome and frequency) that influence Notion’s roadmap.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Proven track record of designing and deploying AI-powered workflows or agents in production for customers.

 - Hands-on technical depth in data modeling and permission design, API and integration patterns, agent design and evaluation, enterprise security and governance, and data validation with SQL or scripts. You do not need to write production code.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Experience scoping Services work, estimating effort and delivering within agreed commercial boundaries.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

jobs.title: Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation (m/f)
jobs.description:
Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.
• Promote a pragmatic and user-oriented approach to transformation, focused on operational adoption and sustainable change.

This position is for you if:

• You have 4 to 6 years of experience in change management, business transformation, organisational change, consulting, operational excellence or a similar field.
• You have contributed to transformation programmes involving several stakeholders, business teams or departments.
• Experience with accounting, corporate services, fund administration or professional services environments.
• You can translate strategic objectives into practical change actions.
• You are able to assess how change impacts people, processes, roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
• You are comfortable facilitating discussions, structuring feedback and turning complex situations into clear action plans.
• You have strong communication skills and can adapt your message to partners, managers and operational teams.
• You are structured, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to monitor progress without taking ownership of each individual project.
• You have a good understanding of digital transformation, business applications and the role technology can play in improving processes, collaboration and service delivery.
• You are familiar with the potential of AI in a business environment and have already used, tested or contributed to practical AI-related use cases.
• You are fluent in English and French.
…then this offer is probably made for you!

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Exposure to software implementation or digital transformation programmes.
• Knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter or similar approaches.
• Experience preparing change plans, communication plans, adoption material, training support or stakeholder engagement plans.
• Good command of Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with project or collaboration tools would be an asset.

What we offer

• A key role in a strategic transformation programme within one of BDO Luxembourg's core business practices.
• The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, business teams and technology specialists.
• A varied role combining change management, stakeholder engagement, communication and transformation monitoring.
• A collaborative, multicultural and entrepreneurial working environment.
• The opportunity to contribute to the future operating model of our Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities in line with your strengths and career aspirations.

What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

jobs.title: RESEARCH SCIENTIST IN INTER-SATELLITE COMMUNICATIONS & ... (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
SD-26145- RESEARCH SCIENTIST IN INTER-SATELLITE COMMUNICATIONS & COOPERATIVE NETWORKING

Fixed term contract | Belval | 18 Months
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be mainly in charge of:
• Designing and evaluating inter-satellite link (ISL) architectures tailored to GEO proximity operations, covering both RF and optical crosslink technologies.
• Developing cooperative communication protocols enabling real-time coordination, sensing cueing, and state exchanges between heterogeneous satellite payloads.
• Defining interface specifications to ensure seamless integration of the networking layer with onboard optical and RF sensing systems.
• Designing predictive and resilient networking strategies leveraging orbital geometry and interference-aware link adaptation.
• Contributing to system-level integration and ground-based demonstration activities validating the communication architecture.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• PhD in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related field

Experience and skills
• Research experience in the areas of satellite communications, inter-satellite links, or non-terrestrial networks (NTN)
• Strong background in communication protocol design, including cross-layer optimization, QoS management, and time-critical networking
• Familiarity with 5G/6G architectural concepts and their applicability to space systems (deterministic latency, distributed scheduling, AI-driven link management)
• Experience with simulation and modelling tools for satellite communication systems
• Knowledge of RF and/or optical link technologies is an asset
• Experience in multi-partner research projects is an asset
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively within a multi-disciplinary, international team

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits
• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square meters, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfill their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online
Your application must include:
• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A scientific CV with contact details
• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
• Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions
We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements

Private Capital Fund Accountant Officer M/F

BNP Paribas CIB, a subsidiary of the BNP Paribas group, is one of Europe's leading providers of custody services for securities.

Our commitments and actions for clients and society | BNP Paribas

• Broadening your horizons and exploring different jobs throughout your professional life, thanks to the diversity of our activities and our dynamic career management
• Preserving your work-life balance thanks to our flexible working hours, two satellite offices near the Belgian and French borders, and remote work options
• Thriving daily in an environment where it's great to live and work. Listening to the voices of our employees, we are committed to providing a high-quality work environment based on respect, diversity, inclusion, and a spirit of camaraderie.

jobs.description:
Market Head for Central and Northern Europe

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

As Market Head for Central and Northern Europe, you'll directly manage the Netherlands Desk based in Luxembourg and build profitable long-term client relationships. The role focuses on generating Net New Money (NNM), growing Assets Under Management (AUM) and increasing gross revenue through high-quality new client acquisition and deeper client solutions. You'll partner across Global Private Banking (GPB) and Commercial Banking (CMB) to bring the right products and services to clients and prospects. Success means delivering agreed financial targets through a strong pipeline, effective referrals across the Group and consistently high standards of client service. You'll also shape a strong risk and control environment with clear expectations on KYC, sales quality and compliance.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Lead and manage the Netherland Market composed of Senior Relationship Managers (hunters), as well based out of PBLU.
• Drive business development efforts through the focus on new client acquisition of UHNW and Family Office segments in the Netherlands and other key International markets related to your business.
• Stir share of wallet increase discipline with the existing UHNW client base through systematic client planning, sales management, client connectivity and other means.
• Ensure collaboration with other markets and locations within HSBC Private Banking, as well as enhance connectivity with HSBC Commercial and Global Banking business lines in the Netherlands and other key International markets.
• Promote brand visibility of HSBC Private Banking in the Netherlands and other key International markets through various initiatives, including proactive marketing, communication, collaboration with business introducers.
• Actively promote, manage, train, develop and assess all members of the team within assigned area of responsibility.

You should apply if you have:

• Min. 10 years of relevant experience in Private Banking within UHNW Netherlands and other key International client segments.
• Strong hunter mindset, proven track record of growing the business and driving acquisition of new clients.
• Demonstrated track record of leading a team of Relationship Managers.
• Decision maker, capable of providing judgment and clear direction within the established framework.
• Fluency in English and Dutch. French and/or German would be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is €200,000 – €350,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Global Head of Land Revenue, you’ll be the global owner for technical new-business strategy, pipeline, and conversion—a customer-facing, technical revenue leadership role, not a RevOps or sales operations role. You’ll own Notion’s Land number (net-new and upgrade iARR across regions), work closely with EPD and Product, and step into high-stakes technical conversations with customers and partners as Notion shifts from product-led to sales-led selling in an AI-native world.

This role is the global owner for new business standards, pipeline programs, and operating cadence. You’ll set the way for landing new business revenue globally, partner with Regional GMs who own regional P&L outcomes, and ensure consistent execution through scalable programs, playbooks, enablement, and governance.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, Sales leadership, and regional teams to improve pipeline quality, win rates, conversion, and time-to-productivity. You’ll also design operating standards that balance regional accountability with global program consistency.

You’ll be measured on qualified pipeline creation, coverage, conversion, program ROI, velocity, handoff quality, and BDR/SC ramp outcomes—requiring you to operate with strong systems thinking, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Run the global new business operating cadence, including weekly program reviews, monthly pipeline health inspection, quarterly planning, escalation paths, and decision-rights models

 - Partner with Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Product, and Partnerships to align new business programs, systems, content, enablement, feedback loops, and change management


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Deeply technical SaaS background with meaningful customer-facing experience—solutions engineering, solutions consulting, field or customer engineering, or technical sales—plus ownership of a revenue, quota, pipeline, or conversion outcome

 - Deep understanding of pipeline mechanics and how to influence conversion levers end-to-end, including qualified pipeline creation, coverage ratios, lead response, handoff quality, stage progression, win-rate lift, and velocity

 - Strong program-building instincts: you can design scalable plays, instrument them with data, and run an inspection cadence that drives behavior change

 - Experience building operating systems for global teams, including cadences, dashboards, governance, playbooks, definitions, and change-management mechanisms

 - Executive presence and cross-functional leadership: able to align and influence Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, and regional teams without relying on direct reporting lines for every dependency

 - Ability to balance regional autonomy with global craft excellence: you set the bar, create standards, and drive consistency while enabling local execution

 - Strong enablement and role-design instincts, with the ability to define expectations, onboarding paths, certification standards, and time-to-productivity mechanisms for BDR and SC motions

 - Builder orientation and comfort in ambiguity: you create the playbook while the org is executing, and you iterate quickly based on market, customer, and performance signals

 - Hands-on with AI tools, and able to credibly explain how AI and agents change workflows for technical teams


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with solution-led selling motions and technical or product-adjacent go-to-market

 - Track record building global programs that still allow regional adaptation

 - Experience partnering deeply with Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and Enablement to create measurable net new business impact

 - Experience designing partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account motions, or field event program standards at scale

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. Youâll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If youâre a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. jobs.title: Client Advisor
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptalâs value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptalâs full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the clientâs concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the clientâs needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptalâs service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the clientâs need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2â3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology â MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk â and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a clientâs thinking when their stated request isnât the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isnât the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

jobs.description:
Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

Permanent, full-time employment

Pension scheme

5 weeks of vacation

Flexible benefits account

Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with "Baker - Maribo" in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

If you are moving from abroad, Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service can help with practical questions about relocation, registration, housing, a partner's job search and settling in Denmark. jobs.title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.
